notes.title: Cruising Nebraska World of Trucks Event
notes.content:
Please join us on [b]Thursday, the 16th of May[/b], as we celebrate the release of our new Nebraska DLC, by taking part in our [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] event –[b] Cruising Nebraska![/b] Through expansive plains, past golden fields and tranquil rivers, you'll explore the rich landscape and economy of the amazing Cornhusker state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f66de1f8b4b2fafa8dce1be1f720b7bea93bb01a.jpg[/img]

We are asking our [b]#BestCommunityEver[/b] to achieve the community goal of driving [b]125,000,000 miles[/b] (201,168,000 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Nebraska.

As you're [b]#CruisingNebraska[/b] and taking in the sights and sounds of this historic state, you'll enjoy the opportunity to view the famous Oregon Trail railway line, or roll through the peaceful streets of some delightful towns such as Ansley, Auburn, Alma and Barnett to name but a few. Nebraska also proudly hosts beautiful wildlife such as the white-tailed deer, ornate box turtle, sandhill crane and is where you can find the stunning blue agate gemstone. And, don't forget, it is also famous for the world's largest Columbian mammoth skeleton, affectionately named 'Archie'.

As you participate in the Cornhusker state's booming economy, you'll get to see some interesting new industries, such as recreational and utility vehicle dealerships, agriculture processing factories, and a wide array of train yards, farms and construction warehouses.

And, during your travels, you can look forward to many spectacular views and highlights such as:[list]
[*] Lake McConaughy, Nebraska's largest reservoir, referred to as "Big Mac" by locals.
[*] Golden Spike Tower, iconic landmark in North Platte, adjacent to the Union Pacific's Railroad Bailey Yard, one of the largest rail yards in the world.
[*] Great Platte River Road Archway Monument, architectural landmark symbolizing the gateway to the American West.
[*] Scotts Bluff National Monument, offering panoramic views of the North Platte River Valley.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=jdPPaR9nWhk;full][/previewyoutube]
As with past cruising events, you can use your own trailer and experience all these in the external market!

Nebraska DLC offers [b]12[/b] fabulous new cities to explore, and we're offering a special reward for completing your [b]personal goal[/b], which will require you to deliver a job [b]to or from all of them[/b]. All jobs for the event need to be 100 miles each (161 km) or more.

Take part in this breathtaking journey through the Great Plains and cruise through Nebraska's diverse landscapes while contributing to its robust and historic economy of agriculture, manufacturing and tourism. All aboard for a trip through the Cornhusker state!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e934c6bd59144e158395d02e87438431ad69a9e3.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Rules[/b][/h3]

Using [b]External Contracts[/b] or [b]External Market[/b], with a World of Trucks-connected profile in American Truck Simulator, the [b]community goal is to drive 125,000,000 miles[/b] (201,168,000 km) while delivering cargoes [b]to or from[/b] any city in Nebraska.

When a player completes a delivery to or from 12 different Nebraska cities, they will achieve their personal goal.

All jobs for the event need to be at least [b]100 miles[/b] each (161 km), or more.

You can check if your recent deliveries met these conditions using your [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/jobs]Log Book[/url] in your World of Trucks profile.
[h3][b]Rewards[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Personal:[/b] Players that deliver cargo [b]to or from[/b] 12 Nebraska cities will gain a personal [b]World of Trucks Achievement[/b] and a [b]Mighty Mammoth[/b] themed ATS truck [b]paint job[/b] Steam inventory item.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f3d28b8477e59330af0a48ecdfe8b6be822b0144.jpg[/img]
[list][*] [b]Community:[/b] When the community goal of driving 125,000,000 miles (201,168,000 km) during deliveries [b]to or from[/b] any city in Nebraska is met, and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive a hanging [b]Box Turtle ornament[/b] Steam inventory item.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/85a44a53e26806521c106b70cc8382dd0cbeb59a.jpg[/img]
[b]The event will be concluded on Sunday, the 14th of July at 23:59 UTC.[/b]

We look forward to hearing from you about your adventures and we're sure you'll love cruising the amazing Cornhusker State! So, please share your screenshots and videos with us using the hashtag #CruisingNebraska on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]X (formerly Twitter[/url]), and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url] profiles and we will share our favorite ones (we may even feature some of them in a future blog post!).

notes.title: American Truck Simulator - 1.50 Update Release
notes.content:
Exciting news! The 1.50 update for American Truck Simulator has officially rolled out and is ready for download on Steam. Packed with bug fixes, adjustments, and fresh content, this update promises an enhanced experience for all players. Check out the detailed features below and dive right in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9cf25706877c268ea19daf48f107ca270f0930d8.jpg[/img]
A huge shoutout to all who contributed, shared feedback, and reported bugs during the Experimental Beta phase. Your invaluable contributions have enabled us to fine-tune, refine, and eliminate bugs that slipped through the cracks initially. Now, it's time to reap the rewards of your collective efforts and release the 1.50 update as we have other projects (like the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska DLC[/url]) coming that will be based on this version of the game. Happy trucking!

[previewyoutube=ihLPbYr1EjM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Renderer Changes - (still based on DirectX 11 API for now)[/h3]
We're consistently working on improving our rendering system. It's been a key focus for us lately, and although it's a project for the long run, we already have some new content available for you. So in version 1.50, we are introducing these highly requested improvements to the graphics of our games: 
[list]
[*] TAA, or Temporal Anti-Aliasing, which sets itself apart from other anti-aliasing techniques that aim to smooth images to reduce jagged edges or flickering through higher resolution rendering. Instead, TAA harnesses the timeline, particularly previous frames, to calculate color values as if from a higher resolution, providing a smoother result.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/35ce6ac04ebeadc222a5e4294344ae4dc717eb0e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/31ccac0bb4b6cc86251b548a68d2af95ccf0006d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e92c65598bea1d44eadf432f493c9a5e7739a668.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2d645871fea0627d5a6510094a448477eaba3f45.jpg[/img]
[*] Cascaded shadow changes: Smooth transition when blending between cascades, smoother and better-stabilized shadow edges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f82f2843707bcf876620fc4d673f5ac1d75f0944.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/dfb6cd2e445ed9504983098c98796c9b36dc3640.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c805ec04b48397da787446a20897d561903a2cc6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0e471a049e285ee93b8b2c14a77f3e2ca7baa693.jpg[/img]
[*] Soft particles: Particles and light flares smoothly fade out when near geometry, eliminating harsh intersections for a more seamless visual experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/539126113c901ecd41aaa6bc95a6769dd6e95c59.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e230a579d55914ec6b18367405b4c722261d1d2b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/597d8b87fae12ebfa2be9ffad9fb7c62fc0a7a41.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/fecf4a363bdb9f7190cd281e060ddf65035d22ce.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b694d0500d2efffab96f51e8d71870257dc5610b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b338f8fb851d555bc8bd834b7c77a0dc4840cfb3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ecf75f4751dd7341db3dd9dc9cc75c7317de0f3e.jpg[/img]
[*] Lit/shadowed smoke: Smoke particles with enhanced volume perception and shading from sunlight, providing a more realistic and immersive atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a4605e1db04d7b50d5e3e6424a01634fad4b07ab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/11d2b4cd36642565262d8b4984fc4c935de06353.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6ccdbb64dcabe8fe66307d61fe371a0ec17a5fe7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8d1e52fe26114434831b98fe4b53978405b1717a.jpg[/img]
[*] Far shadows: Ever-present shadows from distant large objects like factory halls, skyscrapers, and road overpasses, with the option to toggle them off in the Options menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/faec352956f281db002b5ca0df7e2d9789375373.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4551e1feebe0225531a595e7f84396638664ab62.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4cf975f6dd9ef3bc8475a7b10bc81984a8fac1b1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/923a211ca527cd9f4d1ba8af73cb41ef704f0a94.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e45d96f5b81bbfaab84c7ed8c3dd5e20ff1ff8b1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/264467ea6cb8126b35f4555b6ce035589d45884b.jpg[/img]
[*] Optimized light computation: Dynamic lights are evaluated in a single pass, known as clustered lighting, improving performance in night scenes.
[/list]
[h3]User Interface Rework[/h3]
We are introducing substantial UI updates to enhance player interaction and accommodate more features. The redesign adopts a flatter, minimalistic design with tooltips and layered navigation, ensuring easier accessibility. For most UI screens, the visible changes are just an evolution of the previous look, though functionally, a lot of work was invested into making them work more comfortably with a gamepad or a steering wheel, requiring less time reaching for a keyboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9f0c6f4d66c18723ddb54ab35c1fccc151129d93.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/21b8da85dcfb27b68da7fc03240ef1761474b987.jpg[/img]
The biggest change is the Home screen redesign, a new Status Bar sitting atop many various UI screens, the Quick Menu shortcuts, new fonts, icons, and much more. This results in a clearer look on 2K and 4K resolutions, with all the changes contributing to a more streamlined gaming experience. You can read about the new UI in more detail in a dedicated blog post here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/edb9461322ca2bf55f3e1806b206596e7d016c34.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/eeb98ff6a2ff9b3db1bcb0111eb07ce4652c7aae.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/fb513f1ff7a5269c8093609b3e094f2e5efd793e.jpg[/img]
[h3]California Rework - Phase 3[/h3]
The third phase of the California rework makes its debut in the 1.50 update for American Truck Simulator, with a primary focus on central California. This region encompasses key cities starting from the north, such as San Francisco, Oakland, and Stockton, and extends southward to Santa Maria and Bakersfield, although the latter two are not included in this rework phase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5868e6b1faa2bb9b5d100de10f114afbb6eea25b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5cd65e055008cebc393fe2fa7a59f2274391d428.jpg[/img]
Six cities have undergone a complete rework: [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/03/california-rework-california-trucking-4.html]San Francisco[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/02/california-rework-oakland-san-jose.html]Oakland[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/10/california-rework-stockton.html]Stockton[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/05/california-rework-santa-cruz.html]Santa Cruz[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/12/california-rework-fresno-huron.html]Huron[/url], and [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/12/california-rework-fresno-huron.html]Fresno[/url]. We have also added two brand-new cities, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/02/california-rework-oakland-san-jose.html]San Jose[/url] and [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/11/california-rework-modesto.html]Modesto[/url], which will replace Oakdale in our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b2d670417ef3c74512a7020dbe0df9447d58addf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/fe44d00377ecee3f801819f5b96f08646cc2c236.jpg[/img]
All roads in the area have received a complete overhaul, including major routes such as CA-1, US-101, I-5, CA-99, US-395, and more. The beautiful Yosemite National Park also underwent significant enhancements as part of this update! You can watch our trailer for this phase of California rework below.

[previewyoutube=yffmOK_q6Wo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]International LT S13 & International LoneStar[/h3]
With the 1.50 version, the International LT receives revamped interior and exterior options, and the LoneStar gets a refreshed interior. The International LT's exterior sees significant enhancements with new features, customizable options, and adjustments to existing parts, including the addition of the S13 model with its Integrated Powertrain. Additional accessories such as new chassis fairing extenders, bumper and grille options, FlowBelow fairings, blindspot detectors, and a shorter day cab chassis have been introduced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/14fc57158b9adb1d24ebc60c0e90dcd5d8f15fad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6d86950704bd3bef653630730378d08c8f335eea.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/363cec054d03e54d8072e1782bf51b041da42e76.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2f4d3f5f464d76db2c23f17f548c722adb69b622.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/66370e5ceefd4e2898f403507b82303677f6237d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a46b870304316c0d13762ae666d5e3c71ca3b5bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1428a79c57dcfa4aaec5f8016278629127eac9bf.jpg[/img]
The interiors of both trucks have also undergone a complete overhaul with new models, updated textures, customizable interior cabinets, and functioning cabin physics, fulfilling a highly requested feature. We already released a separate blog dedicated to this topic which you can read here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d04b8a03a02f6ee39182b8fe701591bafe2a5273.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d372b142eae7ee007f81e371efe82653297cf5e8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8fc9c194326296f72d6665256fd2a9ff969cac6c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ed687625c24173bc6da40dc6b81a9118e64514ac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/842c2c775d56f6b101ae5c0cd3ed14e499a66324.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8af97dad1759653ea2856c3b506fb5d1640ad859.jpg[/img]
[h3]Options Tooltips[/h3]
Placing your mouse over each setting option will display helpful information, including explanations of what the options do. You will now effortlessly grasp the purpose of every adjustable option in the settings, enabling you to easily fine-tune your experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d95b1de951ed91cc360e49511fdf36528bdd3590.jpg[/img]
[h3]Lane Assistant[/h3]
After implementing various driver assistance features, developing a lane assistant was the next step for us. This system features different modes that make it work well with various ways people control their vehicles, including steering wheels with force feedback. Now, truck drivers can enjoy simply turning it on along with adaptive cruise control, and letting the truck do more of the driving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/905233afa63ac726b77ad8cde08c5266e3eb4754.jpg[/img]

[h3]Western Star 49X - New Exhausts[/h3]
The Western Star 49X now boasts an exclusive edition featuring specially crafted official exhaust systems for both the daycab and sleeper variants. Elevating its premium status, these exhaust shields are intricately engraved with striking Western Star lettering, ensuring your truck makes a bold statement on the road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ba7a51657f062030bc7720de81fd00650e608701.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1e3830fb6b53764dae4f192bd69fa93220a67be6.jpg[/img]

[b]Visual[/b]
[list]

[*] Far shadows

[*] Frame rate limiter added
[/list]
[b]Sound[/b]

[/list]
We hope you are excited to try out all the new content! Remember to follow us on our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]) so you won't miss out on any news from the world of American Truck Simulator. notes.title: American Truck Simulator - 1.50 Update Experimental Beta
notes.content:
Today, we're rolling out something a little different: the Experimental Beta for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]'s upcoming 1.50 update. Why call our upcoming beta experimental? We need to manage expectations right from the start. We are starting the beta cycle this time from a rather early stage. The level of polish and stability is not the same as for our usual Open Betas. We believe in transparency with our community, and we also need to gather a lot of feedback early this time, to understand how well the features perform. That's why we're offering this Experimental Beta as a precursor to the Open Beta, giving you a glimpse of what's to come while acknowledging that it's still very much a work in progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d974bb5392b6f625e3b40bec338ebb7ed74a8810.jpg[/img]
Behind the scenes, our team is hard at work juggling internal projects and releases, all scheduled for version 1.50 of our games. Despite our best efforts, certain aspects of the update are still undergoing refinement. However, we recognize the importance of involving our community in the development process, which is why we're making this content available to you in its current state. Your feedback during this phase is invaluable as we really want to deliver the best possible experience.

With the Experimental Beta, we invite our dedicated players to join us in fine-tuning, testing, and providing feedback. Your input will help us identify and address any issues or imperfections before the Open Beta and eventually the full 1.50 version release. It's important to note though, that this beta may cause instability in certain areas. If you prefer a more polished experience, we recommend waiting for the further Open Beta release.

Rest assured, our commitment to delivering high-quality updates remains unwavering. In the days to come, we'll continue to debug and finalize everything that's coming to ATS with the 1.50 update. Your patience and support during this phase are greatly appreciated as we work towards a seamless transition to the next chapter of American Truck Simulator. Now, without further delay, let's take a look at what you can expect from version 1.50.

[h3]Renderer Changes - (still based on DirectX 11 API for now)[/h3]
We're consistently working on improving our rendering system. It's been a key focus lately, though it'll take some time to complete. Until then, you can expect additional content and enhancements in version 1.50, including: 
[list]
[*] A new feature was added - TAA, or Temporal Anti-Aliasing, which sets itself apart from other anti-aliasing techniques, that aim to smooth images to reduce jagged edges or flickering through higher resolution rendering. Instead, TAA harnesses the timeline, particularly previous frames, to calculate color values as if from a higher resolution, providing a smoother result.
[*] Cascaded shadow changes: Smooth transition when blending between cascades, smoother and better-stabilized shadow edges.
[*] Soft particles: Particles and light flares smoothly fade out when near geometry, eliminating harsh intersections for a more seamless visual experience.
[*] Lit/shadowed smoke: Smoke particles with enhanced volume perception and shading from sunlight, providing a more realistic and immersive atmosphere.
[*] Far shadows: Ever-present shadows from distant large objects like factory halls, skyscrapers, and road overpasses, with the option to toggle them off in the Options menu.
[*] Optimized light computation: Dynamic lights are evaluated in a single pass, known as clustered lighting, improving performance in night scenes.
[/list]
[h3]User Interface Rework[/h3]
We are introducing substantial UI updates to enhance player interaction and accommodate more features. The redesign adopts a flatter, minimalistic design with tooltips and layered navigation, ensuring easier accessibility. For most UI screens, the visible changes are just an evolution of the previous look, though functionally, a lot of work was invested into making them work more comfortably with a gamepad or a steering wheel, requiring less time reaching for a keyboard. The biggest change is the Home screen redesign, a new Status Bar sitting atop many various UI screens, the Quick Menu shortcuts, new fonts, icons, and much more. The result should be a clearer look on 2K and 4K resolutions, with all the changes contributing to a more streamlined gaming experience. We plan to have a separate, more detailed blog on this topic in the near future, so stay tuned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ad782d46ed9e1ff32d46169869e72cbc2191cdbf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/565886c72d3f20bb4193c0bd89c3c99d052a4eee.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/691f201a5dbd3c8f9a79e02aec2591587514b9ac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d6a8cbb7eb2cf0e7558bbe478b84dc4149ed9b56.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a04c1979ff4788a67ab32c614052d347610509c8.jpg[/img]
[h3]California Rework - Phase 3[/h3]
The eagerly awaited third phase of the California rework is focused on central California. Six cities have undergone a complete rework: [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/03/california-rework-california-trucking-4.html]San Francisco[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/02/california-rework-oakland-san-jose.html]Oakland[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/10/california-rework-stockton.html]Stockton[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/05/california-rework-santa-cruz.html]Santa Cruz[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/12/california-rework-fresno-huron.html]Huron[/url], and [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/12/california-rework-fresno-huron.html]Fresno[/url]. We have also added two brand-new cities; [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/02/california-rework-oakland-san-jose.html]San Jose[/url] and [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/11/california-rework-modesto.html]Modesto[/url], which will replace Oakdale in our game.

All roads in the area have received a complete overhaul, including major routes such as CA-1, US-101, I-5, CA-99, US-395, and more. The beautiful [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/02/california-rework-yosemite-national-park.html]Yosemite National Park[/url] also underwent significant enhancements as part of this update! You can watch our trailer for this phase of California rework below.

[previewyoutube=yffmOK_q6Wo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]International LT S13 & International LoneStar[/h3]
The International LT will receive revamped interior and exterior options, and the LoneStar will get a refreshed interior. The International LT's exterior sees significant enhancements with new features, customizable options, and adjustments to existing parts, including the addition of the S13 model with its Integrated Powertrain. Additional accessories such as new chassis fairing extenders, bumper and grille options, FlowBelow fairings, blindspot detectors, and a shorter day cab chassis have been introduced. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/34b4e80c57eea46f497da6fe3a819249bddfb928.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/174fba414e3361dd2bd4a390c137076d08c22494.jpg[/img]
The interiors of both trucks have also undergone a complete overhaul with new models, updated textures, customizable interior cabinets, and functioning cabin physics, fulfilling a highly requested feature. Stay tuned for more updates as we plan to have a separate blog on this topic in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0e0ab4dd34711aaac5174f7d3bd4f7c5168653fb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/accff5fb164383d52640207f6d4de160e5694b2b.jpg[/img]
[h3]Options Tooltips[/h3]
Placing your mouse over each setting option will now display helpful information, including explanations of what the options do. You will now effortlessly grasp the purpose of every adjustable option in the settings, enabling you to easily fine-tune your experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/976fbe10327b400a28d677eaa0c170b64b080a74.jpg[/img]
[h3]Lane Assistant[/h3]
After implementing various driver assistance features, developing lane assistance was the next step for us. This system is more complicated because it has to work well with different ways people control their vehicles. Making it work well with steering wheels with force feedback was particularly important, even though it was challenging because of possible problems like control-force feedback loops and other details.

Also, the lane assistant features different modes, each serving distinct purposes, making it more complicated. Now, truck drivers can enjoy simply turning it on along with adaptive cruise control, letting the truck do more of the driving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/31b357c36e6a6ac923a9db5c50dc842ac826b98d.jpg[/img]
[h3]Changelog[/h3]

[b]Map[/b]
[list]
[*] California Rework – Phase 3
[/list]
[b]Vehicles[/b]
[list]
[*] International LT S13
[*] International LoneStar (interior) and LT (exterior & interior) rework
[*] Lane assistant feature added
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Substantial UI design update (Home screen redesign, persistent Status Bar, Quick Menu, new fonts, icons and more)
[*] Settings options show information about what they do
[/list]
[b]Visual[/b]
[list]
[*] Improvements in the rendering system
[*] Temporal Anti-Aliasing feature added
[*] Cascaded shadow updates
[*] Soft particles 
[*] Lit/shadowed smoke 
[*] Far shadows
[*] Optimized light computation
[*] Frame rate limiter added
[/list]
[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] Brake squeaking sounds added
[/list]
So, do enjoy all these new additions, but please remember: It's only an experimental beta, not an open beta yet or even a stable public version, so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the open beta or the final release. But if you're interested in helping us get there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=187]on our forum[/url] and your bug reports in the dedicated section.

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in the experimental beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator  → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.50. No password is required. Sometimes you may need to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.

So, to our community, thank you for your ongoing dedication and feedback. Together, let's make the Experimental Beta a valuable stepping stone towards Open Beta and an exceptional 1.50 version. Don't forget to stay connected with us and all the latest information through our social media channels, make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]. Happy trucking!

notes.title: Arkansas - Weigh Stations, Rest Areas & Welcome Centre
notes.content:
If you're travelling from afar, the first thing that may come to your mind after a long journey may be to take a well deserved rest, or perhaps a quick stop at a Welcome Center to find out what's on offer in the area. Like many other states, our upcoming Arkansas DLC for American Truck Simulator will feature both of these, welcoming in travellers from across the USA! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8a6e3fe2e834a62a01aa1a27384e135c2820363e.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Welcome Center[/b][/h3]

On your journey into Arkansas, you'll be able to discover two Welcome Centers, both designed for visitors and truckers alike. The first being on the border close to Louisiana, where you'll find a variety of parking spots, a resting area for truckers, dedicated covered picnic tables and of course, the main welcome center itself which features the state's name and official nickname, built from locally sourced native stone! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e5d32bf703a5b09dec6a2ca7263450841a51a441.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e5bb2f43263bb8e33fdbddd7cbed08d453451fae.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9f78341065a2d6155406bcdd50e885ad3a0dd0f8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/dfec4223036177d6281640184650850e0442862e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/39d5762900e8727e5eecc1cdde22e20cfb089ee2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c2c942008fa3238faa737341267e7ca616755ea9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/59cf97868727b2f0162edfebfcfc89325a0599a6.jpg[/img]
You'll find the second Welcome Center on the border with Texas on US-71, and while it features a similar design, it features a larger layout, parking and rest area. The design of the main building itself received a significant upgrade in 2017, increasing its size due to its popularity and proximity to the state line. 

[h3][b]Rest Areas[/b][/h3]

Taking regular rest breaks is vital for drivers to combat fatigue and maintain their alertness while driving long distances. While it is required for drivers to stop for at least a 30 minute break, feel free to pull in for a rest at one of Arkansas' Rest Areas whenever you like! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/eebe45d4360fd5e2056887e9b8a4d461f57507f6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/376222f07f3178adcf0fce9f596d01448c35eb8a.jpg[/img]
One such rest area you will find is the White River Rest Area, situated nearby the picturesque White River. This rest area beckons weary travellers with its tranquil ambiance and scenic vistas.

[h3][b]Weigh Stations[/b][/h3]

Whilst Welcome Centers and Rest Areas are not necessary stops on one's journey, you may be legally required to pull into a Weigh Station. Their purpose is to ensure heavy vehicles comply with state weight regulations, whilst promoting road safety and preventing damage to infrastructure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2a8a8191eae5a536d8bbf8cd8e4d1d1aa368d700.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f07825092b76470d603fb4cbd4fc8681165426a8.jpg[/img]
Make sure to pull in if you hear your weigh station alarm activate, failing to comply may result in a hefty fine! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e6bec88006ae134c15a9de8536d0cf99767da067.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4a89b06c3ae09dafa6b8d4a2859e3f58ad166c9e.jpg[/img]
With all these options to stop, we aren't slowing down our work on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2585150/American_Truck_Simulator__Arkansas/]Arkansas DLC[/url]. If you are excited about this upcoming state coming to American Truck Simulator, make sure to add it your Steam Wishlist! Until next time, keep on truckin'.

notes.title: Haulin' Hearts Online Event
notes.content:
Join us as we celebrate Valentines day by taking part in our latest [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] event – [b]Haulin’ Hearts[/b]!

[previewyoutube=34vUacxAKVg;full][/previewyoutube]
Since the 14th Century Valentine’s Day has been recognised as a time to embrace the chance to give something special to those we hold dear in our hearts, whether it be a letter of love, a heartfelt poem or gift, and today is no different. With all the love on offer, there is plenty miles to cover and loads of Valentines Presents to deliver this year, and every bit helps.

 Today I’m Haulin’ Hearts afar,
    With nothing else in mind.
        And to this task I pledge my word
            For everyone in kind.

                And while I’m on the road out there
                    With fourteen loads ahead,
                        I’ll stop at nothing ‘til I’m done,
                            Then rest my weary head.

                                But not before I’m in your arms
                                    Oh darling love of mine.
                                        For one and all and all for one,
                                            And you my Valentine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c74f73270835f4d76ca3ccce146c5194bb0fdf7b.jpg[/img]

So we invite you, our [b]#BestCommunityEver[/b], whether you have a special sweetheart of your own or simply want to help others connect during this romantic time, to complete the community goal of [b]600,000 deliveries[/b] of Valentines Presents to loved ones around the world! Our special Valentines themed event trailers are all loaded up and ready to roll for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e052797d11eb3a748c7271ef9e1036360fea4e77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/53e3adae149734c88cca3355cfbfdb49abc1edca.jpg[/img]
This is, once again, a great chance for you to create a romantic matching paint job with your truck if you happen to own the Valentine's Paint Jobs Pack DLC for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/588600/American_Truck_Simulator__Valentines_Paint_Jobs_Pack/]ATS[/url]!

Your personal goal requires [b]14 deliveries[/b] of Valentines Presents cargo, and as our thank you we are offering great rewards including  a special World of Trucks Achievement. So, come along and join the fun!

[h3]Rules[/h3]

Using External Contracts, with a [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url]-connected profile in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both, the community goal is to achieve 600,000 deliveries of Valentine Presents cargo, from any city in any trucking territory.

When a player completes 14 deliveries of Valentine Presents cargo across any trucking territories in either game, it will complete their personal goal.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]

[list]
[*] Personal: Players that complete 14 or more deliveries of Valentine Presents cargo will gain a unique [b]World of Trucks Achievement[/b] as well as a [b]Winged Heart[/b] cabin item as a Steam inventory item for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e83f5cebcdb6dc3a2bff891ada3cfc0470d77133.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Community: When the community goal of achieving 600,000 deliveries of Valentine Presents cargo from any city is met and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive a [b]Trucker's Rose[/b] hanging item as a Steam inventory item for their cabin.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c0d2ccb98d6aeee13a1e72cb6d0711ecb5249c7a.jpg[/img]
[b]Note:[/b] In order to qualify for any community reward, you must complete at least your personal goal in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both. Each reward will be a Steam inventory item for both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator. Once completed, claim your reward in the Events page on your [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] profile.

The event will be concluded on [b]Sunday the 18th of February at 23:59 UTC[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df3f07e553e298821d41656a0acf37d3bfaf66db.jpg[/img]

In celebration of this event, we are introducing the Haulin' Hearts Bundle on Steam! If you are an owner of only American Truck Simulator or Euro Truck Simulator 2, this bundle will offer you a chance to fall in love with the title you are missing out on along with exploring the roads in special Valentine-themed paint jobs. Or perhaps, in case you are already having a good time in both of the games and you’re starting to feel a bit lonely, you can always gift the bundle to the special someone and set out on a journey together in the multiplayer Convoy mode.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30356/Haulin_Hearts_Bundle/

notes.title: California Rework - The Golden State #3
notes.content:
Today we are happy to be celebrating American Truck Simulator's 8th Anniversary! Since its release in 2016, we've come a long way in providing so much new content and so many free updates. One such project we've been continually working on is our California Rework, which sees the one of the first U.S. states to be released with our base game, being rebuilt from the ground up by our talented team and brought upto todays map quality standard. Once complete, it will be released as a free update for all current and future owners of American Truck Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ed65f803c66fcd0e631c2cd7c7fe222dbc25ef12.jpg[/img]

This blog serves as a part 3 on 'The Golden State', so we recommend taking a read of our previous [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/04/california-rework-golden-state-1.html]Part 1[/url] and [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/10/california-rework-golden-state-2.html]Part 2[/url] blogs, if you haven't already! 

[h3][b]CA-1[/b][/h3]

Our team has been continuing their work on the legendary CA-1/US-1 Coastline Scenic Route, which is being reworked completely from the ground up. This time, the team is focusing their efforts recreating the highway between Santa Cruz and San Luis Obispo. Along this part of the CA-1, you will pass through famous coastline areas such as Big Sur, San Carpoforo Creek and Willow Creek.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f8651e3d5e85b919c78e2d28e1b987547f779d40.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/33da82070eaf71408a69cfdcceaaa10a237b3bdd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0520b384f4467f031003dbf3f69c57b971218665.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/620701beb1366541bf5803334465dcb9a86220e1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a99714cf6d0ba94cd5ddf68de798c3401998fba6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fcac7d62e0cac0bbd1e8fa111ce310526280f97a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c4ef3795b25067be9a9f7e7aa7ac88f57e2d0b8f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/01b3d6826d1486c6523a3335efaffa0d513bd697.jpg[/img]
As you may know, this highway is incredibly scenic and will feature many bridges and creeks which lead onto the beautiful California coastline. It is a must-drive for any American road-tripper.. or trucker! 

[h3][b]I-5[/b][/h3]

We've also been working on part of the I-5, running between the south of Huron to Bakersfield. Along this route you'll find a mix of scenic landscapes, landmarks, and points of interest, making it a notable route for travellers. This segment of I-5 also traverses the San Joaquin Valley, which is also known for its agricultural richness and diverse scenery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/00067277a0ee247372691f054895e69668a54351.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/291de15921c3211c717d7af2c825b613989a2d0b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/897a44331804ca807c6d623f20151d86b509795a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/650784a26cecc97a7d48f3f96d1b30c4da2be090.jpg[/img]
You'll be sure to find scenic landscapes and a typical Californian climate environment when travelling on this part of the Interstate! 

[h3][b]US-99[/b][/h3]

The historic US-99, also known as the Golden State Highway, is also another route our team has been focusing on during this phase of the rework. Meandering through a diverse California landscape, the US-99 showcases the state's natural beauty. The highway will also take you past charming towns and cities, each with its unique character and landmarks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4903c338f41c2da005f87080bd70b479276207a1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/69039386d9ba73ae543b9c0d3c5f7872ce50674b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3454787bb1a72f5c7ec4b355c48a2e8a5928504e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4b5b9a0d24c562cb7dcb82b759a6e70eb73f84af.jpg[/img]
The route also offers glimpses of California's cultural and agricultural heritage, making it a delightful journey for those seeking the state's nostalgic charm.

[h3][b]Can you guess where these were taken?[/b][/h3]

The team has been kind enough to provide us with quite a few images from their progress of reworking California. So we decided it would be fun for you to guess the location of these screenshots! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/934ab8c2b7c6a9005d79cb75cda8f17a1804acac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a6c1ebbf0592fde15ea34f31c2f25447d85e63ee.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5032bfc971e0e482e3516a10fc6299fb95e9abb6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b579f5f5d256a671536b402b1bf0d51c44fcd519.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/80298015b778ae0155bce38929608233edd5beee.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/86823d95996f31fb3e3e8c0316d8ff84828e4666.jpg[/img]

Think you know? Share the answers with us in the blog comments below! We look forward to sharing more of the work taking place in this phase of our the California Rework for American Truck Simulator. Until then, keep on truckin'

notes.title: Missouri - Meet the Team
notes.content:
Not so long ago, we announced a new DLC coming to American Truck Simulator, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/]Missouri[/url] map expansion. Now seems like the right time to present the heroes working hard to deliver the DLC to our #BestCommunityEver as soon as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/676e35593bd54d9e1b640c9c04226639c4050807.jpg[/img]
We trust you'll appreciate this showcase of the SCS map designers and DLC asset lead currently involved in the Missouri DLC and their brief messages to the #BestCommunityEver.

[h3]Patrik[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/fdbc48e3aab1a8d75c580775fb53704dbd19a57a.jpg[/img]
[i]Immediately after the research was done, it was obvious that Missouri is an interesting state with many things to offer for our game. As a leader and recent visitor to Missouri, I'm keen to deliver a beautiful DLC full of foresty nature, hills, nice views, and interesting cities. We are finally near the Mississippi River which was always a big milestone for me. 

So far we are trying to come up with ideas on how to squeeze so much beauty into our scale and not omit anything important. I watch forum discussions pretty often to see what players expect and I try to find optimal solutions with others. We try our best, Missouri deserves it.[/i]

[h3]Pavel[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d4755168799bfa8d8967c4e68ceccfd3c2f5f9d3.jpg[/img]
[i]It's been three years since I started working at SCS Software as a map designer. Today, I'm facing the biggest challenge of my career. St. Louis, which is a really big city. However, I've grown to love it because I've been there in real life and I've seen everything I'm creating with my own eyes. What I enjoy most is the technical side of the work and the ability to go deep into the engine, get to its limits, and pass on the experience to new colleagues. I enjoy cities and truckstops the most because they are technically challenging tasks.[/i]

[h3]Lukáš[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ad112b995b4dddd23fe565dc161564d0ad595f38.jpg[/img]
[i]My journey in SCS Software began during the Colorado DLC, where I experimented with my first country roads and small cities. Since then, I've been a part of the Texas and Kansas map teams. I'm always seeking new challenges. Right after Amarillo, Corpus Christi, and some parts of Houston, it was Kansas City that I enjoyed the most so far. In the upcoming Missouri DLC, I'll be working on something unique in terms of custom depots which you can look forward to![/i]

[h3]Dubak[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1bf49ee9003cd3355d7646e94f6c6b80f7e76922.jpg[/img]
[i]I have been working for the company for six years and every year the work gets more interesting. I worked on the Oregon, Washington, Colorado, Texas, and Kansas DLCs where I focused more on cities and depots. In Missouri, I will be working on Springfield, where you can look forward to many interesting areas.[/i]

[h3]Jakub[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f6d789496f17cfbec4c5b9f2f3ca56fd3585d646.jpg[/img]
[i]After Kansas, the Missouri DLC is my second project as a map designer in SCS. Although now I feel much more comfortable in the process of creating an interesting environment for the player, I am still trying to challenge myself and push the boundaries of what is possible to achieve. In Missouri, I really hope that I can capture the spirit of US-36 and the city of Saint Joseph, and bring you the hidden beauty of these inconspicuous places in a way that will do them the justice they deserve.[/i]

[h3]El[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/87bb656ecb59459d9858f82defc322fd904bbee4.jpg[/img]
[i]It's been a little over 4 years since I joined SCS as a map designer back in 2019. My main responsibility for Missouri is the city of Joplin and its surrounding roads. Outside of the map, I also focus on selecting generic models that would be best for our DLC, which are later created by our amazing 3D graphics team. What I enjoy creating the most are smaller cities and settlements as they usually have very unique architecture and atmosphere.[/i]

[h3]Jakub[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2021fa817cd1b09c44505dd9dfd8ecb11d4b67fc.jpg[/img]
[i]I am very keen on working on Missouri as it is almost contrastingly different from what I worked on before. To add to that, I will have to wrestle with making a city for the first time. so I am excited to see the result of that. I still look forward to working on interstates and highways, as that is what I think I'm most skilled at.[/i]

[h3]Falda[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/101cc42aea5d82395349759f0b7b81da1fd51842.jpg[/img]
[i]I am responsible for half of the custom depots for Missouri. I made some of them for Kansas and then for Nebraska but now I am working on several depots which were not announced yet. These new depots will bring new challenges and new experiences for players. That is the part that I love most about this job because creating challenging layouts makes me think about how will players react to everything that I prepared for them.[/i]

[h3]Filip[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/95e7d11c82f881c69bcee184b5f1c426c9e241ce.jpg[/img]
[i]In Missouri, I'm looking forward to creating Cape Girardeau, an unmistakable city on the Mississippi River. I hope to translate the genius loci of the riverside town both in the more industrial areas as well as in the urban part of the city.[/i]

[h3]Seki[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4785886eecd066e15df36ef4961528bf0d9c04c7.jpg[/img]
[i]I celebrated 8 years in SCS this month. As a DLC asset lead, I have the opportunity to influence what awesome landmarks, industries, statues, murals, and other buildings will make it into the expansion. I'm responsible for the perfect condition of these 3D models like the St. Louis Gateway Arch, Jefferson Capitol, or Springfield Underground that you come across on your travels. I am most looking forward to the new opportunities that this state will allow us to bring into our game. I won't talk about specifics so I won't take the surprise away from you. Our team will do everything possible to deliver the DLC at least as good as the previous one.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1adef65a002dccf96c892687a6c2bb3beea6c8ae.jpg[/img]
We hope you've enjoyed meeting the team working on the Missouri expansion. Remember to follow us on our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]) so you won't miss out on any news coming in the future. If you are excited about Missouri, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/]add it to your Steam Wishlist[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/

notes.title: Arkansas - Cities
notes.content:
We are happy to bring you another update regarding the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2585150/American_Truck_Simulator__Arkansas/]Arkansas DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator. Get ready for a sneak peek at some of the cities you will drive through when hauling cargo in this state!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/89309f78576884bbe25644fada6dcabec36bf38a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Texarkana: A City Divided[/h3]
Texarkana stands as a city divided between Texas and Arkansas, its heart sliced by the state border. To fully explore Texarkana's unique charm, players will need both the Texas and Arkansas DLCs. Notable landmarks include banks in the Arkansas half and a captivating tire factory, providing an exclusive cross-state experience. Texarkana is known for its vibrant cultural scene, offering a blend of Texan and Arkansan influences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9d44a5ab062dc39b44ef2f8e374d60ff1b660280.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0eb3b726111a1f3ab56a4e41d9ac9c982d07f256.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/381d876d9b97260e6ba96de429ccdabc4076604c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cec874d24d31420049d5a8dbbf98c66029614445.jpg[/img]
[h3]Harrison: Quaint Charm with Hidden Gems[/h3]
Nestled in the picturesque Arkansas landscape, Harrison unfolds as a small town with an unexpectedly charming downtown. The City Hall, a historic hotel, a hospital, and a bank showcase its rich history. Venture to the outskirts to explore warehouses, where notable factories specializing in beverages and furniture are waiting to be uncovered. Harrison's welcoming community and stunning natural surroundings make it a hidden gem in the heart of Arkansas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9824ddbe361ed11c6bf665cb8e63d3521769b964.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cc186f73abff3b3fdcb65cb52eb277db8dbf87be.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/56f4c6edf5c8f3efe6710fd3cd67342e1e184657.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5fc65f74734f1b27eb31bd339b743725b43f6fc6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Jonesboro: Picturesque Downtown Landmarks[/h3]
Jonesboro, one of Arkansas' larger towns, boasts a downtown full of landmarks, including churches, a courthouse, and quaint shops. Navigate through this vibrant city and discover a large rice storage and processing facility - a key player in the local industry, promising an immersive addition to the virtual trucking experience. The city's dynamic charm and architectural gems create a picturesque backdrop for an unforgettable road trip adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/11623b4b1586133958fcf71eb80f64eecc197656.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c44585b654b166a8b89210b1f61f4176956eaca2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8393003f071d7ac6294d9aedf0c5eb31189b9838.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c76e7f9546c818baeb001c68720cfbb7f079c331.jpg[/img]
[h3]Pine Bluff: Riverside Beauty and Industrial Marvels[/h3]
Positioned near the Arkansas River, Pine Bluff offers a scenic view and a chance to explore the adjacent River Port. Landmarks such as the courthouse and Saracen Lake add a touch of history to the cityscape. Pine Bluff ensures a well-rounded experience, seamlessly blending the beauty of nature with the marvels of industrial landscapes. Known for its lively waterfront and thriving arts community, Pine Bluff promises a unique intersection of culture and commerce.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/89309f78576884bbe25644fada6dcabec36bf38a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1a9aa018f354c181f7e4fe4322a1a0dd67e0e62d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b1175fd51a697b3a26255466d8604f4eee59a2af.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aab99e347f7ffdabbd22c69fede266cdd1da402c.jpg[/img]
While the cities you see here are still in development, the anticipation is building for the unveiling of the Arkansas map expansion. Remember to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url] so you'll get all the news about the Arkansas DLC or other upcoming projects. In the meantime, we'll see you on the road!

notes.title: California Rework - Fresno & Huron
notes.content:
We're happy to share with you another look into our on-going California Rework project for American Truck Simulator. For some of our newer player base, a small part of our team has been hard at work to rework the base game state of California and bring it up to standard with our current map expansions as part of a free update. 

Today, we're happy to share with you some preview screenshots from the cities of Fresno & Huron! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/430f2d5027dd2718a19087070e61e4420c4c8a88.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Fresno[/b][/h3]

Nestled in the heart of California's Central Valley, Fresno is home to a unique blend of urban vibrancy and agricultural charm. Known as the "Raisin Capital of the World," this city boasts its title of  'the most productive farmland'. You may have even delivered to this city a few times before in American Truck Simulator. Let's take a look at some of the changes that have been made in the rework. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b2ccf985bc672ee52ddeb7444af4c7fd43ddd166.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b5ccc9ab15b182113fdf51002e217c0068723dfc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/92cc811dbdef3423fa8eca326ce9f629a16624fa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c368411a36f7bc0f8d82ed08d5d4ddc2f283b425.jpg[/img]
Much like many of the other cities in the California Rework, Fresno was completely reworked from the ground up. This means the city and road network from our current base map editor has been deleted and the team has rebuilt it from scratch. This allows the team to take advantage of techniques and tools we previously did not have, and really utilise the space to bring a more realistic layout and representation of the locale. 

Major road networks, such as the CA-99 which runs through the city along with many other connections in and around Frenso have been reworked. The team has also reworked industries in the area, and you may even find some new depots to deliver to. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/70bec76161c9df3fbbcc13f6aa16c8f625a4d2f2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b453ee7e9191a4192a4b758e054e955a69d96022.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/189a20564654809c29c97e0127f12e62d2302d2f.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Huron[/b][/h3]

Surrounded by vast expanses of farmland, Huron provides a tranquil escape from the hustle and bustle of big city life. Known for its colorful murals that tell the story of the community and its rich cultural heritage, Huron provides a glimpse into the heart of the Golden State's rural charm. 

Just like the work undertaken in Fresno, Huron has been built from the ground up, including its road networks and local industries. Nearby, you'll find a new Truckstop under the 'Vortex' brand located close to the I-5. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/34bca8b0b4d657dd7c1ce35d1f4ccf1db2fa1cd0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b860afbc60b1cc511699c2fac84717427e0db01c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/87cbb967c48f6f3e83e7a058c5a2f00b2c3ccee0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a95681521494d6009088bbbb4658202e712b7868.jpg[/img]
Like many other small towns and cities, Huron is home to a variety of Agriculture industries. In the surrounding area, farms grow soybeans, corn, and own livestock. It is also an emerging hub for the production of niche crops for specialty markets, as-well as a rapidly growing cluster of wineries. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c37334fc37f9c46b8c7cfd27d4248d75c6e52baa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/20d9a83ad76006a95ee438509b472e5951d51266.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/52746414c59077e725385bd8565530b4dbb1860a.jpg[/img]
Rest assured, the team is working hard on this project & we look forward to sharing more previews from this upcoming phase of the California Rework. If you missed out on any of the previous blogposts on this topic, be sure to take a read back here. Until next time, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: Christmas Winterland Event 2023
notes.content:
There is a story, I’ve been told,
About a place that’s very old,
A place that only few have seen,
A place where you have never been.

And in this land, I’ll have you know,
It seems to always ever snow.
There must be something in the air,
A kind of magic everywhere.

There’s fun and laughter to be had,
And no one there is ever sad,
Especially with the time at hand!
Behold, it’s Christmas Winterland!

With finest arts and crafts to make,
And choccy goodies all to bake,
With mountain ranges all around
And festive markets to be found.

It’s to this land that we must haul,
And bring supplies for one and all.
And don’t forget the Northstar post,
Where Christmas cards are sent the most.

So, how on earth do you get there?
Well, not by land and not by air.
Instead you need to give a hand
And load supplies to Winterland.

Then once you’re ready for the ride
And offering your help with pride,
A snowy portal will appear.
Just look around, you’ll find it near.

Then drive to it, and don’t delay
Now park inside, then on your way!
Once you arrive, explore, have fun.
It’s Winterland for everyone.

But wait, no wait, I tell you more,
And for this task I do implore,
That this is only half of it
And now here comes the greatest bit.

That to this land you’ll venture forth,
Yes to this land, it’s in the north,
But back you’ll go with gift packs bound
For all the homeland cities found.

Ah, found you say, but found oh where?
Well, through the portal if you dare,
With cargo destination known,
Else leave it to the portal’s own.

Then once you’re back, with gift packs done,
You’ll help to spread more snowy fun!
But not just fun, a legend grand,
Of magic Christmas Winterland!

So, haul for one and one for haul
And Very Merry Christmas All!

It’s that special time of year again, but this time we’ve sprinkled a little magic around and we are delighted to offer to you something that has never been seen before, something unprecedented, and we’ve been working on it for a very long time. To our #BestCommunityEver, we give you our Christmas Winterland event for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2e741538b350d15f21c03e789256960be2252248.jpg[/img]
Join us to explore the fun and festivities of Christmas like never before as you embark on a magical journey to Christmas Winterland and deliver supplies and gift packs across the world! For this event, we challenge the community to get 200 Snowflakes awarded to cities across all trucking territories for each of the five tiers. As tier rewards, players will receive specially crafted cabin items, each representing one of the five festive depots within Winterland!

[previewyoutube=JwwaIdIiWfY;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/fd0ef0e742bfc4a7a2fa60720884ef31632343be.jpg[/img]
You’ll be able to track the community progress on [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] or directly in the game using the updated External Contracts interface.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/60bd5bd4b33ad1cb05e3c1079ce9a87b3288b86d.png[/img]
We’ve also created a special #ChristmasWinterland event Desktop Background Theme this year, and we like to think it sends a clear message for how to find some fun this Christmas, follow the sign post, we hope you enjoy it! It will be there for the duration of the event to raise event awareness and share the Christmas spirit for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/940b8af892c27d15caaadc2508f535900f45b13e.jpg[/img]
Also, pencil in the 19th of December, from 18:00 CET, for our annual Christmas Stream featuring Pavel Šebor! There will be some giveaways, and plenty of interesting updates as usual, there might even be some teasers for new stuff, but for sure there will be loads of fun with a touch of SCS magic! The stream will take place on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url] channel, so don't miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4b5a1dda27064646762ff6b05194af17becff566.jpg[/img]
[h3]Christmas Winterland Event Rules:[/h3]

Using External Contracts with a [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url]-connected profile in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both, the community is to deliver supplies and gift packs to and from Christmas Winterland using as many cities as possible.

There are 5 different depots in Winterland for all deliveries, to and from, they are:

[olist]
[*] Christmas Market...a town square market
[*] Marigold's...a chocolate factory
[*] Northstar...a post office
[*] Rudolph's Crafts...an arts workshop
[*] Snowy Peaks...a mountain resort market
[/olist]
Your personal goal is to complete 15 deliveries for them including at least 1 delivery to or from each depot, using Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both games combined.

Snowflakes are gained for those cities that have delivered to or received from Winterland. For a city to receive 1 Snowflake, the community needs to complete 1000 deliveries between it and Winterland. Each city can receive up to 5 Snowflakes!

The community goal is to reach at least 1000 Snowflakes for cities across all trucking territories. A unique community reward will be unlocked for each tier of 200 Snowflakes accomplished, with 5 tiers in total.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Personal: Your contribution of  15 or more deliveries to or from the 5 Christmas Winterland depots will gain you:
[list]
[*] A special World of Trucks Achievement.
[*] A stunningly beautiful, Winterland truck paint job
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/97d5872241ad88b9ece063e0d43a2baee74a357b.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Community: There will be 5 tiers to unlock. Each tier will bring a special cabin item reward for both games, based on the 5 amazing depots within Christmas Winterland, so let's haul!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c1019fb9b6fdd512a439cb69a764d3cb406bbd8c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2f8e1b6d6fa96aba8c97470c4da777b9481f4a42.jpg[/img]
[h3]Christmas Winterland directions[/h3]

Access to Winterland is available using a portal, which materialises after you've accepted any event cargo. Find it on the map and navigate to it. Look for the sparkles!

When leaving Winterland through a portal, you can either deliver a cargo to it's destination, or travel to a random city for a new job to Winterland.

Note: In order to qualify for any community reward, you must complete at least your personal goal in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both. Each reward will be a Steam inventory item for both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator. Once completed, claim your reward in the Events page on your World of Trucks profile.

[b]The event will be concluded on Sunday, the 14th of January at 23:59 UTC.[/b]

As always, we look forward to hearing about your Christmas Winterland adventure this year, and we’d sure love to see more photos from you while you are achieving your goals and receiving your well-earned rewards this special season of giving. Share your screenshots and videos with us using the hashtag #ChristmasWinterland on our Facebook [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]ATS[/url] / [url=https://www.facebook.com/eurotrucksimulator2/]ETS2[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url] profiles and we will share our favourite ones.

notes.title: Kansas DLC Release
notes.content:
Get ready to rev up your engines and start an exciting journey as the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/]Kansas DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator is releasing today. Explore breathtaking landscapes and vibrant cities in this latest expansion!

[i]Kansas DLC for American Truck Simulator is released![/i]

[previewyoutube=vZmrDhyWPVM;full][/previewyoutube]
Start a big adventure with the Kansas map expansion. Take your time and enjoy every moment as you discover these features:
[list]
[*] Deliver to 14 explorable cities including Kansas City, Wichita, or Topeka
[*] See several landmarks unique to Kansas such as the historic Dodge City, Monument Rocks, and Mount Sunflower
[*] Become a trucker transporting goods for Kansas' key industries - Salt Mine, Food Factory, Car Factory, Building Material Factory, and Battery Factory
[*] Deliver cargo to Aerosystem, playing a key role in Wichita's aerospace industry
[*] Visit Hutchinson and admire the world's largest silos
[*] Play a crucial role in one of America's largest agricultural states. Transport goods that sustain Kansas' farming legacy
[*] Enjoy trucking through several scenic towns (settlements)
[*] Drive through expansive prairies, providing unforgettable views
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/487a20b4aec52ee7b503f33bba4762e2b6592403.jpg[/img]
Transforming from its agricultural origins, Kansas has developed into a bustling industrial center, enticing major enterprises with its strategic placement and well-organized logistics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8865d2682b9fab4fb96421e8f3f439977e385cf0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0dd6118d68ccc69d4b86720a41377ed51ae17b9e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4624668c6c10f6a951d6144d36cc65797b360486.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d3acad9c3a757def678eef6d4a724452c17297d0.jpg[/img]
Truckers can contribute to and experience a range of industries, spanning from the flourishing aviation domain, and agricultural depots to automobile manufacturing, the famed salt mine, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0c175277497ee55aac6a7f4cb5fffde8bf0af174.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0b0cae1e27b96c69dedab76e98eac33f047a5b93.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c4cbc607e1161ef863b49161da889ce2d5ea058e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/981c9e5c297fa4937c051cee5727a11447679599.jpg[/img]
The Kansas DLC is also a part of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33975/Great_Plains_Calling_Bundle/]The Great Plains Calling![/url] bundle on Steam. It's a convenient way to fill in the gaps in your DLC collection for American Truck Simulator. Dive into the diverse landscapes of Montana, Colorado, Wyoming, Texas, Oklahoma, New Mexico, and now Kansas - all part of the package we've crafted. 

This bundle operates on a "Complete the set" basis, ensuring you only pay for the DLCs that are not already in your library!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f4d0a0b2fbbc1bdc64ca95c71a365fbf5bc19d6f.jpg[/img]
[h3]Cruising Kansas Event[/h3]
Starting with the release, there will be a special #CruisingKansas World of Trucks event, where you can earn unique rewards. We are asking our #BestCommunityEver to achieve the community goal of driving 125,000,000 miles (201,168,000 km) while delivering cargo to or from any city in Kansas. You can read more about this event in the [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/11/cruising-kansas-world-of-trucks-event.html.html]dedicated blog post[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/51e0403fb00b2aa2bf0b0d23efcd21bad01a2776.jpg[/img]
We also have a unique gift for you. If you take any External Contract or External Market job TO or FROM the city of Topeka, you'll earn the Tiger Salamander Plush, which can be used as a cabin accessory. Kansas is the home to salamanders so you should definitely consider inviting one to ride along with you during long journeys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8dfc7553afb5b2cbad0eef809cded7a7a1eee9d1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Farm Machinery DLC[/h3]
Along with the Kansas DLC, we are also releasing the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/]Farm Machinery DLC[/url]. This DLC presents a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in the agricultural landscape, especially in the newly added Kansas, where agriculture takes center stage. Haul everything from tractors to spreaders with two in-game brands Owl & Greenler and don't forget to decorate your cabin with special accessories. Read more about this DLC in the [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/11/american-truck-simulator-farm-machinery.html]dedicated blog post[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4d7c9d83697cde35e526743af76192c9343e7a3f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/41803198049efbe7120d99e00035399d38a60d8e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/83e21700ed27ce3b00c3657e671375dba3ae15e0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/88c7169ce55d4e0fd959122b51b251978e62f230.jpg[/img]
[h3]Special Transport DLC Update[/h3]
With the Kansas expansion, you'll be able to haul special cargo on 6 new routes, of which 4 are located within the state, but two of them will be a bit more special, as they start in Pueblo (CO) and lead to either Marysville (707 miles) or Dodge City (313 miles). You will also be able to transport the newly added 39-meter-long (over 129 feet) wind turbine blade and a massive articulated hauler. Find out more about the update [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/11/big-in-kansas-turnpike-tolls.html]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3564a7dfe8e6ae8b71d6bebe1faf13f49c46716e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/54a910983fa5ef44c5b04c7ea9bc28a400b485f1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/edca9ddc034c0c765ea6d8771d5423042ad3b8e0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/dc89d19277b87bb7b5f2e8f0f0f9d5a36a06ed32.jpg[/img]
[h3]Release Live Stream[/h3]
Catch our special reveal stream on our official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware/]Youtube[/url] channel at 4:00 PM CET. Get a sneak peek of what's coming up in Kansas, along with exclusive insights and chats with the developers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4dbe6f1fd360d2c1f9d537aa31d65f0158253cbb.jpg[/img]
We are excited to have you hit the roads of Kansas! Share your initial adventures with us by using #CruisingKansas. Stay tuned for more updates by following our social media channels ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]). And don't forget, the Sunflower State has surprises beyond the surface - your next fantastic journey might be just around the corner. See you on the road!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/
