notes.title: Cruising Kansas World of Trucks Event
notes.content:
Celebrate the release of our new Kansas DLC on Thursday, the [b]30th of November[/b], by taking part in our [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] event - Cruising Kansas! Discover and explore the diverse landscapes of the Sunflower State, where distinct ecological regions of beauty await, all while you're on the job. Kansas offers incredibly beautiful nature, native grasslands, winding streams and seemingly endless blue skies, all entwined with a rich history.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f1f6e7338419ddad663999153792510d864b0a3b.jpg[/img]

We are asking our #BestCommunityEver to achieve the community goal of driving 125,000,000 miles (201,168,000 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Kansas.

While [b]#CruisingKansas[/b], you'll enjoy state parks and expansive prairies, providing unforgettable views. Kansas is also the home to wildlife such as deer, coyotes, raccoons, salamanders, and the iconic American bison, not to mention a multitude of birds, such as the Western Meadowlark, making pit stops during the trip south.

Emerging from its agricultural roots, Kansas has evolved into a vibrant industrial hub, attracting large businesses with its central location and efficient logistics infrastructure. Truckers can support and enjoy various industries, from the thriving aviation sector to car factories or the renowned salt mine and beyond.

During your travels through Kansas, you can look forward to many spectacular views and highlights such as:

[list]
[*] Dodge City, known for its history as a frontier town of the Wild West
[*] Monument Rocks, landmark of ancient chalk formations
[*] Kansas City, largest metropolitan area in Kansas
[*] Mount Sunflower, highest natural point in Kansas
[/list]
[previewyoutube=QUTdQrIwg3w;full][/previewyoutube]
As with past cruising events, you can use your own trailer and experience all these in the external market!

Kansas DLC is offering 14 amazing new cities to explore, and we have a special reward for completing your personal goal, which will require you to deliver a job to or from all of them. All jobs for the event need to be 100 miles each (161 km) or more.

Get ready for a fabulous trip with our latest addition to American Truck Simulator. Enjoy stunning views, beautiful landscapes and ecological regions while contributing to the state's thriving economy along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/487a20b4aec52ee7b503f33bba4762e2b6592403.jpg[/img]
[h3]Rules[/h3]

Using External Contracts or External Market, with a World of Trucks-connected profile in American Truck Simulator, the community goal is to drive 125,000,000 miles (201,168,000 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Kansas.

When a player completes a delivery to or from 14 different Kansas cities, they will achieve their personal goal.

All jobs for the event need to be at least 100 miles each (161 km), or more.

You can check if your recent deliveries met these conditions using your [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/jobs]Log Book[/url] in your World of Trucks profile.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]

Personal: Players that deliver cargo to or from 14 Kansas cities will gain a personal World of Trucks Achievement and a Sunflower themed ATS truck paint job Steam inventory item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d0a010540a9f05073b4abf54d7582e9e5e9abbde.jpg[/img]
Community: When the community goal of driving 125,000,000 miles (201,168,000 km) during deliveries to or from any city in Kansas is met, and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive an Amber Sunflower hanging ornament Steam inventory item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/483aaa74e4ad407c6a23dfa0b4932bf60f53497f.jpg[/img]
[b]The event will be concluded on Sunday, the 28th of January at 23:59 UTC.[/b]

We wait with great anticipation to hear back from you about your travels, with loads of deliveries and sights to see. We truly believe you'll love cruising the beautiful Sunflower State and we look forward to seeing all your photos! So, please share your screenshots and videos with us using the hashtag #CruisingKansas on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url] profiles and we will share our favorite ones (we may even feature some of them in a future blog post!).

notes.title: Big in Kansas + Turnpike Tolls
notes.content:
With the arrival of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=BigIn_Kansas&_Tolls]Kansas DLC for American Truck Simulator[/url] on November 30th, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=BigIn_Kansas&_Tolls__Special_Transport/]Special Transport DLC[/url] will be receiving an update that includes some new routes, missions and the addition of a new feature. Plus, we would also like to share with you a preview of the tolls which you'll encounter this new state, along with a new payment system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/dc89d19277b87bb7b5f2e8f0f0f9d5a36a06ed32.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]BIG In Kansas![/b][/h3]
With the Kansas expansion, you'll be able to answer the call of Special Transport missions on 6 new routes, of which 4 are located within the state, but two of them will be a bit more special, as they start in Pueblo (CO) and leads to either Marysville (707 miles) or Dodge City (313 miles). These range from delivering helicopters to airports, to delivering special cargo to the salt mines, as well as hauling new cargoes such as Wind Turbine Blades that need to be transported from Colorado to Kansas! 

The other 4 routes will take you from: 
[list]
[*] Colby to Hutchinson 
[*] Topeka to Pittsburg
[*] Dodge City to Emporia 
[*] Wichita to Salina [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/045b27a0195017028d100ad9c946890b5eb6075e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/edca9ddc034c0c765ea6d8771d5423042ad3b8e0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e4e1b6fbc57a8ae8f8c4d28a9cda304988878786.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f681ca4051e3b861bf274974cf6685076a3ab33b.jpg[/img]
As you browse the job market, you may notice that some of these new contracts require a lot of travelling, even going as far as travelling to another state! This is why we have introduced the ability to take a rest stop and even refill your fuel tanks during longer routes on a Special Transport contract. It ain't easy work moving around these oversized loads, so make sure to take a break when you can!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/22932f6b73e948a6192f12e0eec10be56be43eb6.jpg[/img]
We look forward to seeing how you get on with the new routes and oversized loads!

[b][h3]Turnpike Tolls in Kansas[/h3][/b]
If you've been trucking in some of our recent expansions, you'll be no stranger to Turnpike Tolls. As an important source of highway funding in many states in the US, these tolls benefit the local economy, support road maintenance and cleanliness of the stretch of the road. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7c46ee3e4e0773191cfc74a7194d014e932176a8.jpg[/img]
However, in Kansas, these will differ a little payment wise from other pre-existing tolls in American Truck Simulator. Rather than a set priced fee, you will now only be charged for the distance you've travelled along the toll road. This means if you only travel a short distance before exiting, you'll be charged a smaller amount versus a driver who travels the entire length of the road. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0c5889456a54d4fba186034c33cacf099b096b20.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8eb833c958bb15b36e0e70a8d96fed6f93878c96.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/50a7b035fe6364e46f40d2087018a7257e091cda.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a44475527ef3f1b8d22e2117eb020c804602b0e3.jpg[/img]
So if you happen to be counting dollars and pennies (like on our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PNM6665BVus&list=PLWJ0dZA1RNUBWTdoDVPcl7TScBrqPtHH9]Twitch Let's Play! Series[/url]), You can always check the set route to see if you can't save yourself a little extra cash on your journey by making a detour onto another route.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/858dc048e1fe69c9ed39169fae3063f654b4cdae.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/85243958b749b9aecbb4e1c4a18f29a8dbe50ade.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d04a397e2e85f7e42b13dc4d2c9cde1761a3fe71.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a88438d96c88bbf60f1b4499f31ce77aadd319e9.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy this small, but practical change coming to our upcoming map expansion. If you cannot wait to get trucking, then be sure to add the Kansas DLC to your Steam Wishlist! We appreciate all your support and we look forward to welcoming you across the State border very soon. Until next time, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.49 Update Release
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the 1.49 update for American Truck Simulator has been released and is now available on Steam. This update contains bug fixes, changes and new content, which are featured below, so we recommend having a read! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1718e7d5eec0e034664d946d84d6ea570e6cbcb0.jpg[/img]

We'd like to take this opportunity to thank everyone who participated, provided their feedback, and made bug reports during the Open Beta period. Your valuable input helped us make tweaks, changes and squash some bugs that we may have missed the first time around. We hope you can now begin to fully enjoy the fruits of your work.

[previewyoutube=i_1Bl_q7YbA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][h3]HDR Skyboxes, Moon and New Weather Effects[/h3][/b]
First and foremost, after many requests, we've added the Moon (back) to our night sky! It's a subtle but remarkable touch that adds an extra layer of realism and wonder to your virtual trucking adventures. Curiously, it's worth mentioning that what might appear as a simple addition – the Moon – has posed some significant challenges for some time. Integrating the Moon into the night sky has required casting, rendering and calculating lunar light, proper phases, managing reflections in water bodies, dealing with wet roads, and addressing mirror effects, among other things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/897e6e8a2a53fb7fa94314f1d0eec1d3d0469bfc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3a09570d8c979c1d5ac8b08d139b8b12c8026cca.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e2f29dc7e58348ab47d59410b9390f4e8260dbb5.jpg[/img]
In addition to that, we've also reimagined the night sky, introducing dynamic stars that gently twinkle, enhancing the overall authenticity of the night-time experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2fff67f32ffe2ae95bc2fa965a46939be33f55ea.jpg[/img]
We are also happy to share that skyboxes will now be in High Dynamic Range (HDR), which means that there will be richer, more vibrant colors in the skies and our weather visual effects have also received an upgrade. Thunderstorms now include visible lightning, offering a more immersive experience. And make sure to keep an eye on the night sky in certain regions, you might be pleasantly surprised by what you will notice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/dcce39391a71b836cef53a4e81f0e29ef41e37ee.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1ac3f8c584ba5f1a89f924a5296a15e96af01fb9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2d639e3633679f60612388e44c5a9197407dad77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c1412bfd5dfda46d5df0eb21b90ac9019644742b.jpg[/img]
To sum it all up, we’ve also prepared a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A5QxMstGYzk&]special video[/url] for you showcasing all of these changes. It’s definitely worth checking it out along with the [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/10/149-update-hdr-skyboxes-moon-and-new.html]dedicated blog post[/url] we published previously!

[b][h3]PACCAR Technical Center [/h3][/b]
Hidden within the vast landscape of Washington, a realistic recreation of the PACCAR Technical Center awaits your discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cd906143393a7e858884a1dfb35533a35b3c24ca.jpg[/img]
Drivers will now have the opportunity to experience the PACCAR Technical Center firsthand. This realistic 1:1 recreation will offer a glimpse into the world of truck development. For years, the PACCAR Technical Center has been the epicenter of innovation and development for renowned truck manufacturers, Kenworth and Peterbilt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4b67bcfa5379436b6e9cef5a121ce44cdffb9892.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3d00efec27597f01d56035527450239384ea89a7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/870cdb491f903e54d334a5fa6623bb1970813433.jpg[/img]
This facility has been instrumental in testing trucks, powertrains, technologies, and more, and it's where the giants of the trucking industry push the boundaries of what's possible, creating the next generation of iconic trucks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/beff18896cd491da4580bd69282308c9ff149313.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0ced0f211fb4bd99e33dd37b00e06f9cfcf0f076.jpg[/img]
Even though the area won't be readily visible on the in-game map and UI, it will be waiting for curious players to discover with plenty of interesting bits to explore. We’ve also added an extra layer of excitement, a small Easter egg will be parked within the PACCAR Technical Center itself. We challenge you to keep your eyes peeled and see if you can spot this surprise. 

We hope you enjoy checking out this new and unique addition in American Truck Simulator!

[b][h3]Used Truck Dealers[/h3][/b]
We're also happy to introduce another highly requested feature. Used Trucks will be now available immediately in the main menu taking you to a selection of trucks that are more budget-friendly compared to brand new vehicles. However, these used trucks come with some mileage and wear, which is indicated by their star rating and a separate window that provides a detailed breakdown of the damage to various parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9b901a7c07d8bb8d64f734805fed291735fc1bfb.jpg[/img]
One of the most significant changes coming along with this feature is the enhanced damage and repair system. In the past, our approach was very simplistic - individual parts would accumulate damage, represented as a percentage, and you could repair them, resetting the percentage to zero. However, with the 1.49 update, parts will accumulate three types of damage

[list]
[*] Damage: This type of damage can be fixed by standard repairs, just as before.
[*] Parts Wear: When components accumulate significant wear and tear, you'll want to replace them.
[*] Permanent Wear: The permanent wear represents systemic aging and wear across the whole vehicle. It can only be nullified by Total Restoration of the entire vehicle. This is a more expensive procedure, but it's the only way to bring your truck and trailer back to pristine condition. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e813164b2bf1010f83b791d1e64996c29197e386.jpg[/img]
With the improved damage system comes enhanced control over vehicle maintenance. You can now make informed choices about which parts to repair or replace based on your judgment. Alternatively, you have the option to seek professional advice for the best repair strategy for your truck or trailer.

Happy (used) trucking! 

[b][h3]Mountains Rework - Utah DLC[/h3][/b]
Four years ago, the Utah DLC was released for American Truck Simulator. Back then, we were still learning a lot about our tools and techniques, especially when it came to the creation of mountains. Today, we are pleased to be at a level where we have improved on creating mountains in-game, especially when it comes to scale and details. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/496184a24eb53c4bac57b143e4f70dcabd05a415.jpg[/img]
Today, we're happy to release with the 1.49 update a small rework of a number of mountains located in Salt Lake City, Utah. We'd like to thank those from our community who passed on their feedback in regards to the representation of the mountains found in this beautiful state. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/92805d9521b201f2c64f366eebe8b91eefb507b1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fbcdc232bcc76a1d04d808be52ab7ac8c7b49155.jpg[/img]
You'll find that in most cases, the mountains have been reworked entirely from scratch, replacing the older models that once stood there. We really hope that you see a difference from this rework! We hope to continue to rework certain aspects of our DLCs as our tools and options continue to develop over time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4158654cf0c7b52129c42c88843289d2f61669d0.jpg[/img]
Be sure to share with us your trucking adventures through Utah in 1.49 on our social media channels, we'd love to see them!

[b][h3]Keybind Modifiers [/h3][/b]
Another highly requested feature coming with 1.49 is the introduction of Keybind Modifiers! When previously creating a new bind in the menu, you could only assign a single key for an action. With the 1.49 update, you will now have the option to use a combination of the key and modifiers to bind an action. For example, you can now assign Shift + L to turn your lights if you so wish! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/88027cd9c163628c4777af41218bab488e422d88.jpg[/img]
This opens up a whole new world of key bind combinations for you to use, allowing for more binding options, but that's not all! You will also now have the options to bind short press and long press key. Holding the key down will be recognised as a long press, and pressing a button as normal will be seen as a short press. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2b00d5809e42f0dbae8d5eccb20a40f98b969cd2.jpg[/img]
Keyboards aren't the only peripherals taking advantage of this change. Controllers will also be able use this new feature!

[b][h3]Special Transport DLC Update[/h3][/b]
With the arrival of the Kansas DLC for American Truck Simulator on November 30th, we have taken the opportunity to bring an exciting update to the Special Transport DLC. Today we are happy to announce the arrival of 2 new oversized cargoes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3564a7dfe8e6ae8b71d6bebe1faf13f49c46716e.jpg[/img]
Introducing the new Wind Blade & Articulated Hauler cargoes, as part of the 1.49 update! Think you got what it takes to haul these new oversized loads? You can find these new cargo routes across some of the already existing routes in various DLCs and base game. We've also introduced two completely new routes, both which start from Pueblo in Colorado, where wind blades are often found being transported in the real world! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ec0dbc0a426f55cb4385f2be540d37c679874e1d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/752905584236cbcb3034d4fc9c8054474cf721c6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/54a910983fa5ef44c5b04c7ea9bc28a400b485f1.jpg[/img]
However, that's not all! The Kansas DLC will also receive several new routes of its own when it is released. You can read more about these routes, plus the addition of a new Special Transport feature for long haul routes at our recent blog post. Check it out here!

[b][h3]Automatic Headlights[/h3][/b]
Another new feature which we are happy to introduce to this update is the option of Automatic Headlights. It is a relatively straightforward feature, that turns on your headlights when the ambient light around the truck falls bellow a certain threshold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7d814b7440ed3cc2b7278aa7e4231e657cf6c544.jpg[/img]
If the option is toggled, your light switch position for parking lights is replaced by automatic lights, so you can still turn your lights off or force your headlights on with the other switch positions.

We have also introduced the addition of Automatic High Beams. This feature will temporally disable your high beams when there is a vehicle in front of you (both in your lane or oncoming) and turns them back on when the vehicle is far enough away.

These automatic high beams are enabled if you flip the high beam switch and when either your automatic headlights are turned on, or you turned your headlights on manually (in case of automatic headlights option toggled off, high beams only work when headlights are manually enabled). We hope you enjoy this simple, yet useful feature for when you are travelling on the road!

[b][h3]Changelog [/h3][/b]
[b]Map[/b]
[list]
[*] PACCAR Technical Centre added to Washington State
[*] Mountains reworked around Salt Lake City (Utah DLC)
[/list]
[b]Visual[/b]

[/list]
[b]Vehicle[/b]
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator 1.49: Special Transport DLC Update
notes.content:
Today, we are excited to reveal two brand-new cargos for the Special Transport DLC. With the upcoming 1.49 update, you will be able to haul a 39-meter-long (over 129 feet) wind turbine blade and a massive articulated hauler in American Truck Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f4dc8d5afcfbe3246c0823f6fddc65261f5229b0.jpg[/img]

You'll also be able to find these two new cargoes on selected Special Transport routes that are already featured in the game, leading through either some of the previously released map expansions, but also located in some of the states that came out with the initial release of ATS.

[b]This DLC update includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Wind turbine cargo
[*] Articulated hauler cargo
[*] New route from Pueblo to Trinidad (near Pueblo)
[*] New route from Pueblo to Limon (near Denver)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/82b3d2262340d90bd699d1e9b1fc6a32a21c187a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c51a39549684f2ad68053d063c66f97c33197154.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d7953e4ea581fe8128b94bba6078610402032ea8.jpg[/img]
Taking the wheel of a truck carrying massive cargo is no easy task. Maneuvering a truck with oversized cargo requires a skillful dance, a fine-tuned balance between power and precision. Only the most skilled truckers can tackle these distinctive missions. Do you think you've got what it takes?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/263a131a3c5b3ec51640741c41ee06617f9e1ae9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6ca6902e89bca21f99035a88b06ab7663a174a30.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Arkansas - Meet The Team
notes.content:
We've been tackling the demanding Arkansas DLC for some time now. Despite the necessary hard work and commitment, we haven't had a chance to give a shout-out to the often-overlooked heroes within our dedicated team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c9c3782bd3f67290452e4239779605c89ee01825.jpg[/img]
We hope you will enjoy this presentation of the SCS map designers who are currently working on the Arkansas DLC and their short messages to the #BestCommunityEver.

[h3]David[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0eed8d994aeb11b65e29ec1dec17fdf23aad10f7.jpg[/img]
[i]I have been working at SCS for seven years now, and during that time, I have progressed from testing to map design to a leadership position as the Map DLC Lead for American Truck Simulator. In this role, my responsibility is to lead the project from start to finish, which primarily involves managing the rest of my team, closely cooperating with other departments, and staying in touch with marketing. Among my previously released projects are Wyoming, Montana, and Oklahoma.

Our goal for Arkansas is to portray it exactly as it is—full of smaller picturesque towns, beautiful nature, and interesting businesses. We're striving to create another enjoyable DLC that people will want to add to their collection of ATS.[/i]

[h3]Joanna[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2dcf7b5b799a33037519310a9aa7dce45f746919.jpg[/img]
[i]It's been almost 3.5 years since I've joined the SCS team. My first big task was to create the Yellowstone Park in the Wyoming DLC. It was quite a challenge but also an exciting mission for a newbie. While working on this task, I realized that creating landscapes and nature is the most enjoyable part of my job. In Arkansas, I work on the small, spa town of Hot Springs and its beautiful surroundings. I hope you will like it![/i]

[h3]Vojta[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b9b7c2f98d3d122da1fbb5ee00fb6981388ef3cc.jpg[/img]
[i]I joined SCS in 2019 and started working on Colorado DLC where I learned all the basics of the editor. Since then I've been working on many projects like the rework of California, Wyoming, a little bit of Texas, Montana, Oklahoma and now Arkansas where I'm responsible for Little Rock and most of the I-40 that goes across the state. What I've enjoyed the most is the variety of tasks that I get from rural roads, and truck stops to large cities.[/i]

[h3]Vopi[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a4ed744b14d319cff597d4da567cfca723163581.jpg[/img]
[i]It's already been five years since I joined SCS back in 2018. Nowadays I work as a Senior Map Designer and during my time here I was able to get my hands on DLCs like Washington, Colorado, Wyoming, Montana and Oklahoma, where I usually focused on some mountainous areas and roads and on nature in general. I am excited about Arkansas because I like the lush and foresty feel it has. Of course, it is not the PNW, but in some ways, it reminds me of working on Washington. Among other things, I am responsible for the North-West Arkansas region around Fayetteville and I hope we can deliver some of its unique features so players can enjoy them.[/i]

[h3]Jakub[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ab797bee7aa32d8344ee0caea2a295a03bd28950.jpg[/img]
[i]It's been a long day at work or school. You are tired; you have had enough. All you want to do for the rest of your day is chill. And so you go trucking. As a fellow gamer, I get it. That's why I am always trying to follow this rule: no matter how pretty and accurate your game is, if it's not fun to play, people will not play it. It will soon be 3 years since I started working at SCS as a map designer on DLC Montana, then worked on Oklahoma, and now I'm doing my best to make sure you have fun trucking in Arkansas. My favorite parts of the map to design are small settlements because they have that American country vibe that I like.[/i]

[h3]Vladimír[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5715b9deb8c1c11247d3f6426449d904d4d50c93.jpg[/img]
[i]This is my seventh year working at SCS as a Map designer. I started with a road connecting California and Nevada through the Death Valley. Then I worked on smaller towns and neighbourhoods, mostly on the coast of California and Oregon (Redwood-Sequoia), Utah (Vernal), Idaho (Salmon), Wyoming (Jackson), Montana (Wolfpoint-Sidney-Glendive), Oklahoma (Idabel-Broken Bow-Hugo) and now I'm working on a road from De Queen to Texarkana in Arkansas. I enjoy working with the details of industrial areas and smaller towns the most.[/i]

[h3]Adam[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9e7409d76029952346ca00fa628c9cb580c6cbc2.jpg[/img]
[i]I joined SCS at the beginning of 2022 as a junior map designer without any previous game development-related professional work experience. I joined in the later production stage of Montana, where I made some interstates and settlements. Then I worked on some parts of cities in Texas and after that on Oklahoma right in the beginning so I had the opportunity to have creative freedom. These days I work on Arkansas which is by far my favorite project. Parts of the map I work on inspire me and I feel blessed to work specifically on this DLC.[/i]

[h3]Jáno[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f1a6d2e1826c78cc1dc19aecb4a959967d6b6e74.jpg[/img]
[i]It's been nearly three years since I started working as a map designer at SCS. In the beginning, I worked on Sacramento city for the California Rework project. Later, I joined Davido's team and started to design small abandoned settlements, wide-open plains, and stunning landscapes, which I really enjoyed working on. You can find some of them in the Texas, Montana, or Oklahoma DLCs. Currently, I am focusing on the eastern region of Arkansas, and I really hope the new DLC will be fun and exciting to play.[/i]

[h3]Zuzu[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/411a27c805701f1aa03f4fdd3cf04b39a6d6b049.jpg[/img]
[i]It has been almost 4 years since I joined SCS as a junior map designer. I started with small roads in Idaho and soon discovered that my interest lies in the more technical aspects of mapping. Now, as part of the Arkansas team, I am responsible for road layouts, such as complex junctions and truck stops. In Arkansas, what I am aiming for is creating viewpoints in beautiful sceneries, crafted by my colleagues.[/i]

[h3]Lukáš[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/513c31b081e8628a8bb3dd87a278247d18a5d7bf.jpg[/img]
[i]I have been working at SCS Software for almost three years now, and every one of them has been entirely stellar. Since then, I have worked on Montana, Oklahoma, and now, of course, the Arkansas DLC, but also a few bits of the California rework and Texas. Regarding Arkansas, I am working on a few settlements and an unnamed city that might or might not contain some gold. But what I really love about Arkansas is the countryside. My absolute favorite places are the swamps, bogs, and overgrown little forest rivers. I always try to capture their true soul. I only wish Arkansas was a bit bigger, so we might be able to weave a few more such places in.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/668e82c4a757e2143fba0a1602cdbb04dc230eba.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ebb50367e68ccba6ee68f06d07c3cdf4944ce027.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/55acad09e757428c65f6e7fc3614fdaefd49b74f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/97ceda99d356ed099a05557340958dc313517e91.jpg[/img]
We hope you've appreciated this brief departure from our typical map-focused blog content. The team is putting in their utmost effort to deliver an exceptional experience, and we're eagerly anticipating revealing more of their ongoing projects in the future. Meanwhile, stay tuned to the blog or follow us on social media platforms ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]) for any upcoming updates.

notes.content:
Get ready for an exciting drive in the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/]Kansas DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator, featuring three standout cities at the core of the Sunflower State. We are happy to bring you some more information about Topeka, Wichita, and Kansas City which are some of the most important settlements in Kansas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8865d2682b9fab4fb96421e8f3f439977e385cf0.jpg[/img]
[h3]Wichita[/h3]
Wichita takes the spotlight, a lively city where your trucking adventure comes to life. Explore the action at Aerosystem, a key player in airplane manufacturing. Enjoy the beautiful view of downtown Wichita, catching sight of landmarks like the Intrust Bank Arena, The Epic Center, or 250 Douglas Place. Deliver cargo to two busy industrial zones, the Eisenhower airport, a personal jet service, and roll along the unique channel cutting through the highway. Wichita's mix of industry and city vibes promises a memorable journey.

Get ready for a unique trucking adventure in Kansas City, which is split between Kansas and Missouri. Truckers will cruise through the Kansas side, catching a glimpse of Missouri's downtown. The economic spotlight shines on the new Caliber Motors car factory, alongside a bustling scene with a custom grain elevator, trailer service, and a general warehouse. Reflecting its historical railroad significance, Kansas City features rail-related depots, including the rail supply depot and railroad construction depot. notes.title: American Truck Simulator - 1.49 Open Beta
notes.content:
Today, we are happy to share with you that the 1.49 Open Beta branch for American Truck Simulator is now available to try and test out. If you plan on participating in this Open Beta, we ask that you please help us by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=313]appropriate section(s) of our official forums.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/00dec11fbf4ba2aadad80a8625c42701cb4b2ac1.jpg[/img]

Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable to our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out. So, without further ado, let's take a look at what the 1.49 Open Beta has in store.

[b][h3]HDR Skyboxes, Moon and New Weather Effects[/h3][/b]
First and foremost, after many requests, we've added the Moon (back) to our night sky! It's a subtle but remarkable touch that adds an extra layer of realism and wonder to your virtual trucking adventures. Curiously, it's worth mentioning that what might appear as a simple addition – the Moon – has posed some significant challenges for some time. Integrating the Moon into the night sky has required casting, rendering, and calculating lunar light, managing reflections in water bodies, dealing with wet roads, and addressing mirror effects, among other things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a4b146af5d7f1cb6eac16133c7285590eaefef18.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a4d8096db6d647038980ece545f50bc50bcdcff6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8fc30ef8411bbd90cba5669d3c26ce0bb581661e.jpg[/img]
In addition to that, we've also reimagined the night sky, introducing dynamic stars that gently twinkle, enhancing the overall authenticity of the night-time experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/05602d797a0dfb16815dc910164b267e4f2c4aff.jpg[/img]

We are also happy to share that skyboxes will now be High Dynamic Range (HDR), which means that there will be richer, more vibrant colors in the skies and our weather visual effects have also received an upgrade. Thunderstorms now include visible lightning, offering a more immersive experience. And make sure to keep an eye on the night sky in certain regions, you might be pleasantly surprised with what you will notice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/524f65f191ca750d754f65c68bcd301206251a1f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d1f2b4e7c1622059b3a737707906ccb9d734f521.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ffafb06be4aa025c1785448042cbd84b7b841293.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2fe9b4553c344ddc6ac02c5426e2399e28cb0198.jpg[/img]

To sum it all up, we’ve also prepared a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A5QxMstGYzk&]special video[/url] for you showcasing all of these changes. It’s definitely worth checking it out along with the [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/10/149-update-hdr-skyboxes-moon-and-new.html]dedicated blog post[/url] we published previously!

[previewyoutube=A5QxMstGYzk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][h3]PACCAR Technical Centre [/h3][/b]
Hidden within the vast landscape of Washington, a realistic recreation of the PACCAR Technical Center awaits your discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bfb2dd62b885d571208cb227db3655e7a77ef00a.jpg[/img]
Drivers will now have the opportunity to experience the PACCAR Technical Center firsthand. This realistic 1:1 recreation will offer a glimpse into the world of truck development. For years, the PACCAR Technical Center has been the epicenter of innovation and development for renowned truck manufacturers, Kenworth and Peterbilt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b79b6b09ca2543e87cc81eca4fe38ef56c9fd988.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/418ced78d973c89dbac71562999cad3df2867d3f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a477443bf70a1adaa3f2cdce8fb8bf72e82d5da3.jpg[/img]
This facility has been instrumental in testing trucks, powertrains, technologies, and more, and it's where the giants of the trucking industry push the boundaries of what's possible, creating the next generation of iconic trucks.

Even though the area won't be readily visible on the in-game map and UI, it will be waiting for curious players to discover with plenty of interesting bits to explore. We’ve also added an extra layer of excitement, a small Easter egg will be parked within the PACCAR Technical Center itself. We challenge you to keep your eyes peeled and see if you can spot this surprise. 

We hope you enjoy checking out this new and unique addition in American Truck Simulator!

[b][h3]Used Truck Dealers[/h3][/b]
We're also happy to introduce another highly requested feature. Used Trucks will be now available immediately in the main menu taking you to a selection of trucks that are more budget-friendly compared to brand new vehicles. However, these used trucks come with some mileage and wear, which is indicated by their star rating and a separate window that provides a detailed breakdown of the damage to various parts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aa0caf2fe04d85147d42b554f1f847c3cad0a0ab.jpg[/img]
One of the most significant changes coming along with this feature is the enhanced damage and repair system. In the past, our approach was very simplistic - individual parts would accumulate damage, represented as a percentage, and you could repair them, resetting the percentage to zero. However, with the 1.49 update, parts will accumulate three types of damage
[list]
[*] Damage: This type of damage can be fixed by standard repairs, just as before.
[*] Parts Wear: When components accumulate significant wear and tear, you'll want to replace them.
[*] Permanent Wear: The permanent wear represents systemic aging and wear across the whole vehicle. It can only be nullified by Total Restoration of the entire vehicle. This is a more expensive procedure, but it's the only way to bring your truck and trailer back to pristine condition.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4c567622008b1fbc0941e668a572d634c758b5b4.jpg[/img]
With the improved damage system comes enhanced control over vehicle maintenance. You can now make informed choices about which parts to repair or replace based on your judgment. Alternatively, you have the option to seek professional advice for the best repair strategy for your truck or trailer.

We'd love to hear your feedback about this new addition [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=313]on our official forums.[/url] Happy (used) trucking! 

[b][h3]Keybind Modifiers [/h3][/b]
Another highly requested feature coming with 1.49 is the introduction of Keybind Modifiers! When previously creating a new bind in the menu, you could only assign a single key for an action. With the 1.49 update, you will now have the option to use a combination of the key and modifiers to bind an action. For example, you can now assign Shift + L to turn your lights if you so wish! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8f57105596f45658a4c8c1b8270be357761c7dc8.jpg[/img]

This opens up a whole new world of key bind combinations for you to use, allowing for more binding options, but that's not all! You will also now have the options to bind short press and long press key. Holding the key down will be recognised as a long press, and pressing a button as normal will be seen as a short press. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b888b89365d7764265061e9296d165f6456c5103.jpg[/img]
Keyboards isn't the only peripheral taking advantage of this change. Controllers will also be able use this new feature! We look forward to hearing [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=313]your feedback[/url] on this new change!

[b][h3]Changelog [/h3][/b]

[b]Map[/b]
[list]
[*] PACCAR Technical Centre added to Washington State
[/list]

[b]Visual[/b]
[list]
[*] HDR Skyboxes, Moon and New Weather Effects
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Used Truck Dealers
[*] Keybind Modifiers
[/list]

[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports in this section.

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator  → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.49. No password is required. Sometimes you have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.[/b]

notes.title: 1.49 Update - Used Truck Dealers

In the past, individual parts would accumulate damage, represented as a percentage, and you could repair them. However, with the 1.49 update, parts will be categorized into three types of damage:

[b]Damage[/b]: This type of damage can be fixed by standard repairs, just as before.
[b]Parts Wear[/b]: For components showing wear and tear, you'll need to replace them.
[b]Permanent Wear[/b]: Parts with permanent wear can only be restored by Total Restoration of the entire vehicle. This is a more expensive procedure, but it's the only way to bring your truck and trailer back to pristine condition.

With the improved damage system comes enhanced control over vehicle maintenance. You can now make informed choices about which parts to repair or replace based on your judgment. Alternatively, you have the option to seek professional advice for the best repair strategy for your truck or trailer.

We can’t wait for you to get your hands on this new feature and provide us with your feedback. For more information regarding when this update will be available make sure to give our social media a follow ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]) and stay in touch with all the latest news.

notes.title: 1.49 Update: HDR Skyboxes, Moon and New Weather Effects
notes.content:
In the 1.49 update for both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator, we're excited to introduce a range of enhancements that will further improve your virtual trucking experience. Let’s take a look at the visual additions that await you on your journeys.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/05602d797a0dfb16815dc910164b267e4f2c4aff.jpg[/img]
First and foremost, after many requests, we've added the Moon to our night sky! It's a subtle but remarkable touch that adds an extra layer of realism and wonder to your virtual trucking adventures. Curiously, it's worth mentioning that what might appear as a simple addition – the Moon – has posed some significant challenges for some time. Integrating the Moon into the night sky has required casting, rendering, and calculating lunar light, managing reflections in water bodies, dealing with wet roads, and addressing mirror effects, among other things. However, we're delighted that we've finally been able to incorporate something as fundamental as the Moon into our in-game night sky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8fc30ef8411bbd90cba5669d3c26ce0bb581661e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a4d8096db6d647038980ece545f50bc50bcdcff6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4651848a320f022de6c53154ff29e6e7a03ba7b7.jpg[/img]
In addition to that, we've also reimagined the night sky, introducing dynamic stars that gently twinkle, enhancing the overall authenticity of the night-time experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0b57af6ce731f0cad37f6de282ce5ec67c684f4a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a4b146af5d7f1cb6eac16133c7285590eaefef18.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ffafb06be4aa025c1785448042cbd84b7b841293.jpg[/img]
Finally, the skyboxes will now be High Dynamic Range (HDR), which means there will be richer, more vibrant colours in the skies and our weather visual effects have also received an upgrade. Thunderstorms now include visible lightning, offering a more immersive experience. And make sure to keep an eye on the night sky in certain regions, you might be pleasantly surprised with what you will notice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d1f2b4e7c1622059b3a737707906ccb9d734f521.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/524f65f191ca750d754f65c68bcd301206251a1f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6b29cc0bac8afbd2a48e163b68904d2233b9f643.jpg[/img]
To sum it all up, we’ve also prepared a special video for you showcasing all of these changes. It’s definitely worth checking out!

[previewyoutube=A5QxMstGYzk;full][/previewyoutube]
With these additions, the 1.49 update aims to enhance the realism and beauty of your trucking world, promising a more enchanting and immersive journey. We have more changes to present to you in the near future, so make sure to give us a follow on social media ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]) to always be notified of any news.

notes.title: 1.49 Update: PACCAR Technical Center
notes.content:
As you may know, every update brings excitement and new adventures for players of American Truck Simulator. With the upcoming 1.49 update, we are introducing an awesome addition that will allow players to delve into an unmarked area like never before. Hidden within the vast landscape of Washington, a realistic recreation of the PACCAR Technical Center awaits discovery!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a477443bf70a1adaa3f2cdce8fb8bf72e82d5da3.jpg[/img]
For years, the PACCAR Technical Center has been the epicenter of innovation and development for renowned truck manufacturers, Kenworth and Peterbilt. This facility has been instrumental in testing trucks, powertrains, technologies, and more, and it's where the giants of the trucking industry push the boundaries of what's possible, creating the next generation of iconic trucks.

On our recent trips to the United States, we were fortunate to receive exclusive invitations from PACCAR to visit their Technical Center. While our primary purpose was to conduct sound recording sessions and 3D scanning of both legendary and new truck models, during our interactions with the team at PACCAR, a shared vision emerged. We realized that bringing the PACCAR Technical Center experience to ATS players would be a fantastic opportunity as we wanted to offer players the chance to explore this testing ground, just as we did. And so, with a shared passion for trucking, we set out to recreate this remarkable place in the ATS universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b79b6b09ca2543e87cc81eca4fe38ef56c9fd988.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/bfb2dd62b885d571208cb227db3655e7a77ef00a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/418ced78d973c89dbac71562999cad3df2867d3f.jpg[/img]
In the upcoming ATS 1.49 update, you will have the chance to experience the PACCAR Technical Center firsthand. This realistic 1:1 recreation will offer a glimpse into the world of truck development, and even though the area won't be readily visible on the in-game map and UI, it will be waiting for curious players to discover. But rest assured, intrepid truckers will quickly uncover this hidden treasure once the update lands on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d9bc7e688ee893c3e86db23f89761e56b476f545.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ca345399e19cf0a8542073bfb9cb9cdd6f6f1fb7.jpg[/img]
While the entire area has plenty of interesting bits to explore, we’ve decided to add an extra layer of excitement, a small Easter egg will be parked within the PACCAR Technical Center itself. We challenge you to keep your eyes peeled and see if you can spot this surprise. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ddd91ac438ebfe1645492de22d421d7f43420eb8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c037c75e631b7a43f6c5af7afbebb487cd53ec14.jpg[/img]
We can’t wait to show you more content that is coming with the 1.49 update over the upcoming weeks. Make sure to follow our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]) to always stay in touch with all the latest announcements and while you’re at it, let us know what you think about the PACCAR Technical Center showcased today.

notes.title: Kansas - Colby & Hays
notes.content:
Today we're happy to share with you not one, but two cities from Kansas, our in-development map expansion for American Truck Simulator! From local industries to landmarks, let's delve into what these areas can offer truck drivers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/595d58d7ea09ead210ec6dc1689288aeddfee9fc.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Colby [/b][/h3]
Nestled in-between the High Plains, where the horizon stretches as far as the eye can see, is the city of Colby. Established in 1884, it has grown into a progressive agricultural community predominantly featuring farming industries. From farms, to machinery services to livestock auctions, there is no shortage of work for drivers looking for a job!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/db1229719b72e019c76756846b4353d46289b6cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/973618b901e7d1be638728a90f51c2c1c4da21c1.jpg[/img]
If the fields aren't for you, you'll also find a supermarket, car dealer and a new dynamic depot nearby; and whilst you're in town, why not take a moment to admire the sights! Near the city limits, you'll find the visitor centre, also known as the 'Grain Bin' thanks to its unique design which incorporates traditional Kansas limestone with a a real grain bin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0fb5583286cb2c50febb6f6c73c4f3e2c8d5687f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bbbf415776e668a0391e9b17432f0917843f7de7.jpg[/img]

From there, you'll come across other prominent landmarks such as the Thomas County Courthouse, the First Presbyterian Church, the Pioneer Memorial Library and the Colby Mall. Be sure to explore a little when you do pass by, you'll never know what you might find! 

[h3][b]Hays[/b][/h3]
Welcome to Hays, a city where history, education, and natural beauty can all be found! Located amidst the rolling plains of the Sunflower State, Hays invites you to explore its captivating blend of past and present.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fee0e866e730c3a0487e8cf0c434197690d064a1.jpg[/img]
Founded in 1867 as the southern branch of the Union Pacific Railroad, it has become a bustling city with a variety of local industries. On your visit in American Truck Simulator, you can find jobs to and from the battery factory, local city works, a dynamic parking depot, car and truck dealer, furniture and supermarket stores. On the outskirts of the city, you'll also find a Steel metal depot, Oil Service and a  Livestock Farm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b167131dde23df51b4377d2462f5b854b4f5f0d7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1543f14407b680a4f95537ebb3b5e6e791fb081b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/69101400c8e5cbaaf2acb7f3f5746a16b0a7f71a.jpg[/img]
If you happen to find yourself in Hays with some downtime, why not check out the local landmarks and attractions? Here you can find a Movie Theater with an accompanying art mural, statues of some of Hays' personalities, the Hays Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 9076, the Hays Public Library and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/11be34f9c0ef54b52de8e431f49ace783faa8145.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/268175b394ba252ef13af196634b95f94951929b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/04d3f3a6e54c957b3bf98ecabd17d455e1f3f8ab.jpg[/img]
No matter which city you choose to visit first, history and industries await you on the road! We hope you enjoyed this insight of what is to come with the Kansas DLC. If you like what you see, be sure to add it to your Steam Wishlist! Until next time, keep on truckin'. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/

notes.title: Cruising Oklahoma World of Trucks Event
notes.content:
We are delighted to invite you on [b]Tuesday, the 1st of August[/b], to celebrate the release of our new Oklahoma DLC, by taking part in our latest [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks event[/url] - Cruising Oklahoma! From mountain ranges and forests, over prairies and savannas to creeks and rivers, you'll explore the diverse landscape and economy of this incredible state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fca3e8e9d429b3310bb804594eb20db693db1341.jpg[/img]

We are asking our #BestCommunityEver to achieve the community goal of driving [b]111,000,000 miles[/b] (178,637,184km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Oklahoma.
While #CruisingOklahoma and enjoying the beautiful landscape it is also worth knowing that it is home to a wide variety of animals and insects, like the common honey bee and Black Swallowtail butterfly, two national state symbols that are important for Oklahoma's biodiversity. The state holds populations of bear and fox in the mountains, as well as the prairie dog and the iconic American bison in the prairie regions.

Oklahoma is also known as the [b]"Sooner State"[/b], symbolizing the energetic, progressive can-do spirit. Truckers can look forward to exploring many new industries, like delivering iconic, yellow School Bus parts to the bus factory, Big Tires for machinery from the tire factories in Ardmore and Lawton, or Yard Trucks that are needed at Tulsa Airport.

During your journey through Oklahoma, you can look forward to many beautiful views and highlights such as:

[list]
[*] Gloss Mountain State Park, unique natural landmark with mesas in north western Oklahoma
[*] Tulsa, metropolis center for energy, aerospace, and technology
[*] McAlester, picturesque historical city in East Oklahoma
[*] Beavers Bend State Park, beautiful park in the mountainous region of south east Oklahoma
[*] Hugo Lake Spillway, dam on the Kiamichi River in south east Oklahoma
[*] As with past cruising events, you can use your own trailer and experience all these in the external market!
[/list]
Oklahoma DLC is offering 10 fantastic new cities to explore, and we have a special reward for completing your personal goal, which will require you to deliver a job to or from all 10 cities of Oklahoma. All jobs for the event need to be 100 miles each (161 km) or more.

Join our journey with the newest DLC of American Truck Simulator and set out on a trip over high plains, prairies and low wetlands, while discovering the unique factories and industries of Oklahoma! Get ready for a terrific ride through the Sooner State!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a0a052f3ff536f3a62407d58bff32633a9324291.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Rules[/h3][/b]
Using External Contracts or External Market, with a World of Trucks-connected profile in American Truck Simulator, the community goal is to drive 111,000,000 miles (178,637,184 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Oklahoma.

When a player completes a delivery to or from 10 different Oklahoma cities, they will achieve their personal goal.

All jobs for the event need to be at least 100 miles each (161 km), or more.

You can check if your recent deliveries met these conditions using your Log Book in your World of Trucks profile.

[b][h3]Rewards[/h3][/b]
[b]Personal:[/b] Players that deliver cargo to or from 10 Oklahoma cities will gain a personal World of Trucks Achievement and a beautiful Wild Stampede themed truck paint job Steam inventory item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0e59eb2a6ab558ae5c4d89885e83fc0dbd0f59b8.jpg[/img]

[b]Community:[/b] When the community goal of driving 111,000,000 miles (178,637,184km) during deliveries to or from any city in Oklahoma is met, and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive a hanging Black Swallowtail ornament Steam inventory item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8039b881c9bac7f31b467494838a3b12a2333c23.jpg[/img]

The event will be concluded on [b]Sunday the 1st of October at 23:59 UTC.[/b]

We wait with bated breath to hear back from you about your new adventure, with so many new places to explore and discover. We think you will love cruising the Sooner State, from its ancient mountain ranges and forests in the high plains region, through central prairies, savannas and mesas, to the low wetlands revealing creeks and rivers, and we look forward to seeing all your photos! So, please share your screenshots and videos with us using the hashtag #CruisingOklahoma on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url] profiles and we will share our favorite ones (we may even feature some of them in a future blog post!).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209650/American_Truck_Simulator__Oklahoma/

notes.title: American Truck Simulator 1.48 Release
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the 1.48 update for American Truck Simulator has been released and is now available on Steam. This update contains bug fixes, changes and new content, which are featured below, so we recommend taking a read! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2352a7eb9b18b8faf6b5ee7b67826012f367916a.jpg[/img]

We'd like to take this opportunity to  thank everyone who participated, provided their feedback, and made bug reports during the Open Beta period. Your valuable input helped us make tweaks, changes and squash some bugs we may have missed the first time around. We hope you can now begin to fully enjoy the fruits of your work. 

[previewyoutube=GPioJ4ogcFc;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][h3]New Texas DLC Content[/h3][/b]
They say everything is bigger in Texas, including the updates! Our talented team has revisited the state to bring an update that fits the boot; including roads, landmarks, depots, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5145401304b739d07950ebb2d9840995466f3efe.jpg[/img] 
The equivalent of 500 real miles have been added over 8 different roads, interstates and highways; including one of the most well known interchanges in Texas. Nicknamed the 'High Five', it is one of the first five-level stack interchanges to be built in Dallas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/986a2967e8dda1fb313f0b8e663937523af53e7f.jpg[/img]
Keeping on the topic of five, in this update you'll be able to explore 5 new settlements. Make sure to take time to explore Greenville, Shamrock, Sharman, De Kalb and Paris. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1b4d9a9159c251cefcd80cac0597d1c832ea38ea.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1170a6feba4b13f8791c4ccb569ea54b9589e53d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/74fb45d52d5535b9367c6ce2764236d7708b7b77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3889f9b9d1ab4533f263cfcaca73a81a61286230.jpg[/img]
Another big addition to this update is the addition of Texarkana; a unique city that straddles the border between Texas and Arkansas, with the state line running through the center of the city.  We hope owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465750/American_Truck_Simulator__Texas/]Texas DLC[/url] will enjoy this sizeable update. Read more about this update in one of our [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/06/american-truck-simulator-148-update.html]previous blog posts[/url].

[b][h3]Cities in the Gallery[/h3][/b]
In the 1.46 update, we introduced the Gallery feature, a one stop shop for all your images, photo trophies, and discovered viewpoints, which maintained all the legacy functionality of the older Screenshot Manager. Today, we're excited to add a new functionality to the Gallery! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/be9b1a551e34df1f38b7f620cf90ffd64787258e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/94916583321b484ac20ec02c0198b81e902b6c01.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e97878dc31a2fd9912d118ffc9c0fb0a68799094.jpg[/img]
As you journey and discover the many cities of American Truck Simulator, you'll be able to collect them under the new 'Cities' tab. Once unlocked, you'll be able to view which cities you have visited, as well as watch and replay any of the city intro cutscenes; which are normally only seen when you first start your first HQ there. 

We hope you enjoy this new addition to our Gallery! Let us know how many cities you've already unlocked in on our social media channels. 

[b][h3]Washington DLC Custom City Intros[/h3][/b]
Carrying on from our previous update which introduced custom city intros for Utah & Idaho, we have now expanded these cutscenes in the Washington DLC for American Truck Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/174c30db5e83d57dd78d9afdd72b05f351d3e7fd.jpg[/img]
These special cutscenes appear when a player selects a starting city when creating a new profile. We hope that new players (or those restarting a new profile) will enjoy these new additions, showcasing the area where you have chosen to begin. 

Originally, these starting cutscenes were quite basic in terms of their movement and functionality, however as time has gone on, we have improved on them with fly-by scripts and more. For most players, you would only see one of these cutscene for a particular city just once, and then continue on to many hours of trucking. This is why we've decided to bring the new function to the Gallery menu to replay them, and see the other City Intros which you may not have normally seen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d64f1f8a5b8520529b69ed7a0e5318f6d03c2b20.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy the work of our team who have brought these Cities to life through these intros, and we look forward to introducing it to more states in the future.

[b][h3]Special Transport DLC Update[/h3][/b]
In addition to the new content and changes that are coming to American Truck Simulator in this update, we are also happy to introduce two brand new special transport routes! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c393d15068809413d3bb0b36168f9abb91c7a32c.jpg[/img]
Are you ready to take on these new routes with oversized loads? You can find these unique delivery contracts between the cities of Laredo & San Antonio in Texas and Laurel & Billings in Montana. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8a2bf74b787ebc2b8c6a77a0a5509d38b09338ef.jpg[/img]
Think you handle it? Share with us your pictures from your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport[/url] hauls on our social media channels.

[b][h3]Reworked Vehicle Transport Trailers[/h3][/b]
Speaking of special transport - we are happy to let you know that our vehicle team has found some spare capacity in between other of their projects to also revisit and rework trailers that our in-game economy uses to transport various types of vehicles, such as cars, SUVs, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0768adce4ebd6ee715f28c7c508d9ad1ced58a51.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/13edc16eae3578067e52ab8de8c4616d7e771e07.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/84d3b7a4a11645007e857feb27a4b1187d536ca6.jpg[/img]
Search for these cargoes within the freight market and take them for a ride! Your nearest car dealer might need delivery of fresh new whips.

[b][h3]Per-State map exploration[/h3][/b]
We know how many drivers enjoy the challenging task of gaining 100% map exploration. We know this isn't easy, so we've introduced a new UI window which can be accessed by clicking on your map exploration in the top left of the world map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/efc4bcede4ebc83c8bd8254014a1fad478330027.jpg[/img]
Upon clicking on this, a new window will open showing you a list of the U.S States with their respective flag, and a breakdown of your exploration of each one. We hope that this will aid you in finding those missing roads in our ever-growing world of American Truck Simulator. 

Let us know how you're getting on with your map exploration in the comments below or on social media! 

[b][h3]Options slider ranges [/h3][/b]
We are happy to introduce a highly requested addition to your options page when tweaking with settings in American Truck Simulator. You will now find a small box next to the sliders which displays the number which it is set to. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aeaad711f8e062822f7c3bc005e74a5ff905c780.jpg[/img]
We hope this makes it easier for you to not only set up multiple profiles with similar settings, but also share your settings with others.

[b][h3]Input wizard controls selection redesign [/h3][/b]
We've given our input wizard for control selection a UI overhaul! Our team has been working hard to bring a simplistic but modern design to this setup window. We hope this new UI will help guide users new and old through the selection and setup process which features new icons and a clear description for each option. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2224aa14196520784088dde46f7c64b8f30d7a3d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7260bacf0fae6dde60772d6765f1c27c25b08170.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/245fc00c398dc0d67750b10338cd74825efe04e7.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Electronic Stability Controls (Anti-Lock Braking System + Traction Control)[/h3][/b]
You can now find the addition of Anti-Lock Braking System & Traction Control in the gameplay options. These Electronic Stability Controls help assist the driver in a variety of conditions and/or scenarios. The Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) loosens brakes on wheels that are close to locking out. Traction Control (ASR or TRC) helps prevent oversteer and understeer, as-well provide individual wheel anti-slip system applies brakes to wheels that are slipping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/600eff70d677a5b4f79924a31142b6ad5348e45a.jpg[/img]
Traction control also features cornering assist, which becomes active when understeer or oversteer, it brakes the inside rear wheels to prevent understeer and outside front wheel to prevent oversteer. We hope these new additions will be of use to you on your future journeys! 
 
[b][h3]MOD structure changes[/h3][/b]
This change is more directed at our MOD creators in the community! We have now added the ability to create a single MOD for multiple DLCs, regardless of which DLC the user actually has.

If at least one of the subdirectories or files (*.zip) in the MOD root is named "base" or prefixed with "dlc_" then these subdirectories or files are mounted instead of the MOD root. We've also updated the SCS Workshop Uploader to reflect these changes as well. If the SCS Workshop Uploader discovers a MOD with the new structure, it performs additional checks.

We hope this new structure makes things a little easier for our talented modding community, and if you have any questions, feel free to head over to our [url=https://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Main_Page]modding wiki[/url] or forum where we can help support you. 

[b][h3]Changelog [/h3][/b]
[b][h3]Map[/h3][/b]
[b][list]
[*] New Texas DLC Content[/list][/b]
[b][h3]Vehicles [/h3][/b]
[b][list][*] Electronic Stability Controls (Anti-Lock Braking System + Traction Control)
[*] Reworked Vehicle Transport Trailers[/list][/b]
[b][h3]Gameplay[/h3][/b]
[b][list][*] Custom City Intros (Washington DLC)
[*] Special Transport New Routes (Montana & Texas DLC)[/list][/b]
[b][h3]UI[/h3][/b]
[list][*] [b]Per-State Map Exploration
[*] Cities in the Gallery
[*] Options Sliders now feature numbers
[*] Input Wizard Control Selection UI Overhaul[/b][/list]
[b][h3]Other[/h3][/b]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.48 Open Beta
notes.content:
Today, we are happy to share with you that the 1.48 Open Beta branch for American Truck Simulator is now available to try and test out. If you plan on participating in this Open Beta, we ask that you please help us by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=308]appropriate section(s) of our official forums.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2aa44bd303b7997a3d6c3f7fddcce4b09d6f62fd.jpg[/img]

Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable to our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out. So, without further ado, let's take a look at what the 1.48 Open Beta has in store.

[b][h3]New Texas DLC Content[/h3][/b]
They say everything is bigger in Texas, including the updates! Our talented team has revisited the state to bring an update that fits the boot; including roads, landmarks, depots, and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8eb30aed3b5b429db064fd20d6a2327c07c159cd.jpg[/img]
The equivalent of 500 real miles have been added over 8 different roads, interstates and highways; including one of the most well known interchanges in Texas. Nicknamed the 'High Five', it is one of the first five-level stack interchanges to be built in Dallas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a9e0c0ed036be3cb425dcb96f2863833b20c416d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7d3aa9d8a1b1541f50f9d63d74c1b3f02c573b4c.jpg[/img]
Keeping on the topic of five, in this update you'll be able to explore 5 new settlements. Make sure to take time to explore Greenville, Shamrock, Sharman, De Kalb and Paris.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1c87bc9b73cb4f91fddd0f0fa9c670b2d411d577.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/603c3f6e81f895651623cac9229cf0e4abd3f91a.jpg[/img]
Another big addition to this update is the addition of Texarkana; a unique city that straddles the border between Texas and Arkansas, with the state line running through the center of the city. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/631887773f1a9b23befe5e2af060d1880b70c7c2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0b62338b4a5185c458cbca90350caacd567a26c8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a2ce4e8524005faef89acc19c74b10f35a0a0b41.jpg[/img]
We hope owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465750/American_Truck_Simulator__Texas/]Texas DLC[/url] will enjoy this sizeable update. Read more about this update in one of our [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/06/american-truck-simulator-148-update.html]previous blog posts[/url] or let us know if the boot fits by heading over to our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewtopic.php?t=320907]official forums[/url]. 

[b][h3]Cities in the Gallery[/h3][/b]
In the 1.46 update, we introduced the Gallery feature, a one stop shop for all your images, photo trophies, and discovered viewpoints, which maintained all the legacy functionality of the older Screenshot Manager. Today, we're excited to add a new functionality to the Gallery! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4b4b75f9662d33aa11d7b0e4b9aa70158c9ebd7d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1c9595644017e094d24881669192da42eebbfb2b.jpg[/img]
As you journey and discover the many cities of American Truck Simulator, you'll be able to collect them under the new 'City Intros' tab. Once unlocked, you'll be able to view which cities you have visited, as well as watch and replay any of the city intro cutscenes; which are normally only seen when you first start your first HQ there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/450f95ba085c05b026610b9b89445ea91cd815d1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7e7be9c088f675c136b24a15f88cff3f6e9dc2be.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy this new addition to our Gallery! Let us know how many cities you've already unlocked in on our social media channels. 

[b][h3]Washington DLC Custom City Intros[/h3][/b]
Carrying on from our previous update which introduced custom city intros for Utah & Idaho, we have now expanded these cutscenes in the Washington DLC for American Truck Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/728ebb9e24fea543cd61ec12d65c4e2e9fa05d3e.jpg[/img]
These special cutscenes appear when a player selects a starting city when creating a new profile. We hope that new players (or those restarting a new profile) will enjoy these new additions, showcasing the area where you have chosen to begin! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0a392fd020414e18716e6d53274b7648ebed2a87.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy this addition, and we look forward to introducing it to more states in the future.

[b][h3]Special Transport DLC Update[/h3][/b]
In addition to the new content and changes that are coming to American Truck Simulator in this update, we are also happy to introduce two brand new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport[/url] routes! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c35ddffe2ba4c8943c963ee7ef2216fd9dd0eb0f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0257ce97b1ca0d7957379aa60d7950fc96258f3a.jpg[/img]
Are you ready to take on these new routes with oversized loads? You can find these unique delivery contracts between the cities of Laredo & San Antonio in Texas and Laurel & Billings in Montana. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5fb49e8cedeed24fecd8121cd093aab0ec6f6089.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c2cabbc8742b8dd1a109b42fb73818d6d8635e92.jpg[/img]
Think you handle it? Share with us your pictures from your Special Transport hauls on our social media channels.

[b][h3]Reworked Vehicle Transport Trailers[/h3][/b]
Speaking of special transport - we are happy to let you know that our vehicle team has found some spare capacity in between other of their projects to also revisit and rework trailers that our in-game economy uses to transport various types of vehicles, such as cars, SUVs, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bcc1aa492aa9b700c04e14fcd684d1721001eb0b.jpg[/img]
Search for these cargoes within the freight market and take them for a ride! Your nearest car dealer might need delivery of fresh new whips.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/101bfa155c495bcc5379489fed945b35d0a56171.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/710cb97b280bbdf3fe74c0a0f695521bfb31f445.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]Per-State map exploration[/h3][/b]
We know how many drivers enjoy the challenging task of gaining 100% map exploration. We know this isn't easy, so we've introduced a new UI window which can be accessed by clicking on your map exploration in the top left of the world map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ca57c62828e34686c94b2de0d77d52cf6e3b42cc.jpg[/img]
Upon clicking on this, a new window will open showing you a list of the U.S States with their respective flag, and a breakdown of your exploration of each one. We hope that this will aid you in finding those missing roads in our ever-growing world of American Truck Simulator. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2e596bf593e6e509e945acef9d12b095d8334237.jpg[/img]
Let us know how you're getting on with your map exploration in the comments below or on social media! 

[b][h3]Options slider ranges [/h3][/b]
We are happy to introduce a highly requested addition to your options page when tweaking with settings in American Truck Simulator. You will now find a small box next to the sliders which displays the number which it is set to. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5f21a4217d47a959c279ccbd134944ffa9a97ecc.jpg[/img]
We hope this makes it easier for you to not only set up multiple profiles with similar settings, but also share your settings with others. Let us know if you think think this design works well by leaving feedback in the appropriate section of [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewtopic.php?t=320907]our forums[/url]. 

[b][h3]Input wizard controls selection redesign [/h3][/b]
We've given our input wizard for control selection a UI overhaul! Our team have been working hard to bring a simplistic but modern design to this setup window. We hope this new UI will help guide users new and old through the selection and setup process which features new icons and a clear description on each option. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/067919180039ca6ce52fecd9ab722adc1bcd8b3d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c02294f5936ca6ee0cb8eb684384d246008ab805.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a3157bff02685abaef587c5e68e87b1266dd76a4.jpg[/img]
Let us know what you think of this new UI change by heading to our forums.

[b][h3]MOD structure changes[/h3][/b]
This change is more directed at our MOD creators in the community! We have now added the ability to create a single MOD for multiple DLC's, regardless of which DLC the user actually has.

If at least one of the subdirectories or files (*.zip) in MOD root is named "base" or prefixed with "dlc_" then these subdirectories or files are mounted instead of the MOD root. We've also updated the SCS Workshop Uploader to reflect these changes as well. If the SCS Workshop Uploader discovers a MOD with the new structure, it performs additional checks.

We hope this new structure makes things a little easier for our talented modding community, and if you have any questions, feel free to head over to our [url=https://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Main_Page]modding wiki[/url] or forum where we can help support you. 

[b][h3]Changelog [/h3][/b]
[b]Map[/b]
[list]
[*] New Texas DLC Content[/list]
[b]Vehicles[/b]
[list]
[*] Electronic Stability Controls (Anti-Lock Braking System + Traction Control)
[*] Reworked Vehicle Transport Trailers
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Custom City Intros (Washington DLC)
[*] Special Transport New Routes (Montana & Texas DLC)
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Per-State Map Exploration
[*] Gallery City Intro addition
[*] Options Sliders now feature numbers
[*] Input Wizard Control Selection UI Overhaul[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Third-Party Mod Structure Change[/list]
[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports in this section.

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.48. No password required. Sometimes you have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.[/b]
