notes.title: American Truck Simulator 1.40 Open Beta
notes.content:
We love to bring you new game updates, especially when they contain some cool features that have been requested for a long time! Today, we are happy to share with you that the 1.40 Update Open Beta for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=1_40_ob]American Truck Simulator[/url] is now ready to be tested and tried-out by our community!

However, please keep in mind that this is the first iteration of the open beta, which is still very much a work-in-progress build. If you want to take it for a spin, you can help contribute by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the appropriate section of our official forums. Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable for our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out.

[b]Please bear in mind that this huge update will likely render many community MODs incompatible. MOD authors may need to adjust and update their mods to work with this update. We strongly recommend that you use a profile without any third-party modifications if you wish to participate in the 1.40 Open Beta. [/b]

So, let's take a look at what the 1.40 update has in store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bd26368d5d5ae456ccba6d22e73983f0144f1bfc.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Visual Lighting System[/h2]
One of the biggest changes you'll notice when you first hop into your truck cab is the implementation of our new visual lighting system. However, this isn't just a simple change of our skyboxes; our new light system is fully dynamic and can now change not just according to current weather, but also based on simulated camera exposure taking into account not just current daylight intensity and weather, but also surface properties of game world elements in the view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/40d8eac5d9af9f54a03385c93356544fa6239af9.jpg[/img]

This new light system and the start of our new physical light model is a very important step towards a complete and better physical model of the whole world in our game, and how real it looks and works. All of our lighting is now based on real physical ratios and units, to make it as realistic as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7b905deeb8395bc6ec23487305f0fcaada4d6171.jpg[/img]

To prepare for this new light system, our teams had to make a lot of changes to existing in-game world objects; including a majority of the in-game assets, textures, and materials to better work with the new physical model of the new light system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b9de8c9f83b83e4a5ff91e128c19d36ee764e42c.jpg[/img]

We are very excited for you to be able to experience and immerse yourself in driving in the new light. The result is the combination of thousands of hours by our programmers and visual effect artists and many other teams involved in the creation process of this new system. 

During this open beta, your feedback is incredibly important and valuable to us, so we ask that you please submits yours to us in the 1.40 section for American Truck Simulator on our forums which you can find [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=279]here[/url]. 

[h2]Extended Chassis update[/h2]
For the 5th anniversary of American Truck Simulator, we wanted to bring a heavily-requested feature to our community to celebrate its progress and journey so far! This suggestion has always frequently appeared in our suggestions pile, and today we are thrilled to bring you an extended chassis range to all current truck models.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/080f62e146715ac6149a06958b5c4ba257ac4ebe.jpg[/img]

Our vehicle team has worked hard to bring you a range of long and short chassis types, allowing you to customize your truck for the job at hand. This update will feature 4x2, 8x4, and 8x6 chassis types which are used for a range of different trailers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/06942a4093771806bc133681cbcaaaa2b8532eb4.jpg[/img]

4x2s, also known as single-axle trucks, are frequently used for local distribution deliveries by supermarkets and by logistic companies for hauling doubles. 8x4 and 8x6 chassis are the big guns of the heavy-haul industry and can handle just about any load you decide to take on. All of these new options bring more variety to you, the driver! So we hope you enjoy this surprise addition to 1.40.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0852b2ad6bf1f15d7d48a746d22e894e4d3e5f9a.jpg[/img]

Here's a full list of all the new extended chassis options now available in the open beta:
[list]
[*] Freightliner Cascadia: Day cab 4x2
[*] Mack Anthem: Day cab 4x2
[*] International LoneStar: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4
[*] Peterbilt 389: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4 & 8x6
[*] Volvo VNL: Day cab 4x2, Day cab & Sleepers 8x4
[*] Peterbilt 579: Day cab 4x2
[*] Kenworth W900: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4 & 8x6
[*] Kenworth T680: Day cab 4x2
[*] Western Star 49X: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4 & 8x6
[/list]

[h2][b]Western Star 49X Update:[/b][/h2]

With the exciting release of the Western Star® 49X in September 2020, we are happy to share with you that with the arrival of 1.40 for American Truck Simulator; the 49X will receive 2 sleeper cabin options as well as a lot of other new options. In fact, this truck just became the one with the most chassis options available, with up to 36 possible chassis/cabin/fuel-tank combinations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ce5a5283bd5100d885fd01b30768a083d11d2370.jpg[/img]

We have just finished covering and showing the options which are coming for this truck in our special live stream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]Steam[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCb9XDB0X13EEqUqCSsOhonQ]YouTube[/url]. Don't fret if you've missed it, as you can always watch it again on our official YouTube channel. Additionally, we will be releasing a dedicated blog post in the near future with more information, images, and also a very cool video; be sure to keep an eye out for it!

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e896ac64bed722d381b149e095168cb0e98f902f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e896ac64bed722d381b149e095168cb0e98f902f.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/010470f77a49a6230e37ee7d8e6333f748f6eda6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/010470f77a49a6230e37ee7d8e6333f748f6eda6.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df295e8daa497c78c1fe5e6e631c115c7f3884f6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df295e8daa497c78c1fe5e6e631c115c7f3884f6.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

Plus, if you are very eager to check out the new updates, be sure to join the 1.40 Open Beta and check it out for yourself!  

[h2]New Mexico & Oregon DLC Viewpoints[/h2]

Back in October last year, American Truck Simulator saw the arrival of viewpoints to the states of Washington and Utah after their popular debut in Idaho! Today we are happy to share with you that 1.40 sees the introduction of new viewpoints to the states of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=1_40_ob]New Mexico[/url] & [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=1_40_ob]Oregon[/url]. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1f232f726f9dac290879e9248a002059d77f2ea2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1f232f726f9dac290879e9248a002059d77f2ea2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/42999a592ffb41d2f778ae669af24dea83ad08a5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/42999a592ffb41d2f778ae669af24dea83ad08a5.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

For newer players of our titles, Viewpoints are certain spots found across the map, where drivers can activate a special in-game cutscene with a short showcase of a near location or place of interest.  These can be found displayed as a grey question mark on your GPS, so be sure to stop and discover them on your journeys. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e9e54b7292cdaceaea9e022c0d79243120155847.jpg[/img]

You also have the option to skip the viewpoint or replay it if you wish to watch it again. From populated cities to historic monuments, each viewpoint highlights a point of interest or industry, so make sure to discover them all!  

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[b]Visual:[/b]
New Visual Lighting System
[b]Map: [/b]
New Viewpoints in New Mexico & Oregon DLC's
[b]Vehicles:[/b] 
New 4x2, 8x4, and 8x6 chassis
Western Star 49X update including sleeper variants and Set-Back configurations 

[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an experimental open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, kinks, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports in [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=279]this section[/url].[/b]

[b]Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.[/b]

[b]If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.40. No password required.[/b]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator 5th Anniversary: Chassis Update
notes.content:
Happy 5th Birthday [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]American Truck Simulator[/url]! It's incredible how time has flown since we released this newer trucking title in February 2016. Since that time we are proud to have brought you 9 U.S States (California, Nevada, Arizona, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]New Mexico[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Oregon[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Washington[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Utah[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Idaho[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Colorado[/url]) with 2 more in development, 7 major truck brands, and 13 DLC's such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477840/American_Truck_Simulator__Cabin_Accessories/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Cabin Accessories[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/?utm_source=scs_blog&utm_campaign=ats_5_anniversary]Special Transport[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/080f62e146715ac6149a06958b5c4ba257ac4ebe.jpg[/img]

To celebrate this special occasion, we wanted to bring a heavily-requested feature to our community to celebrate its progress and journey so far! This suggestion has always frequently appeared in our suggestions pile and today, we are happy to announce that American Truck Simulator will receive new chassis options for all current trucks in the upcoming 1.40 update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0852b2ad6bf1f15d7d48a746d22e894e4d3e5f9a.jpg[/img]

Our vehicle team has worked hard to bring you a range of long and short chassis types, allowing you to customize your truck for the job at hand. This update will feature 4x2, 8x4, and 8x6 chassis types which are used for a range of different trailers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cfe84c55d169b42d881e587318e2e26aef687369.jpg[/img]

4x2s, also known as single-axle trucks, are frequently used for local distribution deliveries by supermarkets and by logistic companies for hauling doubles. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cbd6a6b615eed7ad9311ae17cee954e6bd446234.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cbd6a6b615eed7ad9311ae17cee954e6bd446234.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/06942a4093771806bc133681cbcaaaa2b8532eb4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/06942a4093771806bc133681cbcaaaa2b8532eb4.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/668128d8dced5595ef0827379229d8d768db0fc8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/668128d8dced5595ef0827379229d8d768db0fc8.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

8x4 and 8x6 chassis are the big guns of the heavy-haul industry and can handle just about any load you decide to take on. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7ef8fa1e1abe1e346b0d08725cd76e627e02b88.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e7ef8fa1e1abe1e346b0d08725cd76e627e02b88.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9bffced74848e6be4e99d32793071d76019ecbe3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9bffced74848e6be4e99d32793071d76019ecbe3.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4ad1c3795207cd904050a829a45905c7255948c1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4ad1c3795207cd904050a829a45905c7255948c1.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

Interested to know the details of what chassis types each truck will be receiving? Here's a full list of all the new extended chassis options coming to our range of trucks in American Truck Simulator:

[list][*]Freightliner Cascadia: Day cab 4x2[/*][*]Mack Anthem: Day cab 4x2[/*][*]International LoneStar: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4[/*][*]Peterbilt 389: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4 & 8x6[/*][*]Volvo VNL: Day cab 4x2, Day cab & Sleepers 8x4[/*][*]Peterbilt 579: Day cab 4x2[/*][*]Kenworth W900: Day cab & Sleepers 8x4 & 8x6[/*][*]Kenworth T680: Day cab 4x2[/*][*]Western Star 49X: Day cab 8x4 & 8x6[/*][/list]
All of these new options bring more variety to you, the driver! So we hope you enjoy this surprise addition to 1.40. We want to also take a moment to thank every single member of our community for your on-going support for American Truck Simulator! We look forward to bringing you even more content and updates in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/38daa6752dec601e1f0038edeb1079a69c12f3d2.jpg[/img]

But that isn't all! Tonight we will be hosting a special 5th Anniversary Live-Stream where we will be giving you a first look at these new chassis options and celebrating with you, the community, with giveaways and more! You can join us live from 6pm CET on either [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]Steam[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url], or [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCb9XDB0X13EEqUqCSsOhonQ]YouTube[/url]! We hope to see you there.

notes.title: Hauling Hope Event
notes.content:
Virtual Truckers of the world, we are all still enduring hard times, as the world continues to battle COVID-19. The fight is not over, but we can see light at the end of the tunnel, we see hope in the creation of the COVID-19 Vaccines and their rapid worldwide roll-out. We would like to, once again, recognise the selfless drivers and support crews working so incredibly hard to achieve this goal. So, we are inviting you to take part in personally delivering these vaccines, across any and all trucking territories in the World of Trucks Hauling Hope[ event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9a878b68fab38052e4e639252072a71f1cf13262.jpg[/img]

Last year, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/03/truckathome-event.html]in March[/url], we asked you all to respond in the way we thought best, which was to take part in the unprecedented #TruckAtHome event. The community effort was incredible, it was at a level of participation that we had never seen before. We celebrated with you all further, by delivering financial support and supplies directly to those on the front line, for each new milestone that the community reached.

This time, it will be your own personal journey. Our slogan is [u]#HaulingHope[/u], and the goal is for you to deliver this fragile and precious cargo undamaged, so you will need to be extra careful when making your delivery. The cargo will have a zero-damage tolerance and will require a Fragile Cargo skill, level 1, to be carried.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/95d5919b1111d1b0cf32a0127a7263372df0ffd1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/95d5919b1111d1b0cf32a0127a7263372df0ffd1.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/6027a4349bca31e8e8196c9a344ab848a5847c6a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/6027a4349bca31e8e8196c9a344ab848a5847c6a.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

This event is a chance to take part in delivering something more than just a cargo, it's a chance to deliver hope to the world, if only virtually.

Where you go and how far you haul will be up to you. What is important is that you enjoy the event, spread the word so that others can share the hope, and stay safe and healthy.

[h3][b][u]#HaulingHope Event Rules:[/u][/b][/h3]

Using [b]External Contracts[/b] with a World of Trucks-connected profile in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both, your [b]Personal goal[/b] is to complete at least [b]7 undamaged deliveries[/b] of COVID-19 Vaccine cargo across any trucking territories. To be able to see and carry this cargo, you need to have a Fragile Cargo skill of at least level 1.

[h3][u][b]Reward:[/b][/u][/h3]

[b][u]Personal goal:[/u][/b] Your contribution of 7 or more deliveries of [b]COVID-19 Vaccine cargo[/b] will gain you: 
[list][*]A [b]World of Trucks Achievement[/b].[/*][*]A prestigeous, [b]Hope Trucker Insiginia, cabin item[/b] to hang in your truck.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9b2fa7f5955a4274b2d5300083c556603e39a7ec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/45752a68f54643a096e8ceca3027dce3cbf4471c.jpg[/img]

The event will be concluded [u][i]on Sunday 7th February 23:59 UTC.[/i][/u]

notes.title: Christmas Wise Giving Event 2020
notes.content:
Last year we asked the community to spread the spirit of Christmas giving across all trucking territories in the Christmas Grand Giving event of 2019. The response was outstanding and we all did ourselves proud.

So, you may ask, what could top such a momentous effort? What is better than giving during Christmas time? The answer, this year, is not just giving, but giving wisely! In this way, we bring you the Christmas Wise Giving event of 2020 for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/?utm_source=steam_announcement_ats&utm_campaign=wotr_xmas_2020_start]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/?utm_source=steam_announcement_ats&utm_campaign=wotr_xmas_2020_start]American Truck Simulator[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/0d053ba6d6dc5cf7317ade7ae86411fddb2fbac6.jpg[/img]

We are not only asking you, our #BestCommunityEver, to match the Grand Giving reputation that you earned last year, but we are further challenging everyone to beat it by giving wisely, and we are going to help you do this!

We have fresh trailer loads of much-needed gifts to deliver. It is going to be your kind heart and wise decisions that deliver them to who needs them most. For carrying out this noble deed your actions will be noted twofold, in that we will award Hearts to each city, based on the number of deliveries it gives, and Gifts to each city based on the number of deliveries it receives. It will be the sum total of Hearts and Gifts that will be counted towards the community goal.

The more a city gives or receives, the more Hearts or Gifts that city gets, with a maximum of 5 Heart icons and 5 Gift icons per city.

You’ll be able to track the community progress on [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] or directly in the game using the updated External Contracts interface:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9a29aed23c2b4607715bf5b66b25aeb8972bb6c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/9a29aed23c2b4607715bf5b66b25aeb8972bb6c1.png[/img][/url]

We'll be jump-starting this great event with a special Christmas Wise Giving developer stream on the 17th of December, starting at 18:00 CET. It will be loads of fun, delivering jobs during the event, giving away steam keys, and we'll provide more information on our social media sharing campaign, in which those who'll share an image or video from their participation in the event, under the [i]#XmasWiseGiving[/i] hashtag, will have a chance to win some cool gifts.

[h1]Wise Giving Event rules[/h1]

Using External Contracts with a [i][url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url]-connected profile[/i] in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both, the goal is to get as many Hearts and Gifts as possible awarded to as many cities as possible across all trucking territories. Every city can achieve up to 5 Hearts and 5 Gifts!

[i]For a city[/i] to gain [u]1 Heart[/u] the community must make 1000 deliveries [u]from it[/u], using the provided [i]Gifts[/i] cargo.

[i]For a city[/i] to gain [u]1 Gift[/u] the community must make 1000 deliveries [u]to it[/u], using the provided [i]Gifts[/i] cargo.

Each tier of 350 Hearts/Gifts combined, will unlock a unique community reward.

For a [i]Personal goal[/i], complete [u]at least 15 deliveries[/u] of Gifts cargo in either Euro Truck Simulator 2 or American Truck Simulator.

In quick summary, using Euro Truck Simulator and/or American Truck Simulator:

[list]
[*]To get a Personal goal: 15 deliveries from any cities in either game.
[*]To get a Heart for a city: 1000 deliveries from that particular city.
[*]To get a Gift for a city: 1000 deliveries to that particular city.
[*]Unlock a unique community reward: Every tier of 350 Hearts/Gifts combined, collected from both games.
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a7cfd2619fe5a911441528b8b4499704637d3ad3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a7cfd2619fe5a911441528b8b4499704637d3ad3.jpg[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b1e91d8d0cedb518f6f2a36a0a29504e42cc3917.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b1e91d8d0cedb518f6f2a36a0a29504e42cc3917.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Rewards[/h1]

[h2]Personal goal[/h2]

Your contribution of 15 or more deliveries of Gifts cargo will gain you:

[list]
[*]A [i]World of Trucks Achievement[/i]
[*]A Christmas-themed, [i]Winter Blast[/i], paint job to help you carry out more Gifts deliveries during the event.
[/list]

[h2]Community goals[/h2]

Each tier of [i]350 Hearts/Gifts combined[/i], will unlock unique community rewards. There will be [i]6 tiers[/i] in total, so after 2100 Hearts/Gifts are achieved all community goals will be completed, so let's do this!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/787f5173484df4c3d9baac759954b5b73051cbc4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/787f5173484df4c3d9baac759954b5b73051cbc4.jpg[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b281567df330ec42156df61bb82cb37f85decb1a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b281567df330ec42156df61bb82cb37f85decb1a.jpg[/img][/url]

[i]Note:[/i] In order to qualify for any community reward, you must complete at least your personal goal in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator or both. Each reward will be a Steam inventory item for both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator. Once completed, claim your reward on the Events page on your World of Trucks profile.

[i]The event will be concluded on Sunday the 17th of January at 23:59 UTC.[/i]

notes.title: Introducing Wyoming
notes.content:
After much guessing and debate, many of you came to the conclusion of which state we showcased in our recent teaser trailer. Today we are excited to share with you the U.S State which will be arriving next... 

[h2]Introducing Wyoming for American Truck Simulator[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7928446be65393763db2844cba8c799ea5d53de1.jpg[/img]

[/u][/b]Wyoming may be one of the least populated states in the U.S, but that doesn't mean that it lacks spectacular places to visit and see. Home to some of the country's most breathtaking national parks, Wyoming is best known for its red-walled gorges, hot springs, historic prairie towns, pioneer history, and historical attractions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/771d6c8ad64c1173e84250bdf20ac9bdc78e8d29.jpg[/img]

So why the Bison? Wyoming designated the American bison as the official state mammal in 1985, and to this day you can still find large herds of them grazing across the prairies and protected land which is designated for the conservation of wild bison since their decline across the U.S.

Eagle-eyed viewers of our recent Twitch streams may have spotted some accessories in the cab of our truck in American Truck Simulator. With questions and speculation being thrown back and forth around the community, we are happy to put those rumors to bed!

notes.title: #CruisingColorado Event Update
notes.content:
It took our #BestCommunityEver only 7 days to drive 60,000,000 miles in the currently ongoing #CruisingColorado World of Trucks event to pass the community goal. We are left speechless once again. Actually, you guys and gals have reached it so quickly we might even ask you to show us your cabin logbooks to check if you have had your regular driving breaks?! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2d60f5eaedf544d09957ba1275f7e506c972819d.jpg[/img]

Don't worry, we're just joking here. But it's always cool and motivating to see how fast and easily our fanbase can smash the "quests" we set for them. And how many of you are always ready to immediately join the events we create for you. We also love seeing all your tweets and posts under the #CruisingColorado hashtag over at any social media challenge we monitor. Want some number? Well, so far there have been posted more than [url=https://twitter.com/search?q=%23CruisingColorado&src=typed_query&f=live]1100 tweets[/url] on Twitter and [url=https://www.instagram.com/explore/tags/cruisingcolorado/]280 posts[/url] on Instagram! 

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-63sW7n0yYLc/X7ugCc8vADI/AAAAAAAAXLE/5699oU_KXgUWHQuRm0pCv-ADjSf4gHT0QCLcBGAsYHQ/s1280/socky_crusing_colorado.gif][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-63sW7n0yYLc/X7ugCc8vADI/AAAAAAAAXLE/5699oU_KXgUWHQuRm0pCv-ADjSf4gHT0QCLcBGAsYHQ/w640-h360/socky_crusing_colorado.gif[/img][/url]

According to the reactions and feedback upon the rewards which can be claimed in this event, for both personal and community goals, we guess you really like the new paint job and hanging cabin accessory. Don't forget to share how it fits your favorite truck, pals! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44ae1786e03d9754a85896ac6f75e322274e6cbb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/99edd79d6912927101a783fc475a272dd00b21ee.jpg[/img]

Even though we tried to explain it in our previous blog posts and communication over at our social media channels, we still have received some questions about the date till when this event is going to be kept active, or requests to not end this event even while the community goal is already reached. So please let us say it again here - you do not need to worry, because [b][u]we will keep the event running until well after Christmas, so there will be plenty of time to relax and enjoy the ride while earning your rewards.[/u][/b]

notes.title: Freightliner Cascadia® Announcement
notes.content:
Over the past weekend, we put out a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NAmtFjCJHHo]teaser video[/url] hinting at a new and upcoming truck that will arrive for American Truck Simulator. Many of our avid fans have immediately identified the make and model of the truck. The hype is real; with the awesome support from Daimler Trucks North America, you will soon get to drive the most popular truck on US' roads!

[h3]Introducing the Freightliner Cascadia® for American Truck Simulator[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4aa86e63ee421dfb5155612b5bbaf218bc0a48d9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b882d6cdc0d864ec83a0e3c26160bd87f3e086c8.jpg[/img]

To quote Freightliner's sales literature, "The Cascadia® is the most advanced on-highway truck Freightliner has ever offered. With more than one million hours of R&D and millions of miles of real-world testing, the Cascadia® is the result of sustained, concentrated investment in the future of trucking. Advanced aerodynamics help it slice through the air and boost fuel efficiency. Freightliner reimagined the Cascadia® interior, starting with the dashboard, which features an all-new instrument cluster and automotive-style steering wheel controls and switch placement, to meet driver needs. The Cascadia® is offered with the Integrated Detroit™ Powertrain, which integrates the most fuel-efficient DD15® and DD13® engines ever designed with the technologically advanced DT12™ On-Highway Series transmissions and specifically engineered Detroit™ steer and high-speed ratio tandem axles for optimal, efficient performance."

notes.title: Colorado Release
notes.content:
[b]The big day is here![/b] Preparations to release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Colorado for American Truck Simulator[/url] are in top gear. We are also preparing for a special release stream with special guests. So when exactly is Colorado releasing?

[b][h1]Colorado for American Truck Simulator will be released at 7pm Central European Time[/h1][/b][h3][b][i]( 10am PST, 1pm EST, 6pm GMT, 7pm MSK, 2am SST₊₁, 5am AEDT₊₁ , 7am NZDT₊₁ )[/i][/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=SiTFH7WXapU;full][/previewyoutube]
So what exactly does our Colorado DLC have to offer for truckers? These are just a few of the things we think you will love! 

[list]
[*] Drive from the great plains, through the Rocky Mountains to bustling cities and historical towns.
[*] Haul cargo on the Million Dollar Highway
[*] Discover Colorado's important industries like wind power factories or gold mines
[*] Deliver freight to and from the inside of a large cargo aircraft in Denver International Airport
[*] Admire representation of cities like Denver, Colorado Springs and many others
[*] Visit landmarks like the Four Corners Monument and get a bird's-eye view on it with the viewpoint feature
[*] Unlock Colorado-specific Steam achievements
[*] and Much More!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73cf6522fc6411f7a60c92f785173a3c59cd9419.jpg[/img]

And that shouldn't be the only reason to explore Colorado for yourself! As an added bonus we will also have a World of Trucks event for all new visitors to Colorado with unique rewards to be earned as you visit each city and deliver jobs. Learn more about the rules in our [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/11/cruisingcolorado-event-announcement.html]yesterday blog post[/url] and take part in [b]#CruisingColorado[/b] at [url=http://WorldofTrucks.com]WorldofTrucks.com[/url]. We'd love to see your photos across our Social Media channels using the hashtag!

We expect to have this event available to players for an extended period of time, probably way beyond the point of reaching the 60 million miles which is the current community goal. We don't want to motivate you to rush through the DLC in a hurry to make sure you manage to obtain the personal achievement. We simply want to reward early adopters of the DLC for spending quality time with the new content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f12cf0389de88109f624dd8629c78b04f7cdbfac.jpg[/img]

We will also be hosting a special Colorado release live-stream across official [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Steam[/url] & [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url] channels starting at 16:00 CET. 

Don't miss out on this broadcast as we talk with members of the map and research teams involved in the creation of Colorado and a special guest appearance from Pavel Šebor CEO of SCS Software! We will be answering questions from the community, talking in-depth about the DLC and of course, releasing Colorado LIVE on stream!

We hope you enjoy exploring what Colorado has to offer, we will see you on the roads!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/

notes.title: #CruisingColorado Event Announcement
notes.content:
With the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Colorado DLC[/url] releasing tomorrow, [b][u]November 12th[/u][/b], we'd like to celebrate by inviting you all to take part in our latest [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World Of Trucks event[/url] - [b]Cruising Colorado[/b]! We know many of you are as excited as we are to visit this beautiful Rocky Mountain state with its breathtaking views and historic places, and we are delighted to announce that this event will reward drivers who contribute to Colorado's local economy and industries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/70b17409415f0de01c5f7b13dd28c479bc1593cd.jpg[/img]

We are asking our [b]#BestCommunityEver[/b] to achieve the [b]community goal[/b] of driving [b][u]60,000,000 miles[/u][/b] (96,560,640 km) while delivering cargoes [b]to or from[/b] any city in Colorado. It doesn't matter what you haul, gold mining supplies, wind turbine parts, lumber, food, beverages, it all counts, every last delivery!
And, of course, you can use your own trailer during all of this in the external market!

Our Colorado DLC offers 13 fantastic and unique cities that we really want you to visit. So, we're offering a special reward for completing your [b]personal goal[/b], which will require you to deliver a job [b]to or from[/b] each of them. All jobs for the event need to be [b]100 miles[/b] each (161 km) or more, so be sure to read the rules.

We will keep the event running until well after Christmas, so there will be plenty of time to relax and enjoy the ride while earning your rewards. 

As you are [b]#CruisingColorado[/b] and adding up the job miles, we guarantee there will be new experiences for you like never before. Not to mention, we have included many new viewpoints, offering handcrafted cinematic views, highlighting the attractions of that area. 
[list][*]Visit the Four Corners Monument, the only point in the United States shared by four states.[/*][*]Take a drive through Wolf Creek Pass, located deep in the San Juan Mountains of Colorado.[/*][*]Drive over Red Cliff Bridge, a steel arch bridge that crosses over a beautiful valley.[/*][*]Truck along the I-70, a major east-west Interstate Highway that passes through Glenwood Canyon.[/*][*]
Take a job from Denver International Airport, the 5th busiest airport in the U.S. and home of famous Blucifer. 
[/*][/list]
Colorado, Nil sine numine (Nothing without providence), is our latest addition to American Truck Simulator. Know that as you wind down your cab window and settle in for the long haul, we'll be right there, cruising with you in spirit.  We can't wait to hear your thoughts about this incredibly beautiful, mountainous, triumphant, epic, and historic state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73cf6522fc6411f7a60c92f785173a3c59cd9419.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Rules[/b][/u]

Using [b]External Contracts[/b] or the [b]External Market[/b], with a [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url]-connected profile in American Truck Simulator,[b] the community goal is to drive 60,000,000 miles[/b] (96,560,640 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Colorado.
The cities are: Fort Collins, Sterling, Rangely, Steamboat Springs, Denver, Burlington, Colorado Springs, Grand Junction, Pueblo, Lamar, Montrose, Alamosa, Durango

When a player completes delivery [b]to or from[/b] each of the 13 Colorado cities, it will achieve their [b]personal goal. [/b]

[b]All jobs[/b] for the event need to be [b]at least 100 miles each[/b] (161 km), or more. 

You can check if your recent deliveries met these conditions using your [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/jobs]Log Book[/url] in your World of Trucks profile.

[u][b]Rewards[/b][/u]

[b]Personal goal: [/b]Players that deliver cargo [b]to or from[/b] each of the 13 Colorado cities will gain a personal [b]World of Trucks Achievement[/b] and an impressive Rocky Mountain Bighorn themed [b]ATS truck paint job[/b] Steam inventory item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/24e8a01d8cdb09056ec7dc446aa0a0c029e4873e.jpg[/img]

[b]Community goal[/b]: When the community goal of driving 60,000,000 miles (96,560,640 km) during deliveries [b]to or from any of the 13 cities[/b] in Colorado is met, and if the player has also achieved their personal goal, then they will receive a hanging [b]Rocky Rodeo Gem ornament[/b] Steam inventory item.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/683ad473ed0f640c43f20fa55b3a05e589927bfb.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/683ad473ed0f640c43f20fa55b3a05e589927bfb.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/99edd79d6912927101a783fc475a272dd00b21ee.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/99edd79d6912927101a783fc475a272dd00b21ee.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

We look forward to seeing drivers new and old exploring Colorado for the first time, and we would love to see photos from your first journeys across the state border! Share your screenshots and videos with us using the hashtag #CruisingColorado on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]Twitter[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url] profiles and we will share our favourite ones (we may even feature some of them in an upcoming blog post!).

notes.title: Hard Truck Tribute
notes.content:
[url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/10/colorado-springs-gameplay-video.html]In a recent blog post[/url], we released a gameplay video from our up and coming Colorado DLC for American Truck Simulator, which showcased a beautiful drive from Denver to Grand Junction. But, did you notice something about the truck we were driving? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/498dd06abdfc65a60a66500fadf084fa681bc578.jpg[/img]

Dedicated fans who have played our truck simulator titles as far back as the early 2000s may have recognized that the Kenworth W900 was sporting a familiar paint job from one of our earlier titles, Hard Truck: 18 Wheels of Steel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/df364383b6b10aba2ac1e590d717e919c2a6bb71.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f16d0cee8a36f959989d8a6190d03a6f15cd1152.jpg[/img]

Believe it or not, it has been 18 years since we released Hard Truck: 18 Wheels of Steel (August 2002), but that is not all. Denver, Colorado was also the starting location for all new truckers beginning their trucking life in Hard Truck: 18 Wheels of Steel. It's amazing to see how far we've come and we are excited to once again re-visit Denver in our current American Truck Simulator title. 

To celebrate this occasion, we wanted to reward our community with the Hard Truck Tribute Paint Job. This iconic flames design was available for the Kenworth W900 in Hard Truck: 18 Wheels of Steel and was a popular design among many drivers.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/369ec00664eccbaabcf75207d2a47549e6bf4d96.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e3539a71f1960914a01f93942cecda4198eb4db1.jpg[/img]

Every owner of the American Truck Simulator base game will be eligible to receive this paint job as a free gift, which will be available to use on all current truck models. To receive this special paint job, all you need to do is complete the following requirements: 

[list][*]Be registered on [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url][/*][*]Have your World of Trucks account connected to your American Truck Simulator game[/*][*]Pick any external contracts in American Truck Simulator from any location of your choice, however, the job must be [b]at least[/b] 500 miles long [/*][*]Complete this external contract job [/*][*]Claim your gift on your World of Trucks Event tab which can be found under 'My Page'[/*][/list]

You will have [b][u]until the 7th of February 2021, 23:59 UTC[/u][/b] to claim this Hard Truck Tribute Paint Job. After that time, you will be no longer able to obtain this paint job. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/47355901ae20a0e7c84b9d0755f5fe5e4779bcb2.jpg[/img]

So thank you, our #BestCommunityEver, for all of your incredible support! Whether you have been with us since our humble beginnings or just joined the trucking family recently, it means a lot to us and our team to have you a part of this journey. We look forward to many more years of life on the road with you, we still have a lot of exciting things in the pipeline for our trucking titles!

notes.title: ATS 1.39 Update Release
notes.content:
With lots of testing, feedback, fixing, and fine-tuning, we are excited to announce the arrival of update the 1.39 for American Truck Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1662589f96b32b35e2e5571134f508f071c37c33.jpg[/img]

We'd like to thank all those who took part in the 1.39 open beta and made bug reports and provided general feedback on this new version. We hope you can now begin to fully enjoy the various new features which are included within this update. So, what can you expect to find in the 1.39 update ATS?

 Lets us give you a quick recap of the most significant changes.

[previewyoutube=QGNhMXpyl6A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]LAUNCHPAD UPDATE[/b]

One of the first things you may notice when you launch American Truck Simulator with the 1.39 is a redesign of the current launchpad. The main reason why we are introducing this change is to pave the way for future additions; which will introduce new features to our games, that will be accessed through the launchpad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4289432fa0834ba8a4bb521e59abd8c756c1b3c4.png[/img]

Until then, however, you can see that the design has changed quite significantly, especially as user profiles are now accessed via a drop-down option from the top of the launchpad. You will also find that the DLC Browser, Mod Manager, and Profile Manager have been placed together for easier access, along with a new addition to the launchpad, Game Options. 

This allows you to change your game settings without even having to load the game. So if you're just looking to tweak your game before streaming on Twitch or adjusting a few options before heading into your truck, it can all be done from the launchpad screen. 

[b]LOWBOY TRAILERS[/b]

As we previously announced in a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/09/american-truck-simulator-lowboy-trailers.html]recent blog[/url], new Lowboy Trailers will be arriving to American Truck Simulator. These trailers have been reworked from the ground up, offering drivers the option to purchase them and use them in an array of different jobs including [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076080/American_Truck_Simulator__Forest_Machinery/]Forest Machinery[/url], and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/620610/American_Truck_Simulator__Heavy_Cargo_Pack/]Heavy Cargo DLC's[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/804ddce8cc740df895427a9a73858ad6a9fbf3e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7f3d95272c437c806cd95d910de861321b611f60.jpg[/img]

Owners of these trailers will benefit from a wide array of options to customize them in the upgrade shop, such as color, trailer accessories, beacons, chassis options, lengths, articulated axles, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/51d5a97a14118d82f28623764a4048e70d22f03b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/465d859bb422e8fff0097e2e65b88e28f5ea745b.jpg[/img]

You will also be able to spot them being hauled around by other truckers on the road, so make sure to give them plenty of space if you pass by one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5284d04f3c49794e9c17d393a172459264ae8b4e.jpg[/img]

[b]VIEWPOINTS[/b]

The release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Idaho[/url] for American Truck Simulator saw the introduction of a brand new feature that has not been placed in any other previous map release. Viewpoints allow drivers to activate a special in-game "cutscene" with a short showcase of a near location or place of interest such as an industry.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/281630782f69e4e74765160e76f2731e32d3432f.jpg[/img]

After Idaho's release, it was evident from the community's response that this was a popular feature and one that many of you would like to see expanded upon. While we continue to improve this new addition, we are excited to announce that viewpoints will be arriving in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/]Utah[/url]. Each state will receive 10 new cut-scenes to discover, which can be found nearby famous landmarks, national parks, and industries. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73a466b1602d3f0e150471f2d60b5e1cc927be1e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73a466b1602d3f0e150471f2d60b5e1cc927be1e.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21c83666fcc86274da2f38c06abd37fb76f870ab.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21c83666fcc86274da2f38c06abd37fb76f870ab.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb90adb1a6238510fe165a3607c08a9d9a371122.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb90adb1a6238510fe165a3607c08a9d9a371122.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3f712d0e1d64dd99a8598ca3ef956547ae0a3552.jpg[/img][/tr][/table]

That is not all, however, as viewpoints will now feature a few new functionalities for drivers. You will now have the new options to either skip the viewpoint or replay it if you wish to watch it again. Viewpoints will now also show as undiscovered grey '?' icons on your map until you have visited them for the first time. Also, there are more improvements for this cool new feature still in development, as we've gathered them through the amazing and most valuable feedback from our #BestCommunityEver!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/651d6b8fc2ccce82d05429540f3df3e2d4c74326.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bbff0d5aad9de65fa74e7d4d25383937746d6cb4.jpg[/img]


[b]GENERAL BUG FIXES/SOUND CHANGES[/b]

1.39 also features various bug fixes, improvements, and an update to sounds. This includes, but is not limited to, improved interior cab sound mixing, Western Star 49X truck bug fixes, and improvements, and other changes in preparation for new and upcoming content.

One of the changes you can find is the addition of the Turbo sound slider in the game's Options screen. When we introduced a separate channel for turbo sound some years back, it was hailed as a crucial enhancement to the simulation. We did our best to tune it properly based on actual in-cabin recordings. Indeed, many players commented very positively on it. However, over the years we have also been receiving feedback that the whistling sound may be too difficult to bear for some players. The new slider continues the trend of giving you more control over your simulation experience. We hope you enjoy this new addition plus a few other sound tweaks which come with it.

While a majority of the changes in 1.39 are not seen visually in this version, we look forward to bringing you more content and changes in the near future. 

[b]CHANGELOG[/b]

[b]MAP[/b]
[list]
[*] New Viewpoints in Washington and Utah DLCs
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Launchpad Re-design
[/list]

[b]VEHICLES[/b]
[list]
[*] Lowboy trailers (ownable, including articulated ones)
[/list]

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Viewpoint improvements (replayability, skip, map status, fade-out)
[*] Sound updates and improvements (turbo slider, sound positioning, cabin spatial mixing, sound distribution to accessories)
[*] Trailer browser & lister shows all valid cargo variants
[*] Experimental transmission input shaft emulation and clutch brake support (g_clutch_brake)
[/list]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: Wheel Tuning Pack DLC Update
notes.content:
Traditionally, a trucker in American Truck Simulator will spend their time driving mostly on tarmacked highways and roads on long haul journeys, however with the introduction of new industries in different states, it is no longer uncommon to find a job contract that delivers to an area off-road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/008b82d76f768b3c712f0e47de8beb2869c63648.jpg[/img]

With the continual development of our trucking titles, comes new industries and jobs, some of which require the drivers to move heavy and often large loads around off-road areas such as active mines on gravel roads and logging areas which are often hilly and muddy. Our next update to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/450550/American_Truck_Simulator__Wheel_Tuning_Pack/]ATS Wheel Tuning Pack DLC[/url] aims to help drivers who take these kind of jobs mores often.  

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e4cc5e83b5995c9f7bdd4db0e7c3e824622a9534.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e4cc5e83b5995c9f7bdd4db0e7c3e824622a9534.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a00e6cd2655100fd716b4a4f7f5d339f0e7e190e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a00e6cd2655100fd716b4a4f7f5d339f0e7e190e.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e10415db0ebc70761834b00ea4ce2d20de4700e4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e10415db0ebc70761834b00ea4ce2d20de4700e4.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
Today, we are happy to announce that new heavy-duty wheels will be arriving in the Wheel Tuning Pack DLC for American Truck Simulator. The new tyre has a deeper tread, plus a larger and wider size made from thicker rubber, which is the perfect combination for off-road truckers, but that isn't all.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/864f1c49e150220f812da556bd5fd43a326fc258.jpg[/img]

We are also updating all of our existing 14 rim designs so that they can fit our new wider heavy-duty wheels as well as rear super-single wheels. This mean you can continue to use your favorite rim designs for any job on or off-road.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/feac016eee77198ece1479ca82cbfd37e8f733d3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/feac016eee77198ece1479ca82cbfd37e8f733d3.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44a89dc2d87757271f94003bfaea3ec083c0808c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44a89dc2d87757271f94003bfaea3ec083c0808c.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
We hope you will enjoy this update to the Wheel Tuning Pack for ATS. We know how important it is for drivers to look after their truck with the right equipment and parts, so we are excited to see how the community will utilize these new additions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/27ebefa5f11032cebc1186ecd9f68239b2410807.jpg[/img]

notes.title: #CaptureIdaho Contest
notes.content:
With the recent release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Idaho[/url] for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url], the internet has been flooded with screenshots and videos from our community. From the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/trucksim/]/r/TruckSim[/url] Reddit to our [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]official Twitter[/url] profile, you have been sharing your journey across this new DLC and your favorite viewpoints along the way.

With so many screenshots to like and re-post, we wanted to give back to our community with the opportunity to earn rewards for sharing their travels; introducing #CaptureIdaho !

The contest is simple, capture a screenshot from the state of Idaho in American Truck Simulator, and share it with us across any of our official social media channels with the hashtag #CaptureIdaho. You could win some great rewards! 
So what should you capture? It can be anything from Idaho! We are encouraging you to get creative with this contest. You could take a photo of your favorite landmark, truck, scenic viewpoint, or even a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hd8vvWppdxg]pedestrian with sweet dance moves.[/url] 
Our team of specialist judges will be keeping a watch and making notes for some of their favorite screenshots. To make sure you understand the contest, here are the rules set to help you understand the entry requirements. 

[h2]Rules[/h2]
[list]
[*]Your screenshot [b]must be[/b] taken in the state of Idaho in American Truck Simulator.
[*]You must post your screenshot to any social media platform and include a tag to our official social media account and the hashtag #CaptureIdaho.
[/list]
You can find our official social media handles here: [url=http://instagram.com/scs.software/]SCS Software Instagram[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/scssoftware]SCS Software Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/]American Truck Simulator Facebook page[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]SCS Software Facebook page.[/url]

[list]
[*]Third-party modifications, editing, and post-processing [b]IS[/b] allowed (get creative!)
[*]You can enter as many times as you like, however, we encourage quality over quantity.
[*]The contest will end on the [b]3rd of September 2020.[/b]
[/list]
So what prizes can you win? Let's take a look at the rewards on offer here!

[h2]Prizes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]1st Place:[/b] a special T-shirt with + a 100€ voucher which can be used on our official e-shop + a Steam key for any of our released and available products on Steam
[*][b]2nd Place:[/b] a special T-shirt  + a 100€ voucher which can be used on our official e-shop
[*][b]3rd Place:[/b] a special T-shirt + a Steam key for any of our released and available products on Steam
[/list]
[b]PLUS[/b] we will choose 5 more winners who will also receive a special T-shirt!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/57eb0dc27af2351f2921050bbf4ad7f0aed00f66.png[/img]

We look forward to seeing all your entries and how you can #CaptureIdaho in a unique or different way! Plus if you want, join us on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Steam[/url] tomorrow from 18.00 CEST as we will do a live stream full of Idaho gameplay, Steam keys giveaway, and chatting with you, our #BestCommunityEver!

Don't forget, you will also have until the 16th of August to earn your #CruisingIdaho achievements and rewards (in-case you were looking to kill 2 birds with one stone) you can read more about that event at our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/2724065888612012350]previous blog post[/url]. Good luck and have fun!

notes.title: Idaho Release
notes.content:
The day has come and so has [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Idaho[/url]! Preparations for a release party are in top gear! We are also preparing for a special release stream with special guests. So when exactly is Idaho releasing?

[h3][b]Idaho for American Truck Simulator will be released at
09:00 PDT / 12:00 EST / 17:00 BST / 18:00 CEST /
 00:00 ₊₁ SGT / 02:00 ₊₁ AEST[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=4e0uztR4Ydk;full][/previewyoutube]

So what exactly does Idaho have to offer? This new expansion features:
[list][*]Over 3,300 miles of new roads to discover and explore[/*][*]11 new cities - drive through downtown Boise, Coeur d'Alene set on a gorgeous lake or Idaho Falls with a lovely touristic center[/*][*]A brand new viewpoint feature that gives you a new perspective of the world[/*][*]Expanded fan-favorite industries such as farming, timber harvesting or wood processing[/*][*]Visit the famous Craters of the Moon National Monument and Preserve[/*][*]Over 40 recognizable spots from the Historical Highway Marker program[/*][*]State-specific geographical landmarks such as canyons, valleys or basalt rock formations[/*][*]Many familiar truck stops and rest areas that truckers will know from the real world[/*][*]Finely-tuned road layouts and true-to-life signage[/*][*]Idaho-specific achievements to unlock[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/00eb4813d471592e24614d7076edf43f96337c18.jpg[/img]

And that shouldn't be the only reason to explore the State for yourself! As an added bonus we will also have a World of Trucks event for all new visitors to Idaho with unique rewards to be earned as you visit each city and deliver jobs. Learn more about the rules in our [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/07/cruising-idaho-event.html]yesterday blog post[/url] and take part in [b]#CruisingIdaho[/b] at [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]WorldofTrucks.com[/url]. We'd love to see your photos across our Social Media channels using the hashtag!

We expect to have this event available to players for an extended period of time, probably way beyond the point of reaching the 30 million miles community goal. We don't want to motivate you to rush through the DLC in a hurry to make sure you manage to obtain the personal achievement. We simply want to reward early adopters of the DLC for spending quality time with the new content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9f30419431304200efd19f890cc5fe88d618da5f.jpg[/img]

We will also be hosting a special Idaho release live-stream across Steam & Twitch starting at 15:00 CEST. Don't miss out on this broadcast as we talk with members of the map and research teams involved in the creation of Idaho and a special guest appearance from Pavel Šebor CEO of SCS Software! We will be answering questions from the community, talking in-depth about the DLC and of course, releasing Idaho LIVE on stream!

With the release of Idaho, we will also be making a new special Steam discount bundle available. Introducing the Pacific Northwest bundle which includes the American Truck Simulator base game as well as Idaho, Washington, Oregon, Forest Machinery DLCs, and the Classic Stripes Paint Jobs Pack. The way Steam bundles work, it's both a perfect bundle for any new drivers who are keen to make a start in their new truckin' career, as well as a way for the loyal fans to obtain the new DLC at a nice discount if you already own the previous DLCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21696c3bcae6dae8b2de6211f450e5bf7364bccb.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy exploring what Idaho has to offer, we will see you on the roads!

notes.title: Cruising Idaho Event
notes.content:
With the release of the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/] Idaho DLC[/url] just around the corner, we want to invite you, our #BestCommunityEver, to join us in Cruising Idaho - our latest [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World Of Trucks event[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9f30419431304200efd19f890cc5fe88d618da5f.jpg[/img]

We know drivers from around the world are excited to visit Idaho, and we are just as eager for you to get across the border for yourselves. That is why we are happy to announce this new event which will reward drivers who visit the Gem State and contribute to Idaho's local economy and industries.

The most important thing is to be [b]#CruisingIdaho[/b] and clocking up the job miles. We promise it will be worth it, with beauty to behold and a rich history to experience. You can even use your own trailer in the external market!

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e9c0ab203d40e5ce91f1f9ca5d40f79a25a8debe.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e9c0ab203d40e5ce91f1f9ca5d40f79a25a8debe.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

The community goal is simple. [u][b]Achieve 30,000,000 miles[/b][/u] (48,280,320 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Idaho. Technical supplies, farming produce, mining, and transportation equipment, household and building materials, supermarket goods, automotive fleets, and parts. In fact, you can deliver anything at all!

During your travels don't forget to stop at some of Idaho's many viewing platforms, each offering unique cinematic cutscenes, highlighting the attractions of that area. There's so much to see that we can't list it all, but here are some we can easily recommend.

[list][*]Take in the magnificent mountain vista of Galena summit.[/*][*]Cruise over the historic Perrine memorial bridge with its majestic views, including the Shosone Falls.[/*][*]Experience the volcanic Craters of the Moon National Monument.[/*][*]Take a snapshot at the famous 45th parallel north, halfway between the Equator and North Pole.[/*][*]See if you can spot Sharlie, the famous serpent, in McCalls' Payette Lake.[/*][*]Navigate through the craggy and imposing Grand View Canyon.[/*][*]Pull over to read some of the many Historical Markers that preserve the history of the early pioneers and Native Americans of Idaho.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9a79576b4f46d09c1099ae8ee96e872fb713ffed.jpg[/img]

There are 11 cities in the Idaho DLC and we want you to see them all. So, we're giving a special reward for completing your personal goal which will require job deliveries to or from all of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/265957df21b12f8d6f68a287e96396ca3e2f554f.jpg[/img]

Both the personal and community rewards are a reflection of Idaho's unique natural history and beauty, and we really think you will like them. But more on that in the rules, so please be sure to read them.

Idaho, Esto Perpetua (It is forever), is our latest addition to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Let's see her sites, breathe the air, and take in the grandness of this incredible and varied state.

[b][u]Rules:[/u][/b]

Using [b]External Contracts[/b] or [b]External Market[/b], with a [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url]-connected profile in American Truck Simulator, the [b]community goal[/b] is to achieve 30,000,000 miles (48,280,320 km) while delivering cargoes to or from any city in Idaho.

The cities are:

Sandpoint, Coeur d'Alene, Lewiston, Grangeville, Salmon, Boise, Ketchum, Idaho Falls, Nampa, Twin Falls, Pocatello.

When a player completes delivery [b]to or from[/b] all 11 Idaho cities, it will complete their[b] personal goal[/b].

All jobs for the event need to be[b] 100 miles [/b]each (161 km) or more.

To verify if you comply with the rules, you can review your recent deliveries in the [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/jobs]World of Trucks' LogBook[/url].

[b][u]Rewards:[/u][/b]

[b]Personal goal:[/b] Individual player contributions of deliveries, either to or from all 11 Idaho cities will gain that player a personal World of Trucks Achievement and a beautiful Appaloosa themed ATS truck paint job Steam inventory item.
