notes.title: ATS Washington Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
We have loved sharing with you our progress on Washington, and with the final touches being made to the map, we are now ready to confirm a date...

[h1][b]We are excited to announce that the Washington map expansion for American Truck Simulator will be released on the 11th of June, 2019.[/b][/h1]

We hope that this short trailer will give you a small glimpse on what you will be able to experience for yourself very soon.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rfMXLvxqgoI
And as you can see for yourself, Washington will be rich in content for drivers to explore.
[list]
[*] 3,800 miles of dense road network
[*] 16 brand new cities (Vancouver, Longview, Aberdeen, Olympia, Tacoma, Seattle, Everett, Port Angeles, Bellingham, Omak, Wenatchee, Yakima, Kennewick, Grand Coulee, Spokane, Colville)
[*] More than 20 landmark bridges
[*] 10 original truckstops
[*] Keystone-Port Townsend Ferry
[*] Spokane swing bridge
[*] Grand Coulee dam
[*] Washington's iconic mountains (Mount St. Helens and Mt. Rainier)
[*] Challenging logging cliff road
[*] Dynamic speed limits and LED signs
[*] New unique cargoes: aircraft engines, piggy back trucks, boat...
[*] Large and realistic ports (Seattle, Tacoma, Everett)
[*] Many unique junctions
[*] Distinct company docks: yacht builders, vast farms, material storages...
[*] Washington-specific achievements to unlock
[/list]

With the upcoming release of this map expansion, you will see news, reviews, images, and videos appearing online this coming weekend. With a plan to lift the embargo, the media as well as trusted friends of SCS Software will be able to openly start showing their footage from the map.

Additionally, on Thursday the 6th and Saturday the 8th of June we will be hosting a special Washington stream (on both our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SCSsoftware]Steam[/url]) featuring gameplay of the new map expansion and special guests who were involved in the making of Washington. They will be guiding you through this new state, hosting giveaways, talking with you in the chats and much more, so make sure to tune in from 4pm UTC on Thursday and 5pm UTC on Saturday!

Related Washington posts: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1712958942365784910]announcement[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/3476120204833251553]urban landmarks[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1813167203026377862]prefab building[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1815420464157583278]logging cliff road[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1741112145203423256]farming[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/2603552833072291363]landscapes[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1648790886583445844]Kenworth Renton assembly plant[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1621771190468691879]Everett aerospace factory[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/2565275416680147543]Mount St. Helens[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1622897728549571788]bridges[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1613891161339511970]Seattle[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1613891161350405834]Grand Coulee Dam[/url]

notes.title: ATS Update 1.35 Open Beta
notes.content:
Since version 1.34 for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] was more of a maintenance update, we understand how eager you all are for the 1.35 Open Beta - which is finally here!

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-5u_CCP1DUt0/XNQbEDvGHBI/AAAAAAAABkE/Y6VcAuOgaccyL5OLyPZsRZvcuBxrcwErACLcBGAs/s620/blog_ats_1_35_open_beta.jpg[/img]

Where to start? This update is yet again larger than any of its predecessors - and when we say "larger", we mean a LOT! There are changes in almost every part of our game, so let's get on it!

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-l2-iEWc5ARs/XNQxu2TpbqI/AAAAAAAABlQ/gVQeeoy5he0oX5-1xk-uJR2sfUcLHd1ngCEwYBhgL/s0/r02.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-l2-iEWc5ARs/XNQxu2TpbqI/AAAAAAAABlQ/gVQeeoy5he0oX5-1xk-uJR2sfUcLHd1ngCEwYBhgL/s300/r02.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-OEYopAnjqaE/XNQxvEFiqOI/AAAAAAAABlg/m8VA0tPhe00SlvzJzgRm7-pY_9FH_w2RgCEwYBhgL/s0/r03.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-OEYopAnjqaE/XNQxvEFiqOI/AAAAAAAABlg/m8VA0tPhe00SlvzJzgRm7-pY_9FH_w2RgCEwYBhgL/s300/r03.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] will receive two new roads, OR-58 and CA-299. OR-140 will also feature the final segment of its length. The Arizona sign system has also been improved along with Traffic lights (coming in later builds of the Open Beta) which have been re-worked for all current states.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-HXna1lnFm9A/XNQxwKHG_II/AAAAAAAABlk/tFGASJwmjgY1hVE9riOhi1UEEFRonU81gCEwYBhgL/s0/t2.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-HXna1lnFm9A/XNQxwKHG_II/AAAAAAAABlk/tFGASJwmjgY1hVE9riOhi1UEEFRonU81gCEwYBhgL/s300/t2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-1UMxVWdKNLE/XNQxvkz7n-I/AAAAAAAABlY/0C8QBKpi9yoD-8j6lB6eEPHWzOlCorGwQCEwYBhgL/s0/t1.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-1UMxVWdKNLE/XNQxvkz7n-I/AAAAAAAABlY/0C8QBKpi9yoD-8j6lB6eEPHWzOlCorGwQCEwYBhgL/s300/t1.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-UGIiki1sU-k/XNQxwC5iX9I/AAAAAAAABlc/WRgS4w6p55girZ6jfITLAo4X0U1h94grQCEwYBhgL/s0/t3.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-UGIiki1sU-k/XNQxwC5iX9I/AAAAAAAABlc/WRgS4w6p55girZ6jfITLAo4X0U1h94grQCEwYBhgL/s300/t3.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-lk60xdE9Zg0/XNQxwRDbxEI/AAAAAAAABlg/4QAx9FE0Z3IDTSJO1ubnM2-udA-X83SzQCEwYBhgL/s0/t4.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-lk60xdE9Zg0/XNQxwRDbxEI/AAAAAAAABlg/4QAx9FE0Z3IDTSJO1ubnM2-udA-X83SzQCEwYBhgL/s300/t4.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Besides the various new trailers listed in the change-log (B-doubles of all types, chip van trailers, container trailers, etc) and new cargoes, vehicles in our game also received some new features. This includes three windscreen wiper settings which will help drivers handle the improved rain, an accessory browser for owned trailers, expandable container trailers and a copy function for your truck and trailer configuration - which will come in handy, as your company continues to grow.

From the list of new general additions, some longtime wishes take first spots. One of those is a highly demanded option to use your own trailers for external contracts ([url=https://worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url] jobs). From now on, you can!

DX11 experimental support. It's exactly as it sounds - most of the work on DX11 support is done, so the majority of its aspects are working quite well in our games and feedback from Experimental Beta promises a nice increase of FPS.  Still - it's not in its final state, so use it only at your own risk. Although we'll be grateful for your feedback.

[img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-YBm_wKpILwg/XNQxuM8pYhI/AAAAAAAABkc/L3GHSOeQufcwzjB3a_nZwbLij-bFu77_ACEwYBhgL/s620/drivers.jpg[/img]

Now comes a number of "smaller" additions, based mostly on your suggestions. A large amount of new hireable drivers have been added, so as your trucking empire grows you can expand much more than previously. To help with that growth, we've also added an option to purchase garages online (without the need of having to discover the city previously).

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-pLftbrxu8lU/XNQxw5QlGkI/AAAAAAAABlo/VyYhun_BYewpyo2jmezGlzfSaT16GQ8iQCEwYBhgL/s0/ui.png][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-pLftbrxu8lU/XNQxw5QlGkI/AAAAAAAABlo/VyYhun_BYewpyo2jmezGlzfSaT16GQ8iQCEwYBhgL/s300/ui.png[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-qvPHZNxj6kM/XNQxubBqOLI/AAAAAAAABlk/u2dlA656bwcO29h5-F5KUSczmK1wFmrTgCEwYBhgL/s0/garage.png][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-qvPHZNxj6kM/XNQxubBqOLI/AAAAAAAABlk/u2dlA656bwcO29h5-F5KUSczmK1wFmrTgCEwYBhgL/s300/garage.png[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-R-Y1yRqhtjc/XNQxtXbfImI/AAAAAAAABlg/-54ziWAkTykfvmwbXafjy4nxLjcolG68ACEwYBhgL/s0/01.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-R-Y1yRqhtjc/XNQxtXbfImI/AAAAAAAABlg/-54ziWAkTykfvmwbXafjy4nxLjcolG68ACEwYBhgL/s300/01.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-zmLpgGNkfsM/XNQxtVDWCEI/AAAAAAAABlc/w0D9Se9eO6MR1tM8mzRkHCj3exOMgdoFwCEwYBhgL/s0/02.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-zmLpgGNkfsM/XNQxtVDWCEI/AAAAAAAABlc/w0D9Se9eO6MR1tM8mzRkHCj3exOMgdoFwCEwYBhgL/s300/02.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Another helpful feature is emergency refuelling, which will be an important option for those loving to drive on the edge (why do so many of you like to go with empty tanks?). And to make your travels a little bit more diverse and interesting, you'll now see STAA doubles in traffic.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-lm3bFt72ro8/XNQxvTvgdPI/AAAAAAAABk0/ThnI9Ru6Ow8Jf5DTuxIs_TFkJYRf9Ob7gCEwYBhgL/s0/razer.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-lm3bFt72ro8/XNQxvTvgdPI/AAAAAAAABk0/ThnI9Ru6Ow8Jf5DTuxIs_TFkJYRf9Ob7gCEwYBhgL/s300/razer.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-7pZFHhfhLF8/XNQxtZXpJTI/AAAAAAAABkU/sqVWTDvENbIn-CYrnE7ueFcQUwuqXMLHACEwYBhgL/s0/Tracker4c_white_bg.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-7pZFHhfhLF8/XNQxtZXpJTI/AAAAAAAABkU/sqVWTDvENbIn-CYrnE7ueFcQUwuqXMLHACEwYBhgL/s300/Tracker4c_white_bg.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Considering all these changes, the UI had to change drastically. Players who helped us by entering the Experimental Beta have reported no serious issues with it, so we hope you'll have no problems as well. And to close the list, there're many new input improvements and official support for external peripheries.

[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so [u]you may encounter bugs, instability, kinks or crashes[/u]. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewtopic.php?f=178&t=271053]forum[/url] and your bug reports in [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=263]this section[/url].[/b]

notes.title: Razer Chroma gets official support
notes.content:
We're happy to announce the upcoming arrival of the official support for [url=https://www.razer.com/chroma]Razer Chroma[/url] in both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url]. Starting with the 1.35 Update, our games will support Razer keyboards, mouses and RGB mousemats (headset will use only one colour scheme). Sure, you might think what's the big deal about some "game of lights", but take a look at our video and the list of functions below. Adds a little bit extra to the immersion, doesn't it?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cbaxzoKHCTw

[list]
[*]During the tutorial, the keys being currently explained will be distinguished by colours and the "continue" key will be blinking green[/*]
[*]Some keys will be active only when the truck electrics is on[/*]
[*]Steering left/right and throttle/brake keys are distinguished by colour (typically WASD keys)[/*]
[*]Key for the parking brake is lit when active and blinking when the engine is on[/*]
[*]Lights keys show lights state (parking, low beam, high beam)[/*]
[*]Blinker keys are blinking (the same goes for all speeds of flasher and wipers)[/*]
[*]Gear up/ down keys are active only for non-automatic gearbox[/*]
[*]Camera keys are distinguished by colour and the active camera key is different[/*]
[*]Route Advisor pages keys are distinguished by colour and the active page key is different[/*]
[*]Trailer connect key shows state of the trailer: green for available connect, red for connecting in progress, green blinking for job delivery[/*]
[*]Activation key (typically Enter) is blinking when activation possible (eg. gas station, toll etc.)[/*]
[*]When pumping gas, the keyboard shows tank state and there is a falling wave visualizing flowing gas. When full, the keyboard is green[/*]
[*]Key for the differential lock is lit when the differential is locked and it blinks when there is a differential lock warning in Route Advisor[/*]
[*]When the job is finished, a wave goes across the keyboard, mouse and mousepad in colour of the received medal[/*]
[*]Police fine keyboard blinking[/*]
[*]When the truck is damaged a red wave moves across the keyboard[/*]
[*]All keys and other accessories slowly pulse when the job's time is running out[/*]
[*]Mouse and mousepad's left side LEDs show current player speed in green and in red when the player is speeding[/*]
[*]The cruise control key is yellow when CC can be turned on, blue when it is on. Keys for CC speed up and down are lit when CC is on[/*]
[*]Keys for lifting axle and trailer axle are lit only when lifting is available[/*]
[*]Cvar g_color_feedback can be used to disable colour feedback altogether. This cvar can also be set in Options > Controls > Color feedback.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: New trailers in upcoming ATS update 1.35
notes.content:
We are working hard on the new Update 1.35 for both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. It's shaping up to be one of the biggest updates ever. We plan for an extensive open beta period, but there is still a lot of internal testing and tweaking left to do before we reach that stage. A series of upcoming blog posts will focus on key new features and new content.

In today's post, we want to focus on new types of trailers and loads coming to American Truck Simulator with Update 1.35. The new additions will be very handy in the Pacific Northwest!

Chip van trailers are coming to service the woodworking industry especially in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/]Oregon[/url] and in our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington state[/url] map expansion. They will be available with three body variants: van, moving floor, and iconic belly van. notes.title: ATS update 1.34: Buyable log trailer, more roads!
notes.content:
After the content-loaded updates from previous months, 1.34 is a relatively small maintenance update serving primarily to introduce new content prepared by our vehicle department. The next big things planned need more time in development, and we anticipate 1.35 to be a lot juicier. Still, we believe these new additions will please players of both of our games. The limited scope of this update is also the reason why there wasn't an Open Beta. So what do we have for you?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9084219/2336febfec6ba4717e8b91e2464480b0c2ff3ed7.jpg[/img]

American Truck Simulator receives one of the highly demanded additions to the game - buyable log trailers! Our traffic report sources for Oregon shows a large convoy inbound for the wood transport companies, with a high chance of traffic jams on the forest roads, so be careful out there. As an alternative route, we can recommend OR-140, which is now prolonged all the way to Nevada. And if you're still worried about driving in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/]Oregon[/url], we recommend visiting the Tonopah city, which has been completely refreshed.

notes.title: Vote for us in Steam Awards 2018
notes.content:
We are really proud that Euro Truck Simulator 2 has been nominated for this year's Steam Awards. We still remember the total surprise when the game was nominated in two categories back in 2016, and the even larger shock when it won the two awards. The competition is always massive, there are so many new great games appearing every year, and so many oldies but goldies still on people's minds. Fortunately, it's obviously also the case with ETS2, and it's truly great to see it nominated for the "Most Fun with a Machine" Award.

We would like to express our sincere thanks to our fans, the nomination is a true sign of the power of the fan community!

Now that the voting starts, we'll once again rely on your kind support. There are five really strong contenders in the category, but we can dream big. ːrlroadhogː A somewhat funny aspect of it is that three of the games nominated for the "Most Fun with a Machine" Award have been developed in our home city - Prague, Czech Republic. Looks like there are a lot of geeks living here obsessed with developing games related to cool machines! :)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwards/2018/][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-7kNVhpC_lEk/XBo35Jkph6I/AAAAAAAACZ0/cWrcjNMuxnohUgg8ko-fKOupyerRa0rrACLcBGAs/s620/nominee.jpg[/img][/url]

Anyway, the nominations are a great start, but we are far from finished. To stand a chance, we need you to vote again. We ask all truckers, drivers, and sim enthusiasts: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwards/2018/]Vote for ETS2, together we can do it![/url]

The voting opens December 20th, and closes January 3rd. The winners will be announced in February 2019.

ETS2 is the proud holder of two Steam Awards 2016. Can we earn a third trophy?

[img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-gAxq6kBaFE8/XBoNAvvtxkI/AAAAAAAACZk/4WMFALbUeV4yZCIfngCJJSu-utV49mt5gCLcBGAs/s620/steam_award_winner_2016.jpg[/img]

[h1]Stream[/h1]

We're also currently streaming, watch the stream on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SCSsoftware]developer page[/url] or on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch.[/url]

notes.title: International Christmas Gifts Delivery Event 2018
notes.content:
It's that time of year again where we sit down and write down lists of presents to send to Santa. Thanks to modern technology at the North Pole, creating gifts and sending them anywhere in the world is easier than ever for Santa's team!

[img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-Za99bi_ovHA/XBdYKoBv-kI/AAAAAAAARFo/cTCS3NHnnhY_lBOcGdsanhDJ64WESTqCgCLcBGAs/s620/blog_body_xmas.jpg[/img]

So it is no surprise that the demand for international gift shipping is higher than ever before. With the Christmas season fast approaching, logistic companies across Europe and the US are under pressure to take on extra drivers to deliver expected gifts internationally and on-time to those eagerly awaiting them.

Logistic companies across both continents are putting out the call to all drivers to aid in this huge effort to ship large amounts of holiday gifts across the USA and Europe, and to help sweeten the deal, offer bonus incentives for drivers who complete at least 12 deliveries to and from the major shipping hubs on both sides of Europe and America!

It won't be an easy task, but if we work together along with some much-needed festive treats, songs and truck decorations, we can all help in bringing some much-needed aid to help deliver Christmas on time!

[h1]International Gift Delivery - Rules:[/h1]

For personal contribution, using External Contracts, complete at least 12 deliveries of Christmas cargo in either [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Personal progress is counted in each game separately.

Any job with the following cargo counts towards event completion:
[list]
[*]Christmas Candy Canes
[*]Christmas Ornaments
[*]Christmas Candles
[*]Christmas Wooden Gifts
[*]Christmas Crackers
[*]Christmas Chocolates
[*]Christmas Socks
[*]Christmas Tree Lights
[*]Christmas Traditional Cookies
[*]Christmas Decorations
[/list]

This is also a transcontinental community event. A combined community effort within [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. Aim for [b][u]1,000,000[/u][/b] deliveries to earn a special reward!

[url=https://www.worldoftrucks.com/en/]You can view community progress here.[/url]

[h1]Rewards:[/h1]

For your personal contribution, you will receive:

[b][u]Euro Truck Simulator 2:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]World of Trucks exclusive achievement
[*]An exclusive paint job combo for your truck & trailer - "Starlight Burst"
[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-rFiqv5xPIIg/XBJkGiaYZJI/AAAAAAAARB8/nvLu692mEGs3Idls3v1aj1ocE1adnzOtACLcBGAs/s0/ETS2_reward_xmas_paintjob.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-rFiqv5xPIIg/XBJkGiaYZJI/AAAAAAAARB8/nvLu692mEGs3Idls3v1aj1ocE1adnzOtACLcBGAs/s620/ETS2_reward_xmas_paintjob.jpg[/img][/url]
[/list]
[b][u]American Truck Simulator:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]World of Trucks exclusive achievement
[*]An exclusive paint job combo for your truck & trailer - "Edge Tracer"
[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-GuYbgN9R6e4/XBJkYp7I21I/AAAAAAAARCE/VpUdw2no5rwYC9v6jlZzFXhl9FkGGKGKgCLcBGAs/0/ATS_xmas_paintjob_reward.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-GuYbgN9R6e4/XBJkYp7I21I/AAAAAAAARCE/VpUdw2no5rwYC9v6jlZzFXhl9FkGGKGKgCLcBGAs/s620/ATS_xmas_paintjob_reward.jpg[/img][/url]
[/list]
[b][u]When the community goal is accomplished everyone will receive:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]A special hanging accessory - "Magical Spiral"
[*]A stylish menu background for your game - "First Class"
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RmmuI0tcDqI
[/list]

[b]Bonus:[/b] If you manage to complete your personal contribution in both games (12 ETS2 + 12 ATS  deliveries), you'll receive a neat, cute and special interior decoration reward to both games.

[i]Note: In order to qualify for the community reward, you must complete at least your personal contribution in either of the games. All in-game rewards are tradable and marketable Steam Inventory items.[/i]

The event will be concluded on January 13th, 23:59 UTC.

notes.title: ATS update 1.33 is out!
notes.content:
We are happy to release American Truck Simulator Update 1.33 out of open beta! Thanks to everyone who helped us verify the stability of the new features. We kept testing the ATS update a bit longer to make sure that there were no surprises with the new detours feature, and fortunately it looks like the reactions to it are all positive. We'll keep tweaking the feature in upcoming updates, and of course we owe it also to players of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] - once we create the relevant new graphics content depicting the blocked roads.

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-ZdcyDVkBESw/XAqjHW0R9hI/AAAAAAAABQk/c5TW6LK1BskYiettorLI-nzkTrdTBKE5ACLcBGAs/s620/blog_ats_1_33_update.jpg[/img]

As both our flagship sims are running on the same codebase, American Truck's update benefited from the extended Experimental and Open Beta programs we have tried ahead of Euro Truck 2's new update. We are very likely to repeat the process again for most of the upcoming updates.

Even when we are not currently in open beta, we'd like to invite you to provide your feedback, input, wishes, and critique on our forums. We keep monitoring the message boards pretty much every day. The old school forums often work better for a discussion thread taking place across several days or weeks, compared to the typical quick fire and forget exchanges on newer generation social media.

Features are described in depth in the open beta announcement:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1714079132251894910
Enjoy all the new additions and happy trucking. By the way, which changelog video do you like more?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bcLccszlsA4
[b]To enjoy the 1.33 update, make sure to OPT OUT of beta branches and your game will be updated automatically on Steam.[/b]

notes.title: ATS Update 1.33 Open Beta
notes.content:
When there was no announcement of a Beta for American Truck Simulator, some of you were worried that Euro Truck Simulator 2 is getting all the love. It's true that ETS2 acutely needed an update to enable us to release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/925580/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Beyond_the_Baltic_Sea/]Beyond the Baltic Sea[/url] map expansion, but there is more to ATS taking a bit longer out of the gate. Let's check the story below. We are proud to bring you American Truck Simulator Update 1.33 Open Beta, packed with new features!

[img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-Cbrb7e02u28/W_2ARaYKwlI/AAAAAAAABP0/N6JhdbJiIUgJgpniT-B9c2lgmxe1iKKnwCLcBGAs/s620/blog_ats_1_33_open_beta.jpg[/img]

As a counterpart to HCT trailers in Europe, ATS 1.33 brings you Turnpike double trailers (up to 100 ft). These trailers are pretty difficult to handle - in reality, they are in use only on specific roads built to meet their limitations. As of now, they are only allowed in Nevada in our game. You won't find jobs involving turnpike double trailers in freight market or quick jobs. The only way to use them is is to buy them (same as with HCT in Euro Truck 2) so that new players are not exposed to a challenge beyond their skill level.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Pd2F_ihqac4/W_17V3fb9PI/AAAAAAAABPE/n8teVZUV4uwj7fSLivCKxxPbQcHNTpt2ACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_20181127_152852_00.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Pd2F_ihqac4/W_17V3fb9PI/AAAAAAAABPE/n8teVZUV4uwj7fSLivCKxxPbQcHNTpt2ACEwYBhgL/s300/ats_20181127_152852_00.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-M6R1w6Bf56U/W_17V9_BLdI/AAAAAAAABPg/9PoJMkJMIOMGZ4kxLWZgk9VQMCUchSNBACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_20181126_161714_00.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-M6R1w6Bf56U/W_17V9_BLdI/AAAAAAAABPg/9PoJMkJMIOMGZ4kxLWZgk9VQMCUchSNBACEwYBhgL/s300/ats_20181126_161714_00.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

There is one unique (and temporarily exclusive) new feature in ATS 1.33 - detours. We needed some time and focus to thoroughly review it internally before a public test, and this was the very reason why we avoided doing open betas for both games at the same time.

The goal of this feature is to introduce a bit of uncertainty into planning of your routes. The world in our games tends to be very predictable, while in reality the truck driver cannot take everything for granted. We wanted our players to have to improvise occasionally, and hence the concept of detours was born.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-l3g0amr4ZBg/W_17Wl6rA5I/AAAAAAAABPg/zOEYbdy_NawD79XcALQgmAR8V88XsFlJgCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5bfd3921_21.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-l3g0amr4ZBg/W_17Wl6rA5I/AAAAAAAABPg/zOEYbdy_NawD79XcALQgmAR8V88XsFlJgCEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5bfd3921_21.jpg[/img][/url]

From time to time you'll find the road ahead of you blocked, maybe with state police waving you to go a different way, forcing you to remap your route. Or to search your memory for another option to reach your destination if you're so hardcore that you do not use the GPS. There'll always be a guaranteed way to deliver your cargo. But sometimes it can take more time than you'd be comfortable with, or move you away from the gas stations where you planned to refuel and get some rest. Detours are adding some adrenaline to the driver's job.

Think of this addition as "phase one" and please do give us your feedback. We hope that you will appreciate our ambition to spice up the universe of our games to make it feel more alive and dynamic.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-hDo7q7QNzz4/W_17W819c8I/AAAAAAAABPo/0NUWGuyAvs4bVCo2sbqBxzDw_pJbcMQ4gCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5bfd40b3_16.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-hDo7q7QNzz4/W_17W819c8I/AAAAAAAABPo/0NUWGuyAvs4bVCo2sbqBxzDw_pJbcMQ4gCEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5bfd40b3_16.jpg[/img][/url]

For those of you hungry for new tarmac, we've added the first segment of OR-140. It remained on our wish-list for Oregon, and we are now catching up. We know how important this road is (trucking-wise) and its significance as "a shortcut", allowing you to avoid the long way around via US-20, or through California. The section we open today connects Lakeview and Klamath, a future extension we are also considering should reach to Nevada.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-2zZkhPWegxg/W_17WksuzII/AAAAAAAABPc/dgZ6hMEdCkUYA0DOPiyovXq97TzgAmpEACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5bfc1bc7_10.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-2zZkhPWegxg/W_17WksuzII/AAAAAAAABPc/dgZ6hMEdCkUYA0DOPiyovXq97TzgAmpEACEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5bfc1bc7_10.jpg[/img][/url]

The list of changes continues with the features that we have introduced in ETS2 1.33 already. You may have spotted them outlined in our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=19V0Xgx64hY&t=5s&ab_channel=SCSSoftware]1.33 update video[/url].

Steam cloud-based profiles have received very positive reaction. Saving the game to a "cloud" can prevent potential loss of your profile due to a computer malfuction, or when changing your machine. It will also allow you to play on multiple computers without the need to carry a flash drive with you.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/--MvvlL1c5Yk/W_17WRnRkvI/AAAAAAAABPk/0VtAdSHtQ7YvkQCYo-CTH4blnKC45dRVQCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5bfc1a92_09.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/--MvvlL1c5Yk/W_17WRnRkvI/AAAAAAAABPk/0VtAdSHtQ7YvkQCYo-CTH4blnKC45dRVQCEwYBhgL/s300/ats_hq_5bfc1a92_09.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Q9eB6PEExFw/W_17V7q26-I/AAAAAAAABPs/2eiClCwm4S8at9m-hz1E_SSooGa8d6zxACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5bfc1a2e_11.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Q9eB6PEExFw/W_17V7q26-I/AAAAAAAABPs/2eiClCwm4S8at9m-hz1E_SSooGa8d6zxACEwYBhgL/s300/ats_hq_5bfc1a2e_11.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Reusable truck and trailer configuration templates also received a pretty warm welcome, as the life of a big fleet manager became much easier. We have some ideas to take the feature even further in the future, but we believe it's going to be a great time-saver for many players in its current form already.

Minor changes include improved rain drop behavior on the windshield, music shuffling and localization for names of states (countries).

For people having issues with blinking lights, we've added a new cvar. Try different settings with writing g_disable_beacons 0/ 1/ 2 in the console. We hope that one of these will suit you well.

[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, and kinks. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewtopic.php?f=178&t=264236]forum[/url] and your bug reports in this [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=246]section[/url].[/b]

[b]If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.33 public beta. No password required.[/b]

notes.title: Halloween is Creeping Our Way
notes.content:
The ancient Halloween celebration dating back to [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Halloween]Celtic harvest festivals and perhaps even deeper[/url] is almost here. Over centuries and especially in recent decades, it has evolved into a community-centered holiday directed mainly at the young. It is now actually the second largest commercial holiday in Northern America.

As every year, Steam Store is observing the holiday with a sale, and we are no exception with our games and DLC - discounts are in place over most of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SCSsoftware]our library[/url].

We are taking advantage of having available a Halloween-themed paint job pack for both of our flagship truck sims to come up with limited-time bundles. They should be very interesting for newcomers to the genre, mixing the base games with new cool add-ons. As the bundles are of the type "complete the set," they should also be attractive for trucking game veterans who are looking to complement their existing ATS or ETS2 portfolio with new stuff.
[list][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1807/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2_Halloween_Special/]Euro Truck Simulator 2 Halloween Special[/url][/*][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1813/American_Truck_Simulator_Halloween_Special/]American Truck Simulator Halloween Special[/url][/*][/list]
We have a small surprise for the owners of ATS Halloween Paint Job Pack - we have added a new trailer paint job to the DLC...

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-BToWkcRWgfE/W9YG5aC5r-I/AAAAAAAACiY/tIGSBxvy3FUVzDrTDUQRvPkWiZR2HBQgACLcBGAs/s0/ats_hq_5bc5f0ab_08.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-BToWkcRWgfE/W9YG5aC5r-I/AAAAAAAACiY/tIGSBxvy3FUVzDrTDUQRvPkWiZR2HBQgACLcBGAs/s620/ats_hq_5bc5f0ab_08.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Oregon expansion releasing next week

Let us prime you for next Thursday with a cool video trailer celebrating this announcement:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wilAbkIhZcE

Please find the feature list and additional information on Oregon's Steam page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/

We will also keep on working on the launch-day video trailer to make a yet bigger splash at the release.

notes.title: ATS Update 1.32 Open Beta
notes.content:
The open beta of American Truck Simulator update 1.32 is available now, bringing most of the additions ETS2 received [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/scs_games#announcements/detail/1716321419875422349]a week ago[/url] plus some ATS specific bonuses.

[u][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/u] Due to the scope and scale of the major changes to the game, in order to receive as much feedback as possible, we're sharing this open beta with the community earlier than usual in the development cycle. There are still minor known issues that we're working on, and it’s possible there are even bigger bugs hidden away that we hope you’ll help us discover. If you think that the risk and possible frustration with an unstable and unpolished beta is worth it for you, make sure to backup your player profile to have a safe way to revert to 1.31 in case you get tired of testing. Many mods may have become broken due to extensive data format and logic changes. An early open beta gives the mod authors a chance to start making the necessary changes right away, but for testing at this moment, you may need to disable most mods just to get things working.

With the disclaimer out of the way, let's focus on different elements of this open beta.

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-2GNAavpOlYk/W3Q-GVyRFOI/AAAAAAAABDk/31F6sJucpyASqeqcJIhymCB54pwU-vpvQCLcBGAs/s0/blog_ats_1_32_open_beta.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-2GNAavpOlYk/W3Q-GVyRFOI/AAAAAAAABDk/31F6sJucpyASqeqcJIhymCB54pwU-vpvQCLcBGAs/s620/blog_ats_1_32_open_beta.jpg[/img][/url]

Those reading the blog on a regular basis already know that the major addition coming in 1.32 is trailer ownership. So all the ATS players can now buy, tune and paint their trailers too. And since the laws and rules are a little bit different in the USA than in Europe, we added the option to use Long/Wide vehicles and Oversize Load banners to the trailer tuning options. Just don't forget to lock the trailers up if you want to use them only for yourself, since your employees might decide to try them out too!

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-lsZD6_fn_kQ/W3Q9tNIPDmI/AAAAAAAABDc/uJCiESKyFEItg5Tr3Rxv4HCJul9M0ke9wCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_20180815_155745_00.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-lsZD6_fn_kQ/W3Q9tNIPDmI/AAAAAAAABDc/uJCiESKyFEItg5Tr3Rxv4HCJul9M0ke9wCEwYBhgL/s620/ats_20180815_155745_00.jpg[/img][/url]

Same as in ETS2, some of the trailers were discarded and redesigned, while the rest was adjusted for trailer ownership.  This is just the first stage, as development is still ongoing – and will continue for at least a few more months of hard work. But we didn't want to keep you waiting for the final result when the actual state of trailer ownership allows us to let you play with these new toys already :)

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-lD3pJB8duME/W3Q9tMCKc3I/AAAAAAAABDc/PQZRdyEkoJM0Wkhx2X27roJmG3qBdtBjwCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5b73dd9e_07.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-lD3pJB8duME/W3Q9tMCKc3I/AAAAAAAABDc/PQZRdyEkoJM0Wkhx2X27roJmG3qBdtBjwCEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5b73dd9e_07.jpg[/img][/url]

With trailer ownership came the need to add "icons" to access the new functionality through the game's central "desktop" main menu, so we reorganized the user interface screen. You’ll probably notice that there are two larger widgets on the right side of the screen now, instead of three smaller ones. Also, new screens for trailer management have been added, and some company management screens had to be changed to handle the new feature.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-JG4rSHGaMmo/W3Q9tjB6L0I/AAAAAAAABDU/ClrLl3ZL4-IObFmHmkTlmGrrBopIUx5fACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5b73efa1_08.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-JG4rSHGaMmo/W3Q9tjB6L0I/AAAAAAAABDU/ClrLl3ZL4-IObFmHmkTlmGrrBopIUx5fACEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5b73efa1_08.jpg[/img][/url]

The next addition brings changes in the map. The ATS map design team felt that some gaps in the map deserved to be filled, while some other previous work should get a retouch. So in this update, ATS receives three new roads: US-550 – from Albuquerque to Bloomfield (Farmington), US-95 from Yuma to Quartsize (Ehrenberg) and US-191 which connects I-10 and US-60. Also, the intersection of I-5 and I-80 has been razed to the ground and built completely from scratch.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-UZp5eSmFay4/W3Q9tMZfYlI/AAAAAAAABDc/BG-6EDxFIUcNAl7-0qGSV4f7x9keO5UMACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5b72e16d_08.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-UZp5eSmFay4/W3Q9tMZfYlI/AAAAAAAABDc/BG-6EDxFIUcNAl7-0qGSV4f7x9keO5UMACEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5b72e16d_08.jpg[/img][/url]

When driving on US-191, right by the newly added small city of Clifton, you'll discover Morenci Mine, the biggest copper mine in the United States. Surely a good place to visit, since there’s also a new cargo dock!

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-ArS-5iUf6Hg/W3Q9t-zLMEI/AAAAAAAABDY/kyVaOFyAXBAQAuMQ7b4Hc5d9P6v8nymIQCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5b740cba_08.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-ArS-5iUf6Hg/W3Q9t-zLMEI/AAAAAAAABDY/kyVaOFyAXBAQAuMQ7b4Hc5d9P6v8nymIQCEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5b740cba_08.jpg[/img][/url]

As for other changes, the new ATS update brings trailer cables on AI trucks and one new restriction – long trailers (53 feet – 40+ feet from kingpin to rear axle) are now forbidden in California. Plus one of the community's smaller wishes – parking brake is now disabled by default; those who liked this function need to turn it back on in game options.

Several changes to the code and data were made, related to rendering optimization, and it appears to have brought very nice framerate improvements in some scenarios. But since experience may vary, do share yours with us, please. We're really interested in your feedback on any noticeable FPS changes.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-nw5v4W28Khk/W3Q9twFzomI/AAAAAAAABDc/6H4R_2FiUiEu83JuOGAr_WblRPsXGMuzACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5b73f592_07.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-nw5v4W28Khk/W3Q9twFzomI/AAAAAAAABDc/6H4R_2FiUiEu83JuOGAr_WblRPsXGMuzACEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5b73f592_07.jpg[/img][/url]

So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, and kinks. This time more than ever, due to the sheer size of the update. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/index.php]forum[/url] and your bug reports in [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=236]this section[/url].

[b]If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The method to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.32 public beta. No password required.[/b]

[h1]CHANGELOG:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Trailer ownership
https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1698306386977524431[/*]
[*]Major UI changes (Main menu, Company Management screens, Dealerships, etc.)[/*]
[*]Job filters redesign[/*][*]Some of the old trailers discarded and redesigned[/*]
[*]New roads added: US-550 (NM), US-95 (AZ), US-191 (AZ), Clifton city (AZ)[/*]
[*]Remade and redesigned few places (e.g. I5-I80 interchange)[/*]
[*]Power/air lines on AI vehicles (optional)[/*][*]Rendering speedup[/*]
[*]Option for automatic parking brake - disabled by default[/*]
[*]Long 53ft trailers (40+ feet from kingpin to rear axle) forbidden in California[/*]
[/list]
[h1]MOD ALERT:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Completely redesigned trailer-cargo logic (cargo data, trailer data, economy, etc.). Most mods will need some work to catch up![/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Waking up the sleeping dragon
notes.content:
Two winters ago, as a prize for completing the Christmas Grand Gift Delivery 2016 event, we have rewarded the participants with a time-exclusive content in the form of two pieces of DLC; one for American Truck Simulator and one for Euro Truck Simulator 2.

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-5F_gYOzbzCU/WyEh72__xNI/AAAAAAAABJA/zIMZC-4D9T8sa583MN0CVSM9nI_lWxFWACLcBGAs/s1600/001.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-5F_gYOzbzCU/WyEh72__xNI/AAAAAAAABJA/zIMZC-4D9T8sa583MN0CVSM9nI_lWxFWACLcBGAs/s1600/001.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Update 1.32 Appetizer: Trailer Ownership
notes.content:
Some hints about an upcoming major new feature of our truck sim games have already been spotted by the fan community, and it's time to finally start talking about it openly. Trailer ownership has been requested for years, and it's coming at last, as a major part of the upcoming 1.32 update both for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-hifjHXBOdzA/W2L9bieB87I/AAAAAAAABdw/pisWlYqo7RQbreqPmNXSXCFCy6Er-ZfVACLcBGAs/s1600/trailer_ownership_ets2.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-hifjHXBOdzA/W2L9bieB87I/AAAAAAAABdw/pisWlYqo7RQbreqPmNXSXCFCy6Er-ZfVACLcBGAs/s1600/trailer_ownership_ets2.jpg[/img][/url]

Trailer ownership may not necessarily have the same meaning for everybody, different people may have slightly different ideas of what it should include and how far it should go in depicting reality. In our games with lots of different systems, layered on top of each other, we had to figure out a way to add the feature without breaking the existing gameplay loop which has been very much ok for the majority of the millions of players who tried the game over the years, while bringing enough of a change for people eager for more depth. The core feature set had to be created in a reasonable timeframe so that the bulk of the implementation and testing can fit inside a period between two game updates. In reality, the work has been going on for over a year, employing a big cross-discipline team here, as there is a huge number of changes to gameplay logic and economy, camera work, user interface screens, there are tons of new models, artwork, textures, and paint jobs.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-2RuU-cuiXtM/W2L9jI5f3uI/AAAAAAAABd0/6_7k6i7kcbARDLONNGahywsnh8jFylNCACLcBGAs/s1600/trailer_ownership_amt.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-2RuU-cuiXtM/W2L9jI5f3uI/AAAAAAAABd0/6_7k6i7kcbARDLONNGahywsnh8jFylNCACLcBGAs/s1600/trailer_ownership_amt.jpg[/img][/url]

We had to decide on what is essential and concentrate on this core. In the upcoming update, there are still some elements left where we see an opportunity to go deeper eventually. Some trailer classes have not been refurbished yet so that they have not been made available for trailer ownership, this will have to wait for a future update, too. We are hopeful that the new feature will be accepted positively especially by the hardcore part of the truck sim players, as we have created not just a fully-fledged equivalent to the existing truck upgrade shop, but there's so much more included.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-ZehgbVkMzFc/W2MAL9_Rt3I/AAAAAAAABeE/UtexRVp2uEEM0hYyQ3c2v1lrQhLd336PQCLcBGAs/s1600/trailer_ownership_menu_2.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-ZehgbVkMzFc/W2MAL9_Rt3I/AAAAAAAABeE/UtexRVp2uEEM0hYyQ3c2v1lrQhLd336PQCLcBGAs/s1600/trailer_ownership_menu_2.jpg[/img][/url]

A new, separate configuration section in the form of trailer upgrade shop will let you build, configure, tune and paint your owned trailers. You can choose from multiple chassis, trailer types, and paint jobs and you’ll be able to tune your trailer with many different parts, of course, the wheels are customizable as well. Company paint jobs available in ETS2 will offer the right options for your new trailer to fit into your company's visual style. From now on your AI drivers are able to choose fitting trailers from your trailer pool and use them!

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-jTcZ4e3Hd34/W2MARybMY3I/AAAAAAAABeI/3TMVMqiUaqAqCUGwOaCq55vtg1BzBjSXACLcBGAs/s1600/trailer_ownership_menu_1.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-jTcZ4e3Hd34/W2MARybMY3I/AAAAAAAABeI/3TMVMqiUaqAqCUGwOaCq55vtg1BzBjSXACLcBGAs/s1600/trailer_ownership_menu_1.jpg[/img][/url]

In a nutshell, we have refrigerated, insulated, curtain siders and dry cargo trailers for both games coming in the update as ready to be owned. Moreover, ETS2 will host moving floor trailer variants. For European trailer configuration, you can choose from single, double or also the newly available b-double. American Truck Simulator will host 28, 45, 48 or 53 feet trailer versions in double, triple or even Rocky Mountain double configurations - these will be based on the geographic location of your garage to comply with the law in each US state. Flatbeds will be available for both ETS2 and ATS. Addition to ATS trailers are also flatbeds with a rolling tarp system (equivalent to European curtain sider). You can see there will be many trailer lengths and types combinations to haul cargoes of all sizes. We added one more fitting feature: ADR (HAZMAT) cargoes will „spawn“ appropriate warning sign on your trailer.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vgP5_krgP4o/W2MBq-eaMLI/AAAAAAAABeY/0s3o2TK8M8EJR_VQ5eDGCMh6Decuk7r0wCLcBGAs/s1600/trailer_ownership_menu_3.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vgP5_krgP4o/W2MBq-eaMLI/AAAAAAAABeY/0s3o2TK8M8EJR_VQ5eDGCMh6Decuk7r0wCLcBGAs/s1600/trailer_ownership_menu_3.jpg[/img][/url]

The new addition of trailer ownership logically means big changes to the in-game economy. It will be much more cargo-focused, but Quick jobs and Freight market will stay around as simpler and satisfying options to get into the game. A whole new Cargo Market screen will let you search for deliveries on your own trailer. Yes, we had to create a LOT of new cargo visualizations for this new feature.

We will show you more of trailer ownership before 1.32 is out, and it's also going to be battle-tested as a part of the upcoming Open Beta, so the wait should not be overly long. We hope you’ll be just as excited for its release as we are!

notes.title: Operation Big Sur Starting!
notes.content:
Operation Big Sur Starting![/h1]Here we are with a [url=https://www.worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url] event dedicated solely to American Truck Simulator! The most recent "Start Your Engines!" event related to our association with the FIA ETRC 2018 season roadshow attracted a lot of interest among the players. We were happy to see so many of you taking part in it, and we have high expectations again for our very first community event with a shared goal.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-bJS5kCQraoQ/WzCxerOT2OI/AAAAAAAAPiI/EsFdQ5mplgEMo_R-3JhXLYoTvDNbi83HACLcBGAs/s1600/blog_banner_Big_Sur.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-bJS5kCQraoQ/WzCxerOT2OI/AAAAAAAAPiI/EsFdQ5mplgEMo_R-3JhXLYoTvDNbi83HACLcBGAs/s1600/blog_banner_Big_Sur.jpg[/img][/url]

Many of you probably know about the Big Sur Landslide. It happened in May 2017 and made the Carmel-San Simeon Highway (a part of California State Route 1) unpassable. While the Caltrans workers and private contractors work seven days a week ever since to rebuild it as soon as possible, there is still enough of the landslide left for us. Let's help them and speed up the work! After all, we are talking 2 million cubic foot of dirt, rocks, sand, and mud.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-c0jdDPWh75w/WzDjX1Xf9ZI/AAAAAAAAM-s/t1NcSsA6ocIMLGcS4Wm0lqZ_uyLavWfbwCLcBGAs/s1600/big_sur_location.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-c0jdDPWh75w/WzDjX1Xf9ZI/AAAAAAAAM-s/t1NcSsA6ocIMLGcS4Wm0lqZ_uyLavWfbwCLcBGAs/s1600/big_sur_location.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-Srl3_q7kdkg/WzDjX4pe0tI/AAAAAAAAM-o/-PTvZTLCIVEWNLOwMoiVJebXaM0QyAtGQCLcBGAs/s1600/big_sur_jobs.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-Srl3_q7kdkg/WzDjX4pe0tI/AAAAAAAAM-o/-PTvZTLCIVEWNLOwMoiVJebXaM0QyAtGQCLcBGAs/s1600/big_sur_jobs.jpg[/img][/url]

Are you ready to join the Operation Big Sur? You can bet that along with that proud feeling of accomplishment there will be also some unique rewards for everyone who'll join us in this quest! Let's take a look at the rules and rewards:

[h1][u]Rules:[/u][/h1]
Using External Contracts deliver 15 cargos of material and equipment either TO or FROM Big Sur Landslide on California's Highway 1 to do your part and mark your personal contribution in the effort to restore the scenic coastal road.

This is also a global trucker's community project: In order to complete Operation Big Sur and open the road in the game, the entire American Truck Simulator trucking community will need to make at least 500,000 deliveries. You can track the community progress on the front page of the [url=https://www.worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url].

If you go beyond the required personal quota, your effort will still be counted towards the community goal completion.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-IJaZ0unuvNc/WzHwVsQidJI/AAAAAAAABN0/lAhodJ0u9pki04Cg342Vya45wX5Wyt5aQCLcBGAs/s1600/ats_hq_5b31d076_10.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-IJaZ0unuvNc/WzHwVsQidJI/AAAAAAAABN0/lAhodJ0u9pki04Cg342Vya45wX5Wyt5aQCLcBGAs/s1600/ats_hq_5b31d076_10.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][u]Rewards:[/u][/h1]
For doing your part and finishing 15 deliveries, you will receive a cute "Plush Excavator" cabin toy and an awesome "Juggernaut" paint job.

When the community goal is accomplished, everyone will receive a memorial paint job "Operation Big Sur". However, in order to qualify for the community reward, you must have completed at least 5 event jobs.

All rewards are tradable and marketable Steam Inventory items.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-ki7yLVDs2ig/WzC_bSxj51I/AAAAAAAAPi0/H618-bFzyhwh6GmyeTF9IYJ0lNPHE-P0gCLcBGAs/s1600/ats_20180625_101832_00.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-ki7yLVDs2ig/WzC_bSxj51I/AAAAAAAAPi0/H618-bFzyhwh6GmyeTF9IYJ0lNPHE-P0gCLcBGAs/s1600/ats_20180625_101832_00.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-PwHrkKD9Sks/WzCxul2z0WI/AAAAAAAAPiU/OsnOu_8AWOQrGzGxefGIEvbY2b8NgZ36wCLcBGAs/s1600/ats_20180625_101521_00.gif][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-PwHrkKD9Sks/WzCxul2z0WI/AAAAAAAAPiU/OsnOu_8AWOQrGzGxefGIEvbY2b8NgZ36wCLcBGAs/s1600/ats_20180625_101521_00.gif[/img][/url]
[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-F7E-8X7GblA/WzCxukMslNI/AAAAAAAAPiQ/js6Y7Zwyn_w5bUaGZ2nsEiZ8y8WleUsmwCLcBGAs/s1600/ats_20180625_101723_00.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-F7E-8X7GblA/WzCxukMslNI/AAAAAAAAPiQ/js6Y7Zwyn_w5bUaGZ2nsEiZ8y8WleUsmwCLcBGAs/s1600/ats_20180625_101723_00.jpg[/img][/url]

Ready? It's time to put on the hauling pants and hop in the cabins of our diesel beast. Meeting point - the Big Sur Landslide!

This is a community event, and we hope for the various fan communities around the globe to feel that they are all a part of the united effort! We will be looking forward to seeing your screenshots of the event shared on social media, too. We have once again partnered with [url=http://truckers.fm/]Truckers.FM[/url] to entertain us all during the hauls, and they have some cool giveaways ready for reaching specific milestones on the general progress bar of Operation Big Sur (see [url=https://www.worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] frontpage). Just make sure to tag the pictures with hashtag [u]#OperationBigSur[/u] and also notify [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]@scssoftware[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/TruckersFM]@TruckersFM[/url].

notes.title: Natural beauty of Oregon
notes.content:
Welcome to the next episode of our popular series, revealing details of the upcoming Oregon map expansion for American Truck Simulator. Today we will focus on natural surroundings. Our interpretation of the natural beauty of the states is an essential part of our development focus.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-ZhLnwIqshdU/WxElM9h91SI/AAAAAAAABHE/AK51nqJe_CsFD7Hb-nmd3i1geRH3dGtMwCLcBGAs/s1600/01.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-ZhLnwIqshdU/WxElM9h91SI/AAAAAAAABHE/AK51nqJe_CsFD7Hb-nmd3i1geRH3dGtMwCLcBGAs/s1600/01.jpg[/img][/url]

Our programmers are always improving the tools available to our map designers. Our system for intelligent creation of rock formations has been further refined, so the map team has now even more toys at their disposal to play with.

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-AadCsVPtUq0/WxEm4lAu25I/AAAAAAAABHk/e0w5s-GTs2oIBN3CNBvKaPAPConBja5hACEwYBhgL/s1600/08.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-AadCsVPtUq0/WxEm4lAu25I/AAAAAAAABHk/e0w5s-GTs2oIBN3CNBvKaPAPConBja5hACEwYBhgL/s1600/08.jpg[/img][/url]

Forest industry is one of the key building blogs of Oregon economy and transportation. We want to take our players deeper into the forests, showing things in closer detail. That is why new detailed models of lower and higher forest vegetation are created. We also added wetlands and swamps together with lush meadows full of blooming wildflowers. Several unique representatives of Oregon flora have also been identified. For example, we have created a brand new thundercloud flowering plum tree for some of the urban areas.

notes.title: ATS and ETS2 Update 1.31 Out Now!
notes.content:
We are happy to give you official new updates for both our flagship truck sims, at last. Testing of this update wave took us longer than we had hoped, both internal tests and the open beta revealed a lot of areas requiring our attention before we could call the update done.There's quite a lot of new content and functionality for both games there, and we have run into some unexpected problems when things refused to work together.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-fsyV5J95iuo/WvlmcVrDWzI/AAAAAAAABFU/dZiyTwq6suE1fb7lhwOGvejAgwiD1no_wCLcBGAs/s1600/blog_1_31_update.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-fsyV5J95iuo/WvlmcVrDWzI/AAAAAAAABFU/dZiyTwq6suE1fb7lhwOGvejAgwiD1no_wCLcBGAs/s640/blog_1_31_update.jpg[/img][/url]

Thumbs up to everyone who participated in the beta (for both of our games) and sent us his opinion and reported any issues. We would like to express our sincere thanks for all your help, bug reports, and general feedback, they were even more important and helpful than usual. After over a month full of testing, bug fixing, (and sometimes yelling and panicking), we're finally there. Update 1.31 is out for both of our games!

You can find the long and dry list of changes and additions below, but for those of you preferring moving pictures to written words, here is a very nice overview of the major changes in the 1.31 update courtesy of [url=http://www.youtube.com/squirrel]Squirrel's YouTube channel[/url]:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D80nTXTgtAA

[h1]CHANGELOG - MAIN FEATURES:[/h1]
[list][*]Power/air lines between truck and trailer(s) ([url=http://blog.scssoft.com/2018/03/cables.html]read more[/url])
[*]More realistic mirror rendering (head position-based FOV)
[/list]

[h1]ATS only:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New road through Yosemite added - CA-120 ([url=http://blog.scssoft.com/2018/03/tioga-pass.html]read more[/url])[/*][*]New trailers (bottom dumpers)[/*]
[/list]

[h1]ETS2 only:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Random road events[/*]
[*]8x4 Scania R and S truck chassis[/*]
[*]New routes for Special Transport DLC missions ([url=http://blog.scssoft.com/2018/04/ets2-special-transport-revisited.html]read more[/url])[/*]
[*]Mighty Griffin DLC aftermarket tuning parts for next-gen Scania S & R ([url=http://blog.scssoft.com/2018/03/mighty-griffin-additions-under.html]read more[/url])[/*]
[/list]

[h1]MINOR CHANGES:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Job selection screens have new filter and cargo search elements[/*]
[*]Parking brake automatically ON after truck spawn (g_park_brake_init)[/*]
[*]Screenshot name format now based on date and time[/*]
[*]Increased precision trip data (dashboard computer display)[/*]
[*]Fixed torque converter locking[/*]
[*]Fixed damaged predefined trucks in dealers and quick jobs[/*]
[*]Fixed trailer damage reporting[/*]
[*]Fixed HDR interpolation[/*]
[/list]

[h1]ETS2 only:[/h1]
[list]
[*]UK trailers no longer have a different license plate from the lorry[/*]
[*]Faster gear shifting for new Opticruise transmissions[/*]
[*]Fixed/updated license plates in various countries (Belgian, Norwegian, Polish, Czech)[/*]
[/list]

[h1]TOOLS/ MOD:[/h1]
[list]
[*]New terrain brushes in the map editor[/*]
[*]Dropped support of very old maps (pre ver. 4.38)[/*]
[*]Mirror_data[/*]
[*]A trailer can be registered as standalone or not [/*]
[*]Variable shift length[/*]
[*]Truck dealer trucks are not in a single file/list anymore, the game reads all files/units in the given directory, making things friendlier for mods to coexist[/*]
[*]Steerable wheel independent on wheel model[/*]
[*]Dropped support for old attributes[/*]
[/list]

Make sure to OPT OUT of beta branches now and your game will be automatically updated on Steam. For the legacy non-Steam edition of ETS2, the update should be ready in a few days. Enjoy!

notes.title: American Truck Simulator Update 1.31 Open Beta
notes.content:
We are making American Truck Simulator Update 1.31 accessible in Open Beta form today. We are starting a little rough this time, with several known issues, but at the same time, we are eager to collect feedback and reports already to help us finalize this update ASAP. Open Beta 1.31 for ETS2 should follow in a matter of a few days.[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-3g0R1LhjFMA/WtCFocdoFtI/AAAAAAAAA3M/miWVssl4-l8Vnc9DUXScn5XXqt5k8x27gCLcBGAs/s1600/blog_ats_1_31_open_beta.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-3g0R1LhjFMA/WtCFocdoFtI/AAAAAAAAA3M/miWVssl4-l8Vnc9DUXScn5XXqt5k8x27gCLcBGAs/s640/blog_ats_1_31_open_beta.jpg[/img][/url]
This update brings a mix of new things in many areas of our games. For those of you focused on truck realism, there are simulated trailer cables (with different visibility options) and improved mirror functionality. Explorers taking the CA120 into Yosemite National Park right away - be advised that in National Parks there are some regulations about commercial trucking. And finally, there are also new bottom dumper trailers coming in three versions.
[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-BnLUC7LLZcc/WtCHU9BrDJI/AAAAAAAAA3Y/HXt5rlyj3qU5qIhPg32lFVjg39nbFqpnwCLcBGAs/s1600/ats_open_beta_1_31_01.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-BnLUC7LLZcc/WtCHU9BrDJI/AAAAAAAAA3Y/HXt5rlyj3qU5qIhPg32lFVjg39nbFqpnwCLcBGAs/s640/ats_open_beta_1_31_01.jpg[/img][/url]
There are also some smaller changes; 1.31 brings a few items from players' wish lists. We are introducing a new filter option for job and cargo search, or better precision of trip data for dashboard computer. As always, we have applied a ton of various fixes and tweaks. There is also one noteworthy change - from now on, when you reload/restart the game or if the gameplay repositions your vehicle to a new place, and you "spawn" in your truck, the parking brake will be always automatically set to ON, so that the vehicle may never start moving on its own unintentionally.
[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-HwugUeADQBw/WtCO8KB4gTI/AAAAAAAAA3o/BqLK-n7HFj4xpM7788zwV0f6W7M8PUDBgCLcBGAs/s1600/ats_open_beta_1_31_02.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-HwugUeADQBw/WtCO8KB4gTI/AAAAAAAAA3o/BqLK-n7HFj4xpM7788zwV0f6W7M8PUDBgCLcBGAs/s640/ats_open_beta_1_31_02.jpg[/img][/url]

There are also some changes in tools and mods category. We are currently in the middle of a massive tech change in how our map designers apply textures, materials, and vegetation to road segments. Of course, this will also apply to the mod creators going forward. Historically, we have used a concept of "stamps" with pre-designed patterns to conserve memory and disk space, but we are abandoning this approach, and letting the map designers just "paint" surface properties with a "brush." This will bring more freedom and flexibility to map design; it should make the work more effective when a map designer is in need of a particular terrain feature. For the time being though, it means that map mods will have to be re-touched and re-saved with the new system, so things will need to settle down until everybody catches up. With the cleanup of map import code, we have also dropped support for very old (pre-4.38 format) maps so mods that are no longer maintained (were last saved as of Feb 2017) cannot be loaded in the current version of the game. We hope that this is not really an issue for any mods in current use.

Anyway - enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an [b]open beta[/b], not a stable public version so you may encounter bugs, instability, and kinks. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/index.php]forum[/url] and your bug reports in this [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=233]section[/url].

[h1]MAIN FEATURES:[/h1]
[list][*]Power/air lines between truck and trailer(s)[/*]
[*]Improved mirror rendering (head position-based FOV, properly curved mirrors)[/*]
[*]New road through Yosemite added (CA-120)[/*]
[*]New trailers (bottom dumpers)[/*][/list]


[h1]MINOR CHANGES:[/h1]
 
[list][*]Job selection screens have new filter and cargo search elements (will be added later)[/*]
[*]Parking brake automatically ON after truck spawn (g_park_brake_init)[/*]
[*]Screenshot name format now based on date and time[/*]
[*]Increased precision trip data (dashboard computer display)[/*]
[*]Fixed torque converter locking[/*]
[*]Fixed damaged predefined trucks in dealers and quick jobs[/*]
[*]Fixed trailer damage reporting[/*]
[*]Fixed HDR interpolation[/*][/list]


[h1]TOOLS/ MOD:[/h1]
[list][*]New terrain brushes in the map editor[/*]
[*]Dropped support of the old maps (pre 4.38, due to brushes)[/*]
[*]Mirror_data[/*]
[*]A trailer could be registered as standalone or not[/*]
[*]Variable shift length[/*]
[*]Truck dealer trucks are not on the list anymore, the game reads all units in given directory[/*]
[*]Steerable wheel independent on wheel model [/*]
[*]Dropped support for old attributes[/*]

Today we want to share a few work-in-progress images from American Truck Simulator: Oregon map expansion development. They are depicting one of the new industrial prefabs we're working on: a shipyard.

notes.title: Which way to go? Beaver knows!
notes.content:
It's been two years since the release of American Truck Simulator. These were very hectic and demanding times for our development team but gave us all a lot of joy, too. Over the development of the game, the dedicated ATS team size has grown from the starting brave four to almost forty people at this moment. And we keep on growing, as we are acutely aware that we need to produce more content and more features at a quicker pace.

Our latest addition to ATS universe - the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/]New Mexico map expansion[/url] - won the hearts of our players and has been critically acclaimed by both media and the community. We're extremely grateful for it, it gives us the energy to do our job the best we can and the desire to surpass ourselves and push the boundaries further.

We posted a few photo-hints in our previous teaser blog post to start your imagination. It's time to lift the veil now and show you the next step in ATS world development. There are several possible and logical directions... East? Or North? Can it be Northeast? Rest assured that serious research and pre-production is happening in all these directions, but for actual production, the winner is North! Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome to ... Oregon!

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/--XLiiQJv1m4/WnHNhpjMGEI/AAAAAAAAA4s/zQrzqN1XWeYSKQ1nsil6uT_eRGW0FUY6wCLcBGAs/s1600/01.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/--XLiiQJv1m4/WnHNhpjMGEI/AAAAAAAAA4s/zQrzqN1XWeYSKQ1nsil6uT_eRGW0FUY6wCLcBGAs/s640/01.jpg[/img][/url]

Oregon, the Beaver State, will be the new addition. Depicting the very diverse environments across Northern America is always an exciting challenge for us. Oregon's nature surpasses everything we've encountered so far. Extensive deep forests, dense shrublands, deep calm lakes, wide rivers, steep mountain ranges, volcanoes, high desert and the Pacific Ocean's coastline. All stacked onto territory just a little larger than the United Kingdom!

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-GX9xt1AGefM/WnHNl7VlViI/AAAAAAAAA40/IGnILqVrccIy-3UN7Y3HOsC7Od1fo2IVgCLcBGAs/s1600/02.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-GX9xt1AGefM/WnHNl7VlViI/AAAAAAAAA40/IGnILqVrccIy-3UN7Y3HOsC7Od1fo2IVgCLcBGAs/s640/02.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-P3VCbOCVu9c/WnHNlz7pOYI/AAAAAAAAA4w/yCSx4IYTNgAzcZ7M_VK0LQz0pD6ChT6GwCLcBGAs/s1600/03.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-P3VCbOCVu9c/WnHNlz7pOYI/AAAAAAAAA4w/yCSx4IYTNgAzcZ7M_VK0LQz0pD6ChT6GwCLcBGAs/s640/03.jpg[/img][/url]

Natural diversity is, of course, reflected in demographics and industry. You can look forward to the in-game economy being extended by the local industry corresponding to the reality of Oregon, like traditional wood harvesting and processing at sawmills followed with paper mills and furniture industry. We have not forgotten about other industry like technologically advanced Silicon Forest and other manufacturing centers.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-sRu_qoZ17qA/WnHNreomJNI/AAAAAAAAA44/G3P43kvepN40LRoJodVJ0pxhrleEZ9ymACLcBGAs/s1600/04.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-sRu_qoZ17qA/WnHNreomJNI/AAAAAAAAA44/G3P43kvepN40LRoJodVJ0pxhrleEZ9ymACLcBGAs/s640/04.jpg[/img][/url]

Make sure to follow our blog, we'll publish a series which introduces our newest map expansion Oregon and bring interesting news from development.

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-6um2_0Dzr7A/WnHNunw8qlI/AAAAAAAAA48/2brBfVK2G5kHPeWlVbjX_CvJI9Le17NawCLcBGAs/s1600/05.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-6um2_0Dzr7A/WnHNunw8qlI/AAAAAAAAA48/2brBfVK2G5kHPeWlVbjX_CvJI9Le17NawCLcBGAs/s640/05.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-j8Hr87KbHW4/WnHNuubgb_I/AAAAAAAAA5A/6eBb-sB1JMEmwC8AbONIz_tS0RdjhltzACLcBGAs/s1600/06.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-j8Hr87KbHW4/WnHNuubgb_I/AAAAAAAAA5A/6eBb-sB1JMEmwC8AbONIz_tS0RdjhltzACLcBGAs/s640/06.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator 1.30 Update
notes.content:
In the frenzy of releases at the end of last year, we have not managed to sync the codebases of American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2 to the same revision. With multiple builds of games and DLC to pass through QA, we did not have enough testing capacity to dedicate to this update. The 1.29 revision was solid and working, and we didn't want to risk releasing a new build just a day or two before starting our whole-company vacation, only to find out that a hotfix is needed immediately. It was deemed safer to live with known little glitches for a few weeks rather than to risk introducing an unknown game-breaking bug.

This maintenance release mostly brings some bug fixes and safety measures for mods.

Your game on Steam should update automatically, unless you have opted out from auto updates, or unless you prefer to stay with a particular branch to preserve older mod compatibility.

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-pL0EPRWpNt4/Wld0ONXBryI/AAAAAAAAA2E/IrsMS_PnavsEPKKjgUzf_wCqodcKPCD3wCLcBGAs/s1600/blog_ats_1_30_update.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-pL0EPRWpNt4/Wld0ONXBryI/AAAAAAAAA2E/IrsMS_PnavsEPKKjgUzf_wCqodcKPCD3wCLcBGAs/s640/blog_ats_1_30_update.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Code support for multi-torque engines[/*]
[*]Fixed generation of terrain when it is connected to terrain in unloaded sector[/*]
[*]AI will not use blinkers when canceling a lane change while it is in progress[/*]
[*]Fixed sleeping area triggers not being visible in UI map after initial game load[/*]
[*]Improved calculation of trailer weight distribution when lifting trailer axles[/*][*]Various editor fixes and improvements (stamps in content browser, support hiding of instanced geometry, collections, item performance info, searching, traffic tool)[/*]
[*]Cleanup of OpenGL support[/*]
[*]Fixed light sources in multi-time HQ screenshots[/*]
[*]Prevented crash if road is using a stamp whose material is missing[/*][*]Prevented crash when creating new board template in mod[/*]
[*]Updated localization[/*]

notes.title: New Event: Grand Gift Delivery 2017
notes.content:
Santa needs our help!

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-gWIyfVTxScc/WjkNv8cJUcI/AAAAAAAAJbQ/D_2ue-cn92MV7X30nv2VhfTjPNUhgVtAACLcBGAs/s1600/blog_header_xmas.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-gWIyfVTxScc/WjkNv8cJUcI/AAAAAAAAJbQ/D_2ue-cn92MV7X30nv2VhfTjPNUhgVtAACLcBGAs/s640/blog_header_xmas.jpg[/img][/url]

Our '[url=http://blog.scssoft.com/search/label/On%20The%20Road]On The Road[/url]' crew has just arrived from the North Pole. Santa's logistics network is having a hard time coping with deliveries of all the gifts, and SCS Software has been summoned for help. Honestly, though, our humble sim trailer is just not enough, the motion seats just take up too much space. Way more capacity is needed. It is clear that we need to turn to players of our games for help!

There are billions of gifts around the globe waiting for delivery, and we have duly informed Santa that we may only be able to help him with a tiny fraction of the number, and only in limited territories. Even with the addition of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/]New Mexico to American Truck Simulator[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/558244/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Italia/]Italia to Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url], our coverage of the two continents is still not satisfactory, not to speak about the rest of the planet. Yes, we know! Now even Santa is pushing us hard to improve the coverage for the next year already - as if he planned to depend on us again and again.

For now, let's try to do what we can do. There are rewards waiting for everyone who'll join in! Santa has some special cabin toys and accessories straight from his domain for you. He's even willing to let you park your mighty diesel beasts at the North Pole - in a new main-menu background scene. How cool is that?

This [url=https://www.worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url] event is a bit more complex than what we had in the previous seasons. Players of both American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2 will be able to participate, but each game is counted separately and provides its own set of achievements and rewards. On top of it, each game's event actually has two levels of accomplishment, and two tiers of rewards!

The rewards are not just digital this time. At the conclusion of the event, we'll draw five lucky winners for each game and each tier (that's 20 prizes in total) and offer you a choice of merchandise from our e-shop to pick your reward from.

[h1]Rules & Rewards[/h1]

We're running two events in parallel - you can choose between American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2, or participate in both events to earn the most goodies! Deliver gifts (that's a very specific cargo that you will only find on [url=https://www.worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url] contracts now!) to at least 6 (for the 1st Tier) or 12 (to complete the 2nd Tier) different cities. Only deliveries of over 240 km / 150 miles are eligible. Receive unique rewards on each tier:

[h1]Tier 1:[/h1]
[list][*]Exclusive World of Trucks achievements for event completion in each game[/*][*]Hanging cabin decorations - [u]Xmas Ball [/u]and[b] Plush Bear [/b](ETS2), [b][u]Polar Star[/u][/b] and [u][b]Polar Plush Bear[/b][/u] (ATS)[/*][*]Main menu background theme - "[u][b]Magic Time[/b][/u]"[/*][*]Five people who completed this Tier have a chance of winning the physical reward: [u]choose any amount of merchandise of your choice[/u] from our [url=https://eshop.scssoft.com/]e-shop[/url] for a sum up to 50€.[/*][/list]

[h1]Tier 2:[/h1]
[list][*]Hanging cabin decorations - [b][u]Polar Beast[/u][/b] and [b][u]Snowman Trucker[/u][/b] (ETS2), [b][u]Grizzly Bear[/u][/b] and [b][u]Snowman Trucker[/u][/b] (ATS)[/*][*]Customizable paint-jobs [u][b]"Crystal Dream" [/b](ATS) and [b]"Crystal Dimension"[/b] (ETS2)[/u][/*][*]Main menu background theme - "[b][u]On top of the world[/u][/b]"[/*][*]Five people who completed this Tier have a chance of winning physical reward: [u]choose any amount of merchandise of your choice[/u] from [url=https://eshop.scssoft.com/]e-shop[/url] for a sum up to 100€.[/*][/list]
[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-xtOLuoWMJsY/WjkZlNurQ9I/AAAAAAAAJbg/vf-ENJyZPGQ9E-zH6UTmJegfUwBHN4vsACLcBGAs/s1600/banner_ETS2_paint.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-xtOLuoWMJsY/WjkZlNurQ9I/AAAAAAAAJbg/vf-ENJyZPGQ9E-zH6UTmJegfUwBHN4vsACLcBGAs/s640/banner_ETS2_paint.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-D-nd1FgjqW8/WjkZlq3U8pI/AAAAAAAAJbs/o49OdvSy464lSSUY0S6MdpNQb6XD3wCigCLcBGAs/s1600/banner_ETS2_rewards.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-D-nd1FgjqW8/WjkZlq3U8pI/AAAAAAAAJbs/o49OdvSy464lSSUY0S6MdpNQb6XD3wCigCLcBGAs/s640/banner_ETS2_rewards.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-vVgLQYy-dus/WjkZlFQ7WhI/AAAAAAAAJbo/C4KkbxTCl-8tkBYSE7V4YWlPQLvdl_l6gCLcBGAs/s1600/banner_ATS_paint.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-vVgLQYy-dus/WjkZlFQ7WhI/AAAAAAAAJbo/C4KkbxTCl-8tkBYSE7V4YWlPQLvdl_l6gCLcBGAs/s640/banner_ATS_paint.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vWziKwBl0Yo/WjkZlHgtvRI/AAAAAAAAJbk/2nWcGWGoyMkIKZyhMm20Jjh8mqxqOsPcgCLcBGAs/s1600/banner_ATS_rewards.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-vWziKwBl0Yo/WjkZlHgtvRI/AAAAAAAAJbk/2nWcGWGoyMkIKZyhMm20Jjh8mqxqOsPcgCLcBGAs/s640/banner_ATS_rewards.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Important Notes[/h1]

[list][*]Latest game version is required for participating in the event.[/*][*]In-game rewards are granted as tradeable and marketable Steam inventory items[/*][*]Quadruple (x4) your chance of winning a physical reward by completing the event in both games for both event Tiers![/*][*]Physical rewards are drawn randomly from all participants for each Tier after event completion on Monday, January 22, 2018. Winners will be announced on our blog![/*][/list]

That's it! Put on your hauling pants and hop behind your steering wheel! There're some delivery jobs waiting for you!

There are billions of gifts around the globe waiting for delivery, and we have duly informed Santa that we may only be able to help him with a tiny fraction of the number, and only in limited territories. Even with the addition of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/]New Mexico to American Truck Simulator[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/558244/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Italia/]Italia to Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url], our coverage of the two continents is still not satisfactory, not to speak about the rest of the planet. Yes, we know! Now even Santa is pushing us hard to improve the coverage for the next year already - as if he planned to depend on us again and again.

For now, let's try to do what we can do. There are rewards waiting for everyone who'll join in! Santa has some special cabin toys and accessories straight from his domain for you. He's even willing to let you park your mighty diesel beasts at the North Pole - in a new main-menu background scene. How cool is that?

This [url=https://www.worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url] event is a bit more complex than what we had in the previous seasons. Players of both American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2 will be able to participate, but each game is counted separately and provides its own set of achievements and rewards. On top of it, each game's event actually has two levels of accomplishment, and two tiers of rewards!

The rewards are not just digital this time. At the conclusion of the event, we'll draw five lucky winners for each game and each tier (that's 20 prizes in total) and offer you a choice of merchandise from our e-shop to pick your reward from.

[h1]Rules & Rewards[/h1]

We're running two events in parallel - you can choose between American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2, or participate in both events to earn the most goodies! Deliver gifts (that's a very specific cargo that you will only find on [url=https://www.worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url] contracts now!) to at least 6 (for the 1st Tier) or 12 (to complete the 2nd Tier) different cities. Only deliveries of over 240 km / 150 miles are eligible. Receive unique rewards on each tier:

[h1]Tier 1:[/h1]
[list][*]Exclusive World of Trucks achievements for event completion in each game[/*][*]Hanging cabin decorations - [u]Xmas Ball [/u]and[b] Plush Bear [/b](ETS2), [b][u]Polar Star[/u][/b] and [u][b]Polar Plush Bear[/b][/u] (ATS)[/*][*]Main menu background theme - "[u][b]Magic Time[/b][/u]"[/*][*]Five people who completed this Tier have a chance of winning the physical reward: [u]choose any amount of merchandise of your choice[/u] from our [url=https://eshop.scssoft.com/]e-shop[/url] for a sum up to 50€.[/*][/list]

[h1]Tier 2:[/h1]
[list][*]Hanging cabin decorations - [b][u]Polar Beast[/u][/b] and [b][u]Snowman Trucker[/u][/b] (ETS2), [b][u]Grizzly Bear[/u][/b] and [b][u]Snowman Trucker[/u][/b] (ATS)[/*][*]Customizable paint-jobs [u][b]"Crystal Dream" [/b](ATS) and [b]"Crystal Dimension"[/b] (ETS2)[/u][/*][*]Main menu background theme - "[b][u]On top of the world[/u][/b]"[/*][*]Five people who completed this Tier have a chance of winning physical reward: [u]choose any amount of merchandise of your choice[/u] from [url=https://eshop.scssoft.com/]e-shop[/url] for a sum up to 100€.[/*][/list]
